papers.title: DisciplineGen-1M: A Large-Scale Dataset for Multidisciplinary Visual Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recent image generation and editing models can produce visually appealing natural images, yet they remain unreliable when the target image is a knowledge-intensive diagram whose correctness depends on disciplinary concepts, symbolic structure, and precise spatial relations. We introduce DisciplineGen-1M, a million-scale multidisciplinary dataset that supports text-to-image generation and image editing. It contains 1.2M samples spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, geography, computer science, economics, history, music, and sports. To construct the dataset, we design a scalable framework that combines vector-graphics rendering, OCR-based editing, curated programmatic synthesis, and large-scale text-to-image filtering. These pipelines produce captions, editing instructions, structured annotations, and paired images with controllable semantic differences. Building on DisciplineGen-1M, we further introduce a discipline-informed reasoning-generation model for both text-to-image generation and image editing. Experiments on discipline-related benchmarks, GenExam and GRADE, show substantial improvements over open-source baselines, while evaluations on general reasoning-informed benchmarks, WISE and RISE, further indicate broader transfer. The results suggest that large-scale structured academic visual data is a key ingredient for moving image generation from aesthetic plausibility toward verifiable knowledge-grounded visual creation. We will publicly release our dataset, model, and source code of the data curation pipeline to ensure reproducibility and benefit future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DisciplineGen-1M 是一个百万级多学科视觉生成与编辑数据集，包含 120 万样本，覆盖数学、物理、化学、生物、地理、计算机科学、经济学、历史、音乐和体育。该数据集通过结合矢量图形渲染、OCR 编辑、程序化合成和文本到图像过滤的框架构建，并基于此训练了学科感知的推理-生成模型。在学科相关基准 GenExam 和 GRADE 上，该模型显著优于开源基线，同时在通用推理基准 WISE 和 RISE 上也表现出可迁移的提升。
Motivation: 现有图像生成模型在处理依赖学科概念、符号结构和精确空间关系的知识密集型图表时不可靠，缺乏专门的多学科数据支撑。
Method: 提出可扩展的数据构建框架，融合矢量图形渲染、OCR 编辑、程序化合成和文本到图像过滤，生成涵盖 10 个学科的 1.2M 样本及对应标注。并基于该数据集训练学科感知的推理-生成模型。
Result: 在学科相关基准 GenExam 和 GRADE 上显著优于开源基线；在通用推理基准 WISE 和 RISE 上也取得提升。
Conclusion: 大规模结构化学术视觉数据是推动图像生成从审美可信向知识可验证视觉创建的关键要素。

papers.title: Generalization in offline RL: The structure is more important than the amount of pessimism
papers.abstract_en: While pessimism counteracts overestimation bias in offline reinforcement learning (RL), being overly conservative has been associated with hindering certain forms of generalization. However, in this paper we demonstrate that being overly pessimistic does not inherently prevent optimal generalization in contextual MDPs (CMDPs). Instead, we argue successful generalization depends not on the amount of pessimism, but whether the pessimistic structure respects the underlying symmetries of the optimal solution. We prove that a mildly pessimistic, non-symmetric value function can generalize worse than an overly pessimistic, symmetric one. In offline RL, the structure of the pessimism is determined by the structure of the dataset coverage. As such, enforcing a symmetric value function can be non-trivial, and might require techniques such as data augmentation (DA). Inspired by our theoretical results, we argue that DA can best be applied through a consistency loss during policy extraction, rather than the common practice of (regular) offline training on an augmented dataset. This is empirically validated using IQL and CQL on a rotationally symmetric reacher environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离线强化学习中悲观主义对泛化的影响，证明过度悲观并不妨碍最优泛化，关键在于悲观结构是否尊重最优解的内在对称性。通过理论分析和在旋转对称的reacher环境中的实验（使用IQL和CQL），作者提出数据增强应通过一致性损失在策略提取阶段应用，而非在增广数据集上常规训练。
Motivation: 先前研究认为过度保守会阻碍某些形式的泛化，本文挑战这一观点，主张泛化成功取决于悲观结构而非悲观程度。
Method: 通过理论证明和实验验证，在离线RL中，数据增强应通过一致性损失在策略提取阶段应用，而不是在增广数据集上进行常规的离线训练。
Result: 在旋转对称的reacher环境中，使用IQL和CQL的实验结果支持其理论主张：过度悲观的对称值函数泛化优于非对称的轻悲观值函数。
Conclusion: 强调悲观结构比悲观程度更重要，并建议数据增强的正确应用方式是在策略提取时加入一致性损失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlowCIR: Semantic Transport via Flow Matching for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) aims to retrieve a target image by editing a reference image with a natural-language instruction, without relying on domain-specific annotated triplets. Most existing ZS-CIR methods rely on textual inversion to translate the reference image into pseudo-text tokens and then compose them with the instruction via simple concatenation in the text space, which can be lossy and brittle for fine-grained semantics. In this work, we propose a new paradigm, namely FlowCIR, that casts ZS-CIR as conditional semantic transport between reference and target embeddings. Leveraging \emph{conditional flow matching}, our model learns a lightweight transport field that maps the instruction representation toward a target-aligned query embedding conditioned on the reference image. Since FlowCIR operates on pre-extracted VLM embeddings and trains only a small transport module without updating the image or text encoder, it offers a computationally efficient training protocol compared with prior textual-inversion-based approaches. The resulting framework is training-efficient, requiring roughly $10\times$ fewer training resources than prior textual-inversion-based approaches. We further identify negation and removal as a major failure mode of VLM-based composition. To address this, we propose an inference-only Multi-Negative Steering strategy that steers a negation-containing relative instruction away from its negated semantics, mitigating the limited negation handling of VLMs and improving robustness on negation-heavy queries. Extensive experiments on standard CIR benchmarks demonstrate that FlowCIR achieves strong and competitive performance compared with recent ZS-CIR methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowCIR将零样本组合图像检索（ZS-CIR）建模为参考图像嵌入与目标图像嵌入之间的条件语义传输，利用条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）学习轻量传输场，而不依赖文本反演。方法训练高效，资源需求约为先前文本反演方法的1/10，并提出推理时的多负向引导（Multi-Negative Steering）策略以改善VLM对否定语义的处理。在标准CIR基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有ZS-CIR方法依赖文本反演将参考图像转为伪文本标记，导致细粒度语义丢失且脆弱，尤其难以处理包含否定或移除指令的查询。
Method: 提出FlowCIR，将ZS-CIR作为条件语义传输任务，使用条件流匹配学习一个轻量传输场，将指令表示映射为目标对齐的查询嵌入，仅训练小模块而不更新VLM编码器。此外，提出推理时的多负向引导策略，通过将否定指令的表示向远离其否定语义的方向调整来增强鲁棒性。
Result: 在标准CIR基准上，FlowCIR取得有竞争力的性能，且训练资源比基于文本反演的方法减少约10倍。
Conclusion: FlowCIR提供了一种训练高效且能更好处理否定查询的ZS-CIR新范式，但摘要未提及明显局限性或进一步验证范围。

papers.title: Dendritic In-Context Learning in a Single-Layer Spiking Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) operates via implicit gradient descent embedded in the forward pass of modern AI architectures -- Transformers, Mamba, state-space models, and MLPs. Capturing this capability in biologically plausible Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) has remained an open challenge: existing SNNs fail the Garg-2022 benchmark at non-trivial task dimensions. We trace this failure to a structural assumption: prior SNN designs route adaptation through inference-time synaptic plasticity, viewing the dendritic compartment as a passive conduit for error or teacher signals. We challenge this assumption. The subthreshold dynamics of a single dendritic compartment already implement a complete online learning algorithm. By treating the compartment as the computational substrate rather than a passive conduit, we propose DendriCL -- a single-layer compartmental spiking architecture whose apical recurrence is structurally identical to leaky online Widrow-Hoff LMS. This dynamics-only update collapses the architectural depth required for general-purpose ICL to a single layer. DendriCL is uniquely seed-stable at super-dimensional Garg-2022 ICL -- where dense Transformers exhibit grokking-style instability and fail past moderate task dimension -- and a linear probe recovers the reference online-LMS trajectory directly from the apical membrane at R^2 = 0.93, showing the algorithm is structurally embedded in the dynamics rather than implicitly discovered during training. Taken together, ICL requires neither attention, depth, nor inference-time plasticity: a single compartment with online-LMS dynamics is sufficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DendriCL，一种单层树突脉冲神经网络架构，其尖端循环动态等同于漏泄在线Widrow-Hoff LMS算法，从而在单层中实现通用上下文学习（ICL）。实验表明，DendriCL在高维Garg-2022 ICL基准上表现出种子稳定性，而密集Transformer在该任务中呈现grokking式不稳定；线性探针能从顶树突膜电位直接恢复在线LMS轨迹（R²=0.93），证明算法结构内嵌于动态而非训练中习得。结论是ICL不需要注意力、深度或推理时突触可塑性，单个隔室即可胜任。
Motivation: 现有生物合理脉冲神经网络（SNN）在Garg-2022 ICL基准上失败，原因是它们将树突视为被动通道，依赖推理时突触可塑性进行适应。本文挑战该假设，认为单个树突隔室的亚阈值动态已能实现完整在线学习算法。
Method: 提出DendriCL——单层树突隔室脉冲架构，其尖端循环（apical recurrence）在结构上等同于漏泄在线Widrow-Hoff LMS。该架构将隔室视为计算基质而非被动通道，仅通过动态更新便将通用ICL所需的架构深度压缩至单层。
Result: DendriCL在超维Garg-2022 ICL基准上具有种子稳定性（seed-stable），而密集Transformer在该任务中呈现grokking式不稳定且在中高任务维度失败。线性探针可从顶树突膜电位直接恢复参考在线LMS轨迹，R²达0.93。
Conclusion: ICL不需要注意力、深度或推理时突触可塑性：单个具有在线LMS动力学的隔室即足够。该发现挑战了现有对ICL架构复杂性的认知，并为生物合理SNN实现通用ICL提供了新路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AGVBench: A Reliability-Oriented Benchmark of Data Augmentation for Vein Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Vein recognition is a secure biometric technology often constrained by limited annotated data and imaging variations. While data augmentation mitigates this, strategies designed for natural images may disrupt the fine-grained topology and textures essential for identity discrimination. We present AGVBench, which evaluates 30 representative augmentation strategies on five public palm- and finger-vein datasets with seven backbone architectures, covering classic CNNs, vision transformers, and vein-specific recognition models. Our results show that multi-image mixing methods (e.g., MixUp, PuzzleMix, StarMixup) generally provide the strongest recognition performance. However, they are often poorly calibrated and vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, revealing a clear inconsistency between clean accuracy and adversarial security. We also find that severe geometric transformations frequently degrade recognition, which is potentially due to feature misalignment or spatial cropping, and that augmentation effectiveness varies across palm and finger vein datasets. These findings prove that accuracy-centric evaluation is insufficient for biometric augmentation. AGVBench provides standardized protocols to support reproducible research and guide the design of reliable, secure, and robust vein recognition systems. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/Advance-VeinTech-Innovators/AGVBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AGVBench基准，用于评估30种数据增强策略在5个公共掌静脉和指静脉数据集、7种骨干网络（包括CNN、视觉Transformer和静脉专用模型）上的表现。结果显示多图像混合方法（如MixUp、PuzzleMix、StarMixup）在识别性能上最优，但校准差且易受对抗扰动，而严重几何变换常降低性能，且增强效果在掌静脉和指静脉数据集间存在差异。
Motivation: 静脉识别受限于标注数据不足和成像变化，现有针对自然图像的增强策略可能破坏微细拓扑和纹理，而准确性评估不足以衡量增强的可靠性。
Method: 构建AGVBench基准，系统评估30种增强策略在多种数据集和骨干网络上的识别性能、校准性和对抗鲁棒性。
Result: 多图像混合方法识别性能最强，但校准差且对对抗扰动脆弱；严重几何变换常降低性能；增强效果在掌静脉和指静脉数据集间存在差异。
Conclusion: 准确性评估不足以指导生物特征增强，AGVBench提供标准化协议以支持可重复研究并设计可靠、安全的静脉识别系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AnyGroundBench: A Specialized-Domain Benchmark for Video Grounding in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated immense promise in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG). However, current evaluation protocols are largely confined to zero-shot assessments on general, daily-life benchmarks. This creates a critical disconnect from real-world applications in specialized fields, where models inevitably encounter rare visual concepts and complex spatio-temporal dynamics. Since exhaustive pre-training across infinite data distributions is infeasible, the ability to adapt to novel domains is essential. To bridge this gap, we introduce AnyGroundBench, a domain-adaptation benchmark designed to shift the STVG evaluation paradigm from static zero-shot testing to rigorous domain adaptation. Targeting five specialized domains (animal, industry, sports, surgery, and public security), AnyGroundBench pairs newly captured videos such as expert-annotated mouse behaviors with established datasets, unifying them through dense, high-fidelity spatio-temporal annotations. Crucially, the benchmark provides dedicated training subsets to systematically measure domain adaptability. We extensively evaluate 15 state-of-the-art VLMs, assessing their zero-shot generalization and In-Context Learning (ICL) capabilities under practical computational constraints. Ultimately, our findings reveal that current models fail in both zero-shot and ICL-based adaptation when confronted with specialized domains, exposing critical flaws in spatio-temporal reasoning that future research must address.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AnyGroundBench，一个面向专门领域的视频接地基准，旨在将时空视频接地（STVG）的评估从零样本转向领域适应。基准覆盖动物、工业、体育、手术和公共安全五个专业领域，提供新采集视频和高质量时空标注，并包含训练子集以衡量领域适应性。评估15个视觉-语言模型（VLM）后发现，当前模型在零样本和上下文学习（ICL）下均无法有效适应专业领域，暴露了时空推理的严重缺陷。
Motivation: 现有视频接地评估局限于零样本测试和通用日常基准，与专业领域实际应用脱节，而模型难以预训练覆盖所有数据分布，因此需要评估领域适应能力。
Method: 构建AnyGroundBench基准，包含五个专业领域（动物行为、工业、体育、手术、公共安全）的新视频和标注，统一提供密集时空标注，并设计训练子集用于系统测量领域适应性。
Result: 对15个最新视觉-语言模型的评估显示，在专业领域下，当前模型在零样本和基于上下文的适应中均失败，暴露出时空推理的关键缺陷。
Conclusion: 当前VLM在专业领域的视频接地任务上能力不足，未来研究需重点解决时空推理和领域适应问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HERMES: A Multi-Granularity Labeling Substrate for Pre-training Data Mixtures
papers.abstract_en: Most data-mixing methods assume the corpus has already been partitioned into groups, and the choice of those groups determines what a mixer can express. Existing labels, including provenance, topic or format taxonomies, and flat embedding clusters, commit to one semantic axis at one granularity; changing the resolution rebuilds the labels. We argue the bottleneck is the label system, not the mixer, and provide a hierarchical one. HERMES is a data-derived labeling substrate: a Learned Semantic Transform followed by 3-stage residual vector quantization annotates each document once into a coarse-to-fine code whose prefix length controls granularity up to approximately 130k cells. At coarse granularity HERMES sits at a plateau with KMeans-family methods on standard clustering metrics, so the contribution is the substrate, not the clusterer. On 1B-parameter, 25B-token pre-training, the hierarchy exposes an interaction fixed-granularity pipelines cannot test: at one prefix length, a combined Stage-2 rule contrast, equal-subbucket coverage versus size-proportional within-bucket quality top-30%, lifts a 16-task capability macro-average by +0.0253; at the next finer level, the same rule loses its measurable edge as candidate pools contract approximately 5x. HERMES reframes data mixture design from choosing among fixed label sets to navigating a reusable, data-derived granularity hierarchy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HERMES 是一种数据衍生的层次化标签基底，通过学习语义变换和三级残差向量量化，为每个文档生成粗到细的代码，支持从粗到细的粒度控制（约130k个单元）。在1B参数、25B token的预训练实验中，层次结构揭示了固定粒度方法无法测试的交互：在某一前缀长度下，组合规则提升16任务能力宏平均+0.0253，而在更细粒度下该优势消失。HERMES 将数据混合设计从选择固定标签集转向导航可复用的层次化粒度结构。
Motivation: 现有数据混合方法假设语料已被分组，且标签系统（如来源、主题、嵌入聚类）固定于单一语义轴和粒度，改变分辨率需重建标签。论文提出标签系统本身是瓶颈，而非混合器，需要层次化标签结构。
Method: HERMES 由两阶段组成：首先学习语义变换（Learned Semantic Transform），然后进行三级残差向量量化（3-stage residual vector quantization），每个文档被编码为一个粗到细的代码，前缀长度控制粒度。
Result: 在标准聚类指标上，粗粒度下的 HERMES 与 KMeans 族方法持平；在1B参数、25B token预训练中，层次结构显示：在某一前缀长度下，组合规则提升16任务能力宏平均+0.0253，而在更细粒度下候选池缩小约5倍，该优势消失。
Conclusion: HERMES 将数据混合设计从选择固定标签集重新定义为导航可复用的、数据衍生的粒度层次结构，并表明层次结构能揭示固定粒度管道无法测试的交互。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Memory for a long-horizon LLM agent is a contract about what each future decision is allowed to see. The simplest contract appends past observations, tool calls, and reflections to every prompt, which makes prior context easy to access but also turns it into a jumbled mixture in which the effect of any single memory component is hard to isolate. We introduce and instrument an alternative bounded contract: every decision is made from a fresh user message assembled by typed retrieval, with no raw cross-decision transcript appended. The prompt thus stays bounded across runs of any length, and any single layer can be ablated in isolation. We instantiate the contract in Slay the Spire 2, a closed-rule stochastic deck-building game whose runs require hundreds of tactical and strategic decisions. A public online benchmark of frontier LLMs on the same game reports zero wins at the lowest difficulty across five configurations, and the developer-reported human win rate at the same difficulty is 16%; the task is hard but not saturated. Within our harness, a fixed-A0 ablation shows the largest observed difference when triggered strategic skills are enabled: the no-store baseline wins 3/10 games and adding the skill layer 6/10. At this sample size the comparison is directional rather than statistically decisive (Fisher exact p\approx0.37); a cross-backbone probe and public accumulating-context baselines are reported as operational comparisons rather than controlled tests of the contract variable itself. We release a reproducible testbed: 298 completed trajectories with condition tags, frozen memory/skill snapshots, prompt records, and analysis scripts -- an agent design and a validated, reusable methodology for studying how explicit memory layers shape long-horizon LLM-agent decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgenticSTS，一种有限记忆测试平台，用于评估长周期LLM智能体。该平台通过类型化检索在每次决策时构建有限上下文，而非追加完整历史。在Slay the Spire 2游戏中，零样本LLM在最低难度下胜率为0%，而人类为16%。实验显示添加策略层后胜率从3/10提升至6/10，但统计上不显著。论文提供了可复现的基准测试环境。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体通过追加历史上下文形成长程记忆，导致混合难以隔离单一记忆效果。需要一种有界记忆契约来独立分析每个记忆层的作用。
Method: 提出有界记忆契约：每次决策使用类型化检索构建新用户消息，不跨决策追加原始转录。在Slay the Spire 2游戏中实现该测试平台，并支持逐层消融。
Result: 零样本LLM在最低难度下五轮胜率为0%，人类为16%。固定A0消融实验中，无存储基线胜率3/10，添加策略层后6/10（Fisher精确p≈0.37）。跨骨干网络和累积上下文基线作为操作比较。
Conclusion: 该测试平台提供298个轨迹、冻结记忆/技能快照等资源，是研究显式记忆层如何影响长周期LLM智能体决策的可重复方法论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ArcAD: Anomaly-Rectified Calibration for Cold-Start Supervised Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of Industrial Anomaly Detection (IAD) in real-world manufacturing frequently encounters a challenging cold-start bottleneck, in which limited normal samples fail to represent the full normal distribution and only a few anomalies are available. Under such a regime, existing methods struggle to form compact normal boundaries and fail to effectively exploit supervised signals from rare defects. To address this challenge, we propose Anomaly-Rectified Cold-start AD (ArcAD), a plug-and-play calibration framework for reconstruction-based IAD baselines. ArcAD follows a push-pull learning paradigm to construct a compact and discriminative normal boundary under data scarcity. On the one hand, ArcAD projects limited normal samples onto a hypersphere and pulls them into multiple compact clusters to maximize coverage of the normal manifold. On the other hand, it synthesizes pseudo-anomalies on the hypersphere and leverages real anomalies to push the boundary inward and sharpen anomaly discrimination. Extensive experiments on MVTec-AD, VisA, Real-IAD, and MANTA demonstrate that ArcAD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and unsupervised methods in both single-class and multi-class settings under cold-start conditions. Code is available at: https://github.com/LGC-AD/ArcAD.

papers.title: Aggregation with Exponential Weights is Optimal in Expectation
papers.abstract_en: The aggregation with exponential weights (AEW) estimator is not fully understood in the basic setting of model selection aggregation with squared loss. In particular, whether it is minimax-rate optimal in expectation for large enough fixed temperatures and under random design has been an open problem since its introduction, which was explicitly posed by Lecué and Mendelson (2013). In this paper, we settle this problem by showing that \emph{without} requiring a Bernstein-type assumption, the AEW indeed achieves the excess risk $T \log (M) / (n+1)$ in expectation, whenever the temperature $T$ satisfies $(L^2/T)\exp(B/T)\leq μ/2$. Here, the number of dictionary elements is $M$, the estimator has observed $n$ i.i.d. samples from any distribution, and the loss is assumed to be bounded by $B$, $L$-Lipschitz continuous and $μ$-strongly convex. For squared loss, we show that $T\geq 4 b^2$ suffices when the predictions and labels are $[0,b]$-valued. Because AEW is known to be suboptimal in expectation for temperatures below some constant, this shows that AEW has a sharp phase transition when the temperature is large enough but constant, as conjectured by Lecué and Mendelson.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文解决了聚合指数权重（AEW）估计器在平方损失下是否达到极小极大最优速率的长期开放问题。作者证明，在温度参数足够大时，AEW在期望意义上达到过量风险T log M/(n+1)，无需Bernstein型假设。对于平方损失，当预测和标签在[0,b]范围内时，T≥4b^2即可。这证实了AEW存在尖锐的相变。
Motivation: 自Lecué和Mendelson（2013）提出以来，AEW在模型选择聚合中在随机设计下是否期望极小极大最优一直未解决。
Method: 通过理论分析，在损失有界、L-Lipschitz连续且μ-强凸的条件下，推导出AEW期望风险的上界，并给出温度条件的显式表达。
Result: 证明了当温度T满足(L^2/T)exp(B/T)≤μ/2时，AEW的期望过量风险为T log M/(n+1)；对于平方损失，T≥4b^2即可。
Conclusion: 该结果填补了AEW理论空白，表明其在足够大但恒定的温度下存在尖锐相变，符合Lecué和Mendelson的猜想。

papers.title: Copewell: A Multi-Agent Swarm Architecture for Equitable Mental Wellness Support
papers.abstract_en: Mental health disorders affect nearly one billion people globally, yet 75% of individuals in low- and middle-income countries receive no treatment due to workforce shortages, cost barriers, and stigma. Current AI-powered wellness solutions predominantly rely on single-mode conversational interfaces that suffer high abandonment rates and fail to provide measurable, immediate relief calibrated to users' dynamic emotional states. This paper presents Copewell, a novel multi-agent swarm system designed to expand access to mental wellness support through human-centered AI principles. Our architecture introduces three technical innovations: (1) a multi-source assessment framework integrating self-reported, physiological, and contextual data to mitigate algorithmic bias; (2) valence-arousal emotion mapping using Russell's Circumplex Model of Affect to route users to specialized AI agents; and (3) dual-mode intervention delivery combining conversational support with evidence-based sensory wellness protocols. We examine the sociotechnical design considerations underlying Copewell's development, including a privacy-first architecture, embedded ethical oversight through a dedicated Ethics Supervisor agent, and participatory design informed by mental health practitioners. Early practitioner engagement and beta deployment inform design decisions and identify directions for future empirical evaluation. This work contributes to responsible AI discourse by demonstrating how technical architecture can operationalize equity and safety principles from inception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Copewell，一个多智能体群体系统，旨在通过以人为本的AI原则扩展心理健康支持的可及性。架构包括多源评估框架（整合自我报告、生理和情境数据）、基于Russell情感圆周模型的效价-唤醒情绪映射路由，以及结合对话支持和感官健康协议的双模式干预。论文还讨论了隐私优先架构、道德监督智能体及临床医生参与的设计考量。
Motivation: 全球近10亿人受心理健康障碍影响，但中低收入国家75%的患者因人力短缺、成本障碍和污名化无法接受治疗。现有AI解决方案主要依赖单一对话界面，放弃率高且无法根据动态情绪状态提供可测量的即时缓解。
Method: 提出三方面技术创新：1）多源评估框架整合自我报告、生理和情境数据以减少算法偏见；2）使用Russell的Circumplex情感模型进行效价-唤醒情绪映射，将用户路由至专门AI智能体；3）双模式干预：对话支持与基于证据的感觉健康协议相结合。系统还包括隐私优先架构、专用道德监督智能体以及由心理健康从业者参与的设计。
Result: 早期从业者参与和beta部署为设计决策提供信息，并确定了未来实证评估的方向。尚未报告定量结果。
Conclusion: 本文通过展示技术架构如何从初始阶段即可操作化公平和安全原则，为负责任AI讨论做出贡献。

papers.title: When Token Compression Breaks: Structural Pruning vs. Token Reduction for Robust ViT Segmentation under High Compression
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are strong backbones for semantic segmentation, but their computational cost limits deployment. Recent token compression methods for efficient transformer-based segmentation reduce this cost by decreasing the number of tokens. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on low-to-moderate compression, leaving their behavior under aggressive compression and corrupted inputs unclear. Meanwhile, structural pruning provides an orthogonal route to efficiency by removing redundant components in the ViT architecture, but is rarely compared to token compression under a unified protocol. To bridge this gap, we benchmark representative token compression and structural pruning methods for ViT-based semantic segmentation under matched FLOPs on ADE20K and Cityscapes, together with their common-corruption variants ADE20K-C and Cityscapes-C. Our results reveal a consistent trend on both clean and corrupted inputs: token compression is highly effective at mild reductions but degrades sharply when compression becomes severe, consistent with substantial information loss from overly aggressive token reduction. In contrast, structural pruning exhibits a smoother degradation curve and is more stable at high compression. Motivated by these findings, we study a prune-then-merge pipeline that applies moderate token compression on top of a moderately pruned backbone. At comparable FLOPs, this combined strategy consistently achieves a better accuracy-robustness trade-off at high compression, offering a practical recipe for deployment-oriented ViT segmentation. Code is available at https://github.com/phatnguyencs/vit-seg-compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了视觉Transformer（ViT）在语义分割中的两种高效化策略——token压缩与结构剪枝，在ADE20K和Cityscapes及其损坏变体上的表现。结果显示，token压缩在低压缩率下有效，但在高压缩率下性能急剧下降，而结构剪枝在高压缩率下表现更稳定。基于此，作者提出先剪枝后合并的流水线，在中等剪枝骨干上施加适度token压缩，实现了高压缩下准确率与鲁棒性的更好权衡。
Motivation: 现有token压缩方法主要在低至中等压缩率下评估，缺乏对高压缩和损坏输入下的行为研究；且结构剪枝作为另一种高效化路线，未在与token压缩统一的协议下进行比较。
Method: 在匹配FLOPs的条件下，对代表性token压缩方法和结构剪枝方法在ViT语义分割中进行基准测试，并设计先剪枝后合并的流水线：先对ViT进行中等结构剪枝，再应用适度的token压缩。
Result: 在ADE20K和Cityscapes及其损坏变体上，token压缩在轻度压缩时有效但高压缩时性能骤降；结构剪枝在高压缩时退化更平滑、更稳定。先剪枝后合并的策略在高压缩下取得更好的准确率-鲁棒性权衡。
Conclusion: 对于部署导向的ViT语义分割，结构剪枝在高压缩下优于token压缩，而两者结合的策略是一种高效的实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Challenges and Recommendations for LLMs-as-a-Judge in Multilingual Settings and Low-Resource Languages
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-Judge has become the dominant evaluation paradigm for many natural language generation tasks, due to shortcomings of conventional metrics and high correlations with human judgment, albeit mostly in English. There are now attempts to extend LLM-as-a-Judge to multilingual settings including low-resource languages. However, LLMs have limited proficiency in low-resource languages, and there is often no adequate human validation in these settings. To highlight the scope of the problem and current practices, we explore the use of LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators in ACL Anthology papers focusing on multilingual settings and low-resource languages across a diverse set of tasks. Out of 650 papers mentioning LLM-as-a-judge, only 33 of them focus on low-resource or multilingual settings. Our in-depth analysis of these papers indicates inconsistent evaluation outcomes, a tendency to overtrust LLM judgments in multilingual settings, and the widespread reliance on a single judge model per study. To help the NLP community further, we conclude with recommendations about how to use LLM-as-a-Judge in multilingual and low-resource settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文系统调查了LLM-as-a-Judge在多语言和低资源语言设置中的应用现状。在650篇提及LLM-as-a-Judge的ACL论文中，仅33篇关注多语言或低资源场景。深入分析发现评估结果不一致、对LLM判断过度信任以及多数研究仅依赖单个评判模型等问题。最后提出了改进建议。
Motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-Judge评估范式主要针对英语，扩展至多语言和低资源语言时面临LLM语言能力不足和缺乏人类验证的问题，亟需了解当前实践中的问题。
Method: 从ACL Anthology中筛选提及LLM-as-a-Judge的650篇论文，进一步聚焦其中33篇关注多语言或低资源场景的论文进行深入分析。
Result: 发现这些论文中评估结果不一致，普遍过度信任LLM在多语言环境中的判断，且大多数研究仅使用单一评判模型，缺乏交叉验证。
Conclusion: 为NLP社区提供了关于如何在多语言和低资源设置中更可靠地使用LLM-as-a-Judge的具体建议。

papers.title: Purified OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation Without Losing How to Think
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving LLM reasoning, where a privileged teacher with access to reference solutions provides token-level supervision on the student's own generated trajectories. However, we find that OPSD consistently fails on long chain-of-thought (long-CoT) reasoning models, yielding at best marginal gains while destabilizing the reflective reasoning capability these models depend on. Through a novel decomposition of the teacher's supervision signal, we identify the root cause: the teacher's supervision is dominated by a reference-induced component that drives rote memorization of reference-specific shortcuts, while the question-conditioned, inference-transferable component is ignored or actively opposed. Based on this diagnosis, we propose a two-step solution. First, we construct a reference-only teacher (the same model conditioned on the reference without the question) to isolate the non-transferable component of the supervision signal; the residual after subtracting this component captures the question-conditioned, inference-transferable correction. Second, we use pointwise mutual information (PMI) as the mechanism to transform this residual into a well-formed PMI target distribution that the student can directly distill from, filtering out the reference-induced shortcut. Experiments on four long-CoT models across two datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over both the base model and standard OPSD, while preserving the models' natural epistemic behavior throughout training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线自我蒸馏（OPSD）在长链思维推理模型中的失效问题。作者发现标准OPSD因教师信号中参考诱导成分主导，导致学生死记硬背参考捷径，而忽略推理可迁移成分。提出两步解决方案：构造仅参考教师分离非可迁移成分，并利用点互信息（PMI）构建蒸馏目标。实验表明，该方法在四个长链思维模型上持续优于基线和标准OPSD，同时保持模型自然的认知行为。
Motivation: 在线自我蒸馏在长链思维推理模型中几乎失效，甚至破坏模型的反思能力，需要理解其根本原因并提出改进。
Method: 通过分解教师监督信号，识别出参考诱导成分主导的问题。然后构造仅参考教师（不包含问题）来隔离非可迁移成分，用残差捕获可迁移修正，并使用点互信息（PMI）转化为蒸馏目标。
Result: 在四个长链思维模型和两个数据集上，该方法持续改进推理性能，优于基线和标准OPSD，且保留模型自然的认知行为。
Conclusion: 诊断了OPSD在长链推理中失败的根本原因，并提出了有效的净化方法，保留推理能力的同时避免死记硬背。

papers.title: Efficient Waste Sorting for Circular Economy: A Confidence-guided comparison between One-Vs-All and One-Vs-Rest Classification Strategies with Human-in-the-Loop for Automated Waste Sorting
papers.abstract_en: The complexity of waste disposal regulations across European countries poses significant challenges for the residents and hinders the transition to a Circular Economy. In Germany, the proper sorting and disposal of household waste remains challenging across municipalities. Consequently, substantially reducing incorrectly disposed waste is vital for improving waste management and advancing the Circular Economy. AI-based waste sorting solutions can support residents through user-friendly tools, such as mobile applications, that guide proper waste disposal. To be effective in supporting the Circular Economy, however, these solutions must be configurable to reflect the specific waste sorting scheme of individual municipalities in Germany. In the scope of this work, an evaluation and analysis are performed of two prominent classification strategies: OvA and OvR. The research uses a dataset constructed in alignment with the waste categories and sorting scheme of the city of Goslar in Germany. Moreover, this work aims to extend beyond the overall performance by examining the behavior of OvA and OvR classification strategies in identifying samples likely to be misclassified. These classification strategies are compared by applying varying confidence thresholds to identify uncertain samples for subsequent human review. This evaluation aims to balance the number of misclassifications against the human effort required for data annotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对德国垃圾分类法规复杂且各城市方案不同的挑战，对比One-Vs-All (OvA)和One-Vs-Rest (OvR)两种分类策略，使用Goslar市垃圾分类数据集，通过设置不同置信度阈值识别可能误分类的样本，并引入人工审查以平衡误分类率与人力成本。实验表明该方法有助于构建可配置的AI垃圾分类系统，支持循环经济。
Motivation: 欧洲各国垃圾分类法规复杂，德国各城市分类方案差异大，居民错误分类问题突出，阻碍循环经济转型。现有AI垃圾分类方案需适配特定城市规则，并在高准确率与人工标注成本之间取得平衡。
Method: 对比OvA和OvR两种多分类策略，在Goslar市垃圾分类数据集上训练，通过设定可变置信度阈值筛选不确定样本，将低置信度样本交由人工审查，以降低误分类率并控制人力投入。
Result: 摘要未提供具体性能数字，但通过分析两种策略在不同置信度阈值下的行为，评估了误分类数量与人工标注工作量之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 该置信度引导方法可根据特定城市的垃圾分类方案进行配置，通过平衡误分类与人力投入，提升AI垃圾分类系统的实用性和支持循环经济的潜力。

papers.title: CoFL-S: Spatially Queryable Sector Flow Fields for Local Language-Conditioned Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation has increasingly emphasized high-level instruction reasoning, memory, global map construction, and instruction decomposition, while the low-level action representation remains comparatively underexplored. We propose CoFL-S, a low-level vision-language-action framework that predicts a language-conditioned flow field over the robot's local visible sector and generates continuous trajectories by rolling out the predicted field. To train this low-level representation, we convert each VLN-CE episode, originally a whole-episode instruction paired with an action sequence, into frame-level local supervision with aligned sub-instructions and matched action, trajectory, and dense flow-field targets. For evaluation, we introduce a continuous-time Habitat benchmark that isolates low-level action interfaces from instruction decomposition and executes all methods through a shared velocity-command controller, enabling decomposition-independent closed-loop comparison across different planner frequencies rather than fixed discrete forward-and-turn transitions in VLN-CE. Under matched encoders and training settings, CoFL-S consistently outperforms action-token and action-chunk baselines across planner frequencies in the continuous-time Habitat benchmark, and zero-shot real-world closed-loop deployment further shows its advantage over both baselines beyond simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoFL-S 提出一种低层视觉-语言-动作框架，通过预测机器人局部可见扇区上的语言条件流场（flow field）并滚动生成连续轨迹。它将 VLN-CE 中的完整指令序列转换为帧级局部监督，并引入连续时间 Habitat 基准以隔离低层动作接口。实验表明，在相同编码器和训练设置下，CoFL-S 在不同规划频率下均优于动作 token 和动作 chunk 基线，并在零样本真实世界部署中展现出优势。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言导航研究多聚焦于高层指令推理、记忆与全局地图构建，而低层动作表示仍未被充分探索。
Method: 提出 CoFL-S，预测语言条件流场，通过滚动预测的流场生成连续轨迹；将每个 VLN-CE 片段转换为帧级局部监督，包含对齐的子指令和匹配的动作、轨迹及稠密流场目标。
Result: 在连续时间 Habitat 基准中，CoFL-S 在不同规划频率下均优于动作 token 和动作 chunk 基线；零样本真实世界闭环部署也表现出优势。
Conclusion: CoFL-S 提供了一种有效的低层动作表示框架，可提升导航性能并支持跨仿真与真实的迁移。

papers.title: DetailAnywhere: Fashion Detail Generation via Cross-Modal Feature Alignment Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based generative AI has achieved remarkable success in e-commerce applications such as virtual try-on, poster generation, and product background synthesis. However, when making online purchasing decisions for apparel, consumers also desire the freedom to examine specific detail regions of interest, such as collars, cuffs, and fabric textures, yet existing methods have not explicitly studied this setting. We therefore formalize a new, non-template task: Fashion Detail Generation with focus conditioning, and release FDBench, the first benchmark comprising 40K+ human-verified reference-detail pairs across 41 different categories. This task poses a unique semantic gap challenge: the model must bridge the correspondence between a focus marker on a product reference image and a photorealistic close-up view of the indicated region, while faithfully preserving the garment's identity, without any precise prompt. To bridge this gap, we propose Cross-modal Feature Alignment Distillation (CFAD), which leverages a fine-tuned DINOv3 teacher to align both branches of a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer in a shared semantic space via dual-branch distillation. To further improve consistency between generated details and reference images, we introduce a consistency reward model that jointly scores image pairs along three quality axes and optimizes generation via reinforcement learning. Experiments show that our model DetailAnywhere significantly outperforms all state-of-the-art opensource methods across all metrics and human evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个新的任务——时尚细节生成（Fashion Detail Generation），并构建了首个包含40K+人工验证参考-细节对的基准FDBench。针对如何将产品参考图像上的关注标记与指定区域的逼真特写视图对齐的问题，提出了跨模态特征对齐蒸馏（CFAD）方法，利用微调的DINOv3教师通过双分支蒸馏在共享语义空间中对齐扩散Transformer的两个分支，并引入一致性奖励模型通过强化学习优化生成。实验表明，DetailAnywhere在各项指标和人类评估上显著优于所有现有开源方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在虚拟试穿、海报生成等应用上表现良好，但消费者在购买服装时希望自由检查特定细节区域（如衣领、袖口、面料纹理），而现有方法未明确研究此问题。
Method: 提出CFAD（Cross-modal Feature Alignment Distillation），使用微调的DINOv3教师通过双分支蒸馏对齐多模态扩散Transformer的两个分支；同时引入一致性奖励模型，联合评分图像对在三个质量维度上的表现，并通过强化学习优化生成。
Result: DetailAnywhere在FDBench基准上显著优于所有开源方法，覆盖所有指标和人类评估。
Conclusion: 通过跨模态特征对齐蒸馏和一致性奖励模型，可以有效解决时尚细节生成中的语义鸿沟，实现逼真的细节生成并保持服装身份。

papers.title: Storm Track Self-Reinforcement Through Cloud Radiative Effects
papers.abstract_en: Traditionally, midlatitude storm tracks are viewed as being driven by meridional temperature gradients maintained by differential solar heating. Yet in the Southern Hemisphere, storm activity remains strong even when the summertime insolation gradient nearly vanishes. Here, we show that storm-track cloud radiative effects play a major role in maintaining the Southern Hemisphere storm activity. Satellite observations reveal that sunlight reflected by midlatitude clouds in early summer creates a substantial meridional gradient in surface heating, despite the nearly uniform summer insolation. Idealized aquaplanet simulations then show that shortwave cloud radiative effects reinforce meridional sea-surface temperature gradients, thereby strengthening storm activity primarily during late summer and autumn, while longwave cloud effects partly offset this response. To interpret these results, we develop a simple theoretical model linking storms, clouds, and sea-surface temperature gradients. The model reproduces the simulated seasonal response and identifies two emergent cloud properties that control the feedback strength: the maximum attainable cloud albedo and the sensitivity of cloud cover to storm activity. Together, these findings indicate that cloud radiative feedbacks are key to maintaining the thermal gradients that sustain storm activity. More broadly, they reveal a strong coupling among storms, clouds, and the ocean spanning distinct spatial and temporal scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过卫星观测和理想化水球模拟，发现中纬度云短波辐射效应在夏季日照梯度近乎消失时仍能维持南半球风暴活动，并建立了一个理论模型来量化云-海温-风暴反馈强度。
Motivation: 传统观点认为风暴路径由太阳加热驱动的经向温度梯度维持，但南半球夏季风暴活动在日照梯度很小时仍很强，这一矛盾需要解释。
Method: 使用卫星观测数据揭示云反射太阳光造成的经向表面加热梯度，结合理想化水球模拟（aquaplanet）分离短波和长波云辐射效应，并发展一个简化理论模型联系风暴、云和海温梯度。
Result: 短波云辐射效应增强了经向海温梯度，从而在夏末和秋季加强风暴活动，长波效应部分抵消该响应；理论模型再现了模拟的季节响应，并识别出控制反馈强度的两个云属性：最大云反照率和云覆盖对风暴活动的敏感性。
Conclusion: 云辐射反馈是维持驱动风暴活动的热力梯度的关键，揭示了风暴、云和海洋在不同时空尺度上的强耦合。

papers.title: An Additive MLP-GNN Framework for Characterizing Chemical and Structural Contributions to Aqueous Solubility
papers.abstract_en: Aqueous solubility is a key property in early-stage drug discovery, but most predictive models merge physicochemical descriptors and molecular graph information into a single representation, obscuring whether a prediction is driven by global chemistry, molecular structure, or both. We present an additive deep-learning framework that keeps these two sources of information separate throughout training: physicochemical descriptors are encoded by a multilayer perceptron (the chemical branch) and molecular graph topology by a graph neural network (the structural branch), with the two outputs combined only at the prediction stage through an additive model with an optional multiplicative interaction. This design provides a direct decomposition of chemical and structural components that can be examined separately after training. Furthermore, pretraining on the larger AqSolDB dataset and fine-tuning on the smaller BigSolDB2 dataset substantially improve accuracy and reduce run-to-run variations, indicating generalizability of the learned features from the data-rich settings. We further interpret the fitted model using best linear projections of the branch outputs, molecule-level embedding summaries across solubility classes, and atom-level GNNExplainer masks aggregated over functional groups. These analyses show that the chemical branch aligns with familiar physicochemical descriptors, while the structural branch captures graph-topological and functional-group patterns associated with solubility. Across both datasets, the framework attains competitive predictive performance while making the distinct roles of chemical and structural information more transparent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个加法MLP-GNN框架来预测水溶性，将物理化学描述符（化学分支）和分子图拓扑（结构分支）分开训练，仅在预测阶段通过加法模型组合。该设计允许对化学和结构贡献进行直接分解，并在AqSolDB预训练后微调至BigSolDB2获得更好性能。实验表明化学分支符合已知物理化学描述符，结构分支捕捉图拓扑和官能团模式，且预测性能竞争力强。
Motivation: 现有预测模型将物理化学描述符和分子图信息合并为单一表示，难以区分预测是由全局化学、分子结构还是两者共同驱动。需要可解释的分离模型来阐明不同来源的贡献。
Method: 设计加法深度学习框架：多层感知机编码物理化学描述符（化学分支），图神经网络编码分子图拓扑（结构分支），两分支输出在预测阶段通过加法模型（可选乘法交互）结合。在AqSolDB预训练后微调至BigSolDB2。
Result: 在AqSolDB和BigSolDB2上取得竞争性预测性能，预训练和微调显著提升精度并降低运行间变化。通过最佳线性投影、分子级嵌入总结和基于GNNExplainer的官能团掩码实现可解释性。

papers.title: Criticality-Based Guard Rail Validation for AI Agent Decisions in Autonomous Telecom Networks
papers.abstract_en: The evolution toward fully autonomous telecommunications networks (Autonomous Network Levels 4-5) requires AI/ML agents to make real-time network decisions without human intervention. However, no standardized runtime mechanism exists to intercept and validate individual inference outputs before they trigger live network state changes, creating risks of erroneous autonomous decisions. This paper proposes the Guard Rail Validation (GRV) framework, a standardizable runtime architecture for intercepting and validating AI-driven decisions before execution. The framework evaluates decisions across multiple weighted dimensions -- including action scope, action type, service criticality, agent autonomy level, reversibility, and temporal behavioural patterns -- to determine a criticality level. Based on this level, graduated validation mechanisms are applied: execute-with-logging, bounds checking, independent agent validation, or multi-agent consensus. The framework additionally provides cross-agent conflict detection with criticality-weighted priority resolution and runtime conformance logging for regulatory compliance (e.g., EU AI Act Article 14). We present the architecture, algorithmic procedures, O-RAN deployment model, and evaluate threat coverage against known AI/ML attacks in telecommunications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向自主电信网络（AN L4-L5）的Guard Rail Validation (GRV) 框架，用于在AI代理决策执行前拦截和验证，确保安全性与合规性。框架通过加权维度（动作范围、类型、服务关键性、自主水平、可逆性、时间行为模式）评估关键性，并应用分级验证机制，包括执行并记录、边界检查、独立代理验证或多代理共识。还提供跨代理冲突检测和运行时合规日志（符合EU AI Act）。摘要报告了架构、算法、O-RAN部署模型及对已知AI/ML攻击的威胁覆盖评估。
Motivation: 现有自主电信网络缺乏标准化的运行时机制来拦截和验证AI代理的推理输出，导致错误决策可能触发实时网络状态变更，带来风险。
Method: 提出GRV框架，包括多维度加权关键性评估（action scope、action type、service criticality、agent autonomy level、reversibility、temporal patterns），根据关键性分级的验证机制（execute-with-logging、bounds checking、independent agent validation、multi-agent consensus），以及跨代理冲突检测与关键性加权优先级解决。
Result: 摘要提供了GRV架构、算法流程、O-RAN部署模型，并评估了对已知电信AI/ML攻击（如对抗性攻击）的威胁覆盖。
Conclusion: GRV框架为自主电信网络提供可标准化的运行时决策验证，支持监管合规（EU AI Act），但摘要未提及具体实验性能或对比基线。

papers.title: MedSaab-US: A Backpropagation-Free Multi-Scale Wavelet-Saab Framework for Thyroid Nodule Segmentation in Ultrasound Images
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning (DL) methods dominate thyroid nodule segmentation in ultrasound (US) images, achieving high Dice scores but at the cost of millions of parameters, GPU-dependent training via backpropagation, and limited mathematical tractability. These limitations impede deployment in resource-constrained environments. In this paper, we propose MedSaab-US, a backpropagation-free segmentation framework grounded in the Green Learning paradigm. MedSaab-US extracts multi-scale spatial-frequency features by combining multi-level Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) with multi-scale channel-wise Saab (Subspace Approximation with Adjusted Bias) transforms at patch sizes of 5 x 5, 11 x 11, and 21 x 21 pixels. Label-Assisted Greedy (LAG) feature selection retains the most discriminative features, which are fed to an XGBoost classifier for pixel-wise prediction. The Saab transform parameters are determined analytically from data statistics, while XGBoost employs iterative greedy tree construction without requiring backpropagation. Evaluated on the TN3K dataset (2,879 training and 614 test images), MedSaab-US achieves a mean Dice coefficient of 0.4784 +/- 0.2190, precision of 0.5768, and recall of 0.5604, with a model footprint under 500K parameters and CPU-only inference in approximately 0.3 seconds per image. We present this result as an exploratory non-DL baseline for thyroid ultrasound segmentation and analyze the specific challenges posed by isoechoic nodules. An ablation study further quantifies the contribution of each pipeline component, including separate evaluations of LAG feature selection and training-set size.

papers.title: Prediction Sets for Counterfactual Decisions: Coverage, Optimality, and Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predictions are increasingly used to guide high-stakes decisions, from treatment selection to policy making. To ensure reliability with imperfect predictions, uncertainty quantification methods such as conformal prediction build prediction sets with coverage guarantees. However, statistical validity alone does not immediately determine the decisions to take, nor the optimality thereof. This gap is especially delicate in counterfactual settings where the outcome that materializes depends on the action taken, so uncertainty cannot be specified independently of the decision rule. We develop a decision-theoretic framework for uncertainty-informed counterfactual decisions. We identify a novel notion of \emph{policy-coupled coverage} -- namely, coverage of the realized outcome under the action induced by the prediction sets themselves -- as the optimal and lossless interface between uncertainty and action. It plays three roles. First, it justifies acting via a natural max-min rule as minimax-optimal under distributional ambiguity. Second, optimizing prediction sets under policy-coupled coverage is equivalent both to a stronger universal-coverage formulation and to the direct risk-averse optimization over policies and utility certificates; this equivalence yields the explicit form of the population-optimal prediction sets. Third, it admits a two-stage procedure, Policy-Coupled Risk-Averse Conformal Prediction (PC-RACP), that approximates these optimal sets with rigorous finite-sample coverage. Simulations and a real email-marketing experiment confirm that PC-RACP delivers higher utility than existing approaches while maintaining valid coverage, and that ignoring the counterfactual structure of the decision problem is suboptimal for both validity and utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个决策理论框架，用于反事实决策中的不确定性量化。核心概念是“策略耦合覆盖”，即预测集诱导的行动下实现结果的覆盖。该框架通过最大最小规则提供最小最大最优决策，并推导出总体最优预测集的显式形式。提出策略耦合风险厌恶共形预测（PC-RACP）两阶段程序，在有限样本下保证覆盖的同时提高效用。模拟和真实邮件营销实验验证了方法有效性。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法（如共形预测）仅提供覆盖保证，但无法直接指导最优决策。在反事实场景中，结果依赖于所采取的行动，因此不确定性不能独立于决策规则。需要一种将不确定性与行动最优结合的理论框架。
Method: 定义策略耦合覆盖作为不确定性与行动之间的最优接口。通过最大最小规则实现分布模糊下的最小最大最优决策。证明优化策略耦合覆盖的预测集等价于通用覆盖公式和直接风险厌恶优化。提出有限样本两阶段程序PC-RACP，近似最优集并保持覆盖。
Result: 模拟和真实邮件营销实验表明，PC-RACP相比现有方法在保持有效覆盖的同时提供更高效用。忽略反事实决策结构会导致效力和效用的次优。
Conclusion: 策略耦合覆盖是连接预测不确定性与反事实决策的正确接口。本文提供的理论框架和算法可推广到更多高风险决策场景。

papers.title: Self-explainable Operator Learning for Discovering Spatial Patterns in Functional Data
papers.abstract_en: Operator learning has emerged as a powerful tool for modeling complex physical systems in functional spaces. However, their neural network-based architectures make them opaque models, obscuring the reasoning behind their predictions. In this work, we introduce a self-explainable operator learning framework that overcomes this challenge by reformulating operator learning as a linear combination of generalized functional linear models expressed through integral equations. Exploiting the additive decomposability of these integral equations, we divide the input domain into subdomains and compute localized integrals to evaluate the contribution of each region to the final prediction. This decomposition enables direct interpretability where the model explains both inputs and outputs by linking specific input regions to corresponding output patterns, thereby revealing which spatial features drive predictions. We demonstrate the framework on function-to-scalar and function-to-function mappings in fluid flow problems involving blood flow and unsteady aerodynamics. The results show that the operator most often prioritizes regions with strong feature gradients, providing physically meaningful insight into the model's decision-making process. Comparisons with established post-hoc explainability methods demonstrate qualitative agreement while highlighting the key advantage of the proposed approach: explainability is embedded directly within the operator structure itself and does not require an external tool. Therefore, our framework provides a mathematically transparent and physically interpretable approach to uncover relationships within data, fostering trust in machine learning for scientific applications by enabling more informed data-driven analysis of physical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自可解释的算子学习框架，通过将算子学习重构为广义函数线性模型的线性组合（积分方程形式），利用积分方程的加性可分解性将输入域划分为子域，计算局部积分以评估每个区域对最终预测的贡献，从而实现输入输出双向解释。在血流和非定常空气动力学等流体问题的函数到标量/函数映射上验证，结果显示算子优先关注特征梯度大的区域，且可解释性内嵌于算子结构，无需外部工具。
Motivation: 现有算子学习模型（如神经网络）虽然能有效建模函数空间中的复杂物理系统，但内部机制不透明，难以解释预测依据。
Method: 将算子学习重新表述为广义函数线性模型的线性组合，通过积分方程表示；利用加性可分解性将输入域分块，计算各子域局部积分，直接量化每块区域对输出的贡献。
Result: 在血流和非定常空气动力学问题中，模型识别出特征梯度大的区域对预测贡献最大；与事后可解释方法定性一致，且该方法无需外部解释工具。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了数学上透明、物理上可解释的算子学习方式，有助于增强科学机器学习中的信任，但摘要未提及泛化性或计算开销等局限性。

papers.title: The Eticas AI Risk Taxonomy: Open Infrastructure for Operationalizing AI Audits
papers.abstract_en: The rapid deployment of AI systems across high-stakes domains has created urgent demand for standardized evaluation, yet the field remains fragmented across competing risk taxonomies that catalog risks without showing how an audit is executed. At least 74 AI risk taxonomies exist, and almost all stop at the catalog. The hard part of auditing is not naming a risk but operationalizing it: turning it into a test run against a real system, a measured value, a calibrated severity, and a defensible grade. This paper leads with that bridge. We present the operationalization layer Eticas has built and run, shown end to end on a single risk (PII leakage) against a public benchmark, and then the open taxonomy that makes the method scale. On GPT-4-0314, a disclosure risk that seven external frameworks require be controlled is measured at 0%, 51%, and 84% disclosure as adversarial conditioning increases, mapping through calibrated severity bands to a subcategory grade of E with a SYSTEMIC pattern. Around this example, the Eticas AI Risk Taxonomy v2.0.0 organizes 76 active subcategories across 10 categories and 20 sub-groups, with mappings to 18 external frameworks across compliance, reference, and academic tiers. Its category and sub-group layer is published under CC BY 4.0 as open semantic infrastructure with stable URIs and SKOS/JSON-LD distributions, and a worked subcategory example shows the operational layer down to its severity thresholds. The contribution is the demonstrated bridge from concept to graded finding, anchored by a clean separation of risks from the mechanisms by which they surface, and framed by an open-core model in which the conceptual scaffold is open and the methodology calibration is the practitioner layer. This is the infrastructure the AI auditing field needs: shared, open, and demonstrably operable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有AI风险分类法停留在风险目录阶段，缺乏操作化审计的方法。作者提出了Eticas AI风险分类法v2.0.0，包含操作化层，以PII泄露风险为例，在GPT-4-0314上演示了从风险到分级发现的完整流程，并提供了开放语义基础设施。该分类法包含10个类别、20个子组、76个活动子类别，映射到18个外部框架。
Motivation: 现有至少74种AI风险分类法，但几乎都止于风险目录，未能将风险转化为可执行的测试、测量值和可辩护的评级，导致审计难以标准化。
Method: 提出了一个操作化层，包括风险测试、测量、严重性校准和分级，并以PII泄露风险为例对GPT-4-0314进行端到端演示。分类法采用开放核心模型，概念层公开（CC BY 4.0），方法论校准作为实践层。
Result: 在GPT-4-0314上，随着对抗条件增强，PII泄露率从0%到51%再到84%，经过校准的严重性带映射到子类别E级和SYSTEMIC模式。
Conclusion: 论文贡献在于构建了从概念到分级发现的桥梁，明确区分风险与其表面化机制，为AI审计领域提供了共享、开放且可操作的基础设施。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fourier Preconditioning for Neural Feature Learning
papers.abstract_en: Mutual information (MI)-inspired feature learning techniques are capable of generating low-dimensional embeddings that retain nonlinear dependence structures, but direct estimations of MI suffer from noisy probability distribution estimates in the low-data regime. The H-Score objective, computed from second-order statistics, provides a practical proxy metric for training feature extraction networks. We prove that H-Score is invariant to invertible transformations in the unrestricted functional setting, but becomes sensitive to input basis rotations under constrained approximation classes. Consequently, we study unitary preconditioning for H-Score networks and show that selecting an appropriate basis rotation reduces finite-width truncation error by concentrating predictive dependence into fewer dominant modes. We identify the fast Fourier transform (FFT) as an effective data-independent, low-cost preconditioner for approximately stationary processes, where spectral structure induces concentration of the cross-covariance singular value spectrum. We introduce training-free metrics based on spectral entropy and cumulative dependence energy to quantify basis suitability and predict downstream inference gains prior to network training. Experiments across eight multivariate datasets demonstrate that FFT preconditioning is particularly useful in resource-constrained regimes, achieving up to 50% normalized mean squared error (NMSE) reduction, while the proposed metrics correlate with observed performance gains and correctly identify cases where spectral preconditioning is detrimental.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Signal Processing Letters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明H-Score目标在无约束函数设置下对可逆变换保持不变，但在约束近似类中对输入基旋转敏感。提出使用快速傅里叶变换（FFT）作为数据无关的低成本预条件器，通过集中预测依赖到少数主导模式来减少有限宽度截断误差。在八个多变量数据集上实验显示，FFT预条件在资源受限场景下可将归一化均方误差（NMSE）降低高达50%，并引入基于谱熵和累积依赖能量的免训练指标来评估基的适用性。
Motivation: 受互信息启发的特征学习技术能生成保留非线性依赖的低维嵌入，但直接估计互信息在低数据量下受噪声概率分布估计影响。H-Score作为基于二阶统计的代理目标，其性能受输入基旋转影响，需要有效的预条件策略。
Method: 从理论分析H-Score在可逆变换下的不变性及在约束近似类中对基旋转的敏感性出发，提出使用FFT作为数据无关、低成本的预条件器，并设计基于谱熵和累积依赖能量的免训练指标来量化基的适用性。
Result: 在八个多变量数据集上，FFT预条件在资源受限场景下实现高达50%的NMSE降低；提出的指标与观测到的性能增益相关，并能正确识别谱预条件失效的情况。
Conclusion: FFT预条件是一种有效的基旋转策略，能提升H-Score网络的特征学习效果，尤其是在数据有限或计算资源受限时。文中提出的免训练指标可提前预测预条件效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: What Types of Human-AI Teams Exist?
papers.abstract_en: Human-AI teaming has received increasing attention in the literature. However, the range of studies conducted in multiple domains make it difficult to understand what types of teams are being studied, and in what ways are they similar/different from one another. In this study, we analyse 53 papers on human-AI teams and categorise them into five main clusters based on psychological taxonomies of teaming; AI Assistant, Ad-hoc Dependency, Ad-hoc Forced Dependency, Paired Equanimity, and Group Equanimity. Each cluster represents a unique combination of holistic team-level characteristics, indicating there are multiple disparate team types studied under the same definition. In turn, this raises the question of whether insights are truly transferable between papers. We conclude with guidance on how to identify the types of human-AI teams studied, a checklist for reporting a human-AI team in research work, and ways in which the field can be further synthesised.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文系统回顾了人机协作团队的研究，对53篇论文进行聚类分析，基于团队心理学分类法归纳出五种团队类型：AI助手、临时依赖、临时强制依赖、配对平等和群体平等。作者指出当前研究在相同定义下研究多种不同的团队类型，质疑结论的可迁移性，并提供了识别和报告人机团队类型的指导。
Motivation: 现有关于人机协作团队的研究涉及多个领域，但缺乏对团队类型的系统分类，使得不同研究之间难以比较和借鉴。
Method: 对53篇人机协作论文进行系统性文献综述，基于心理学团队分类法进行聚类分析，划分出五个主要聚类：AI助手、临时依赖、临时强制依赖、配对平等和群体平等。
Result: 识别出五种不同的团队类型，每种类型具有独特的整体团队级特征，表明当前研究在相同标签下包含了多种异质团队类型，可能影响研究结论的可迁移性。
Conclusion: 提供了识别所研究的人机协作团队类型的指南，用于报告研究工作的清单，并讨论了进一步综合该领域的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Overview of Risk Assessment and Management for Intelligent Systems under the AI Act and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: The society and emerging risk-based regulatory frameworks for AI underscore the need for rigorous risk assessment to ensure safe and reliable AI systems. In response to this imperative, this paper presents an overview of AI risk assessment (identification and analysis) and management methodologies. It begins by reviewing the worldwide regulatory landscape that drives the need for systematic AI risk assessment. Then we characterize the spectrum of AI-related risks identified in the literature, from technical failures to ethical and social impacts. Subsequently, it reviews key risk assessment methodologies proposed for AI systems, focusing on general frameworks. The paper highlights best practices and illuminates methodological gaps, highlighting areas for further research on AI risk assessment.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Accepted at the IEEE International Carnahan Conference on Security Technology (ICCST 2026), October 14, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文概述了AI系统的风险评估与管理方法，回顾了全球基于风险的监管框架，描述了从技术故障到伦理社会影响的各类AI风险，并重点评审了通用的AI风险评估方法论。文章强调了最佳实践，指出了当前方法学上的空白，为未来研究提供了方向。
Motivation: 社会及新兴的基于风险的AI监管框架要求对AI系统进行严格的风险评估，以确保其安全可靠，但当前方法学尚不完善，亟需系统梳理。
Method: 本文通过文献综述的方式，梳理了全球AI监管环境，分类了AI相关风险谱系，并回顾了主要的AI风险评估方法论框架。
Result: 文章总结了AI风险评估的最佳实践，并指出了方法论上的空白，为后续研究提供了方向。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要进一步研究以完善AI风险评估方法，尤其针对现有框架的不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Resource Allocation with Continuous Random Consumption: Regret under Degeneracy
papers.abstract_en: We study online resource allocation when both rewards and consumption sizes may be continuously distributed. Requests arrive sequentially and must be accepted or rejected irrevocably under fixed resource capacities. Each request belongs to one of finitely many observable types; conditional on an observable request type, both the reward and the scalar size are random, and the realized size scales a fixed type-specific resource-consumption vector. The model allows the deterministic fluid relaxation to be degenerate. We show that additive regret is governed by the size-weighted mass of requests whose value-to-size ratios lie near the active acceptance cutoffs. We formalize this quantity through an active weighted-mass exponent p. When p > 1, this cutoff mass is thin, and the problem is genuinely hard: every online policy must incur regret of order at least $T^{1/2 - 1/(2p)}$, and this holds for every p > 1. A sample-path marginal policy matches this lower bound up to polylogarithmic factors; and when p = 1, so that the mass grows linearly near the cutoff, it attains $O((\log T)^2)$ regret. For example, if the size and the value-to-size ratio are independent and uniformly distributed, then p = 1; if instead the size and the reward are independent and uniformly distributed, then p = 2. Thus the policy achieves $o(\sqrt{T})$ regret throughout this regularity class without any fluid non-degeneracy assumption, allowing both primal degeneracy and dual non-uniqueness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究奖励和资源消耗量均连续分布的在线资源分配问题，允许确定性流体松弛退化。通过引入活跃加权质量指数 p 刻画启发式遗憾界，证明当 p>1 时任何在线策略必须至少达到 Ω(T^{1/2-1/(2p)}) 的遗憾，而样本路径边际策略可匹配该下界（至多对数因子）；当 p=1 时该策略实现 O((log T)^2) 遗憾。无需流体非退化假设。
Motivation: 现有在线资源分配研究常假设消耗量为确定性或离散分布，或要求流体松弛非退化。本文旨在处理连续随机消耗且容许退化的更一般情形，并给出紧的遗憾下界与上界。
Method: 提出基于样本路径边际（sample-path marginal）的在线策略，并利用活跃加权质量指数 p 量化靠近接受截止值的请求质量，进而推导遗憾界。
Result: 当 p>1 时，下界为 Ω(T^{1/2-1/(2p)})，策略匹配至多对数因子；当 p=1 时，策略达到 O((log T)^2) 遗憾。示例中独立均匀分布下，若 size 与 value-to-size 比独立则 p=1，若 size 与 reward 独立则 p=2。
Conclusion: 该策略在整个正则类上实现 o(√T) 遗憾，无需流体非退化假设，允许原始退化与对偶非唯一性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Optimisation Framework for the Well-Conditioned Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising route to solve partial differential equations, yet they have struggled to reach the precision of classical solvers. The obstacle is increasingly understood to be one of optimisation, owing to the severely ill-conditioned loss landscape. We present $\textbf{DSGNAR}$: Doubly-Sketched Gauss-Newton with Adaptive Ratio, a scalable second-order optimisation framework that confronts this ill-conditioning and, in doing so, obtains unprecedented accuracy and speed. $\textbf{DSGNAR}$ couples a doubly-sketched Gauss-Newton model with a novel strategy that carefully controls both regularisation and step length. Across a suite of problems spanning nonlinear, chaotic, multi-scale, high-dimensional, and Navier-Stokes, the framework greatly improves on the state of the art: able to attain relative $\ell_2$ errors as low as $3\times10^{-16}$ in double precision, improve contemporary results by five orders of magnitude on the canonical Burgers' equation, and as much as eight orders on a high-dimensional Poisson problem, while remaining markedly faster. We further show that, in single precision, solutions at the limit of round-off error can be obtained very quickly: Burgers' equation to $\ell_2^{\text{rel}} = 4.75 \times 10^{-7}$ in under ten seconds. The framework is also robust to the choice of architecture, arithmetic precision, and initial hyperparameters. The code is available at https://www.github.com/wephy/physics-informed-neural-networks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对物理信息神经网络（PINN）训练中损失景观严重病态导致优化困难的问题，提出 DSGNAR（Doubly-Sketched Gauss-Newton with Adaptive Ratio）二阶优化框架。该框架通过双重草图 Gauss-Newton 模型结合自适应正则化与步长控制，在非线性、混沌、多尺度、高维及 Navier-Stokes 等偏微分方程问题中实现前所未有的精度与速度。例如，双精度下相对 l2 误差可低至 3×10^{-16}，经典 Burgers 方程误差改进达 5 个数量级，高维 Poisson 问题改进达 8 个数量级。
Motivation: PINN 求解偏微分方程时，因损失景观严重病态（ill-conditioned）而难以达到传统数值求解器的精度，该障碍本质上源于优化困难。
Method: 提出 DSGNAR 框架，由双重草图 Gauss-Newton 模型与自适应比率策略组成，通过精细控制正则化与步长来应对病态。
Result: 在涵盖非线性、混沌、多尺度、高维及 Navier-Stokes 的问题集上大幅超越现有方法：双精度下相对 l2 误差达 3×10^{-16}，Burgers 方程结果改进 5 个数量级，高维 Poisson 问题改进 8 个数量级；单精度下 Burgers 方程可在 10 秒内达到 4.75×10^{-7} 误差。
Conclusion: 该框架对网络架构、算术精度与初始超参数选择均表现出鲁棒性，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 针对物理信息神经网络（PINN）训练中损失景观严重病态导致优化困难的问题，提出 DSGNAR（Doubly-Sketched Gauss-Newton with Adaptive Ratio）二阶优化框架。该框架通过双重草图 Gauss-Newton 模型结合自适应正则化与步长控制，在非线性、混沌、多尺度、高维及 Navier-Stokes 等偏微分方程问题中实现前所未有的精度与速度。例如，双精度下相对 l2 误差可低至 3×10^{-16}，经典 Burgers 方程误差改进达 5 个数量级，高维 Poisson 问题改进达 8 个数量级。
summary_sections.motivation: PINN 求解偏微分方程时，因损失景观严重病态（ill-conditioned）而难以达到传统数值求解器的精度，该障碍本质上源于优化困难。
summary_sections.method: 提出 DSGNAR 框架，由双重草图 Gauss-Newton 模型与自适应比率策略组成，通过精细控制正则化与步长来应对病态。
summary_sections.result: 在涵盖非线性、混沌、多尺度、高维及 Navier-Stokes 的问题集上大幅超越现有方法：双精度下相对 l2 误差达 3×10^{-16}，Burgers 方程结果改进 5 个数量级，高维 Poisson 问题改进 8 个数量级；单精度下 Burgers 方程可在 10 秒内达到 4.75×10^{-7} 误差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架对网络架构、算术精度与初始超参数选择均表现出鲁棒性，代码已开源。

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving and Verifiable Approximate Distributed Coded Computing
papers.abstract_en: Distributed machine learning enables collaborative model training without centralizing data, but it also exposes learning processes to privacy leakage and malicious manipulation. Existing defenses typically address these threats in isolation and are often tailored to specific learning paradigms or model architectures, limiting their applicability in realistic deployments. In particular, federated learning and decentralized learning exhibit distinct adversarial surfaces that are rarely addressed within a unified framework. In this paper, we present a model-agnostic framework for adversary-resistant distributed learning that jointly addresses privacy preservation and malicious behavior across both federated and decentralized settings. Our approach combines paradigm-specific defense mechanisms with GPBACC, a privacy-enhancing coded computing technique applicable to arbitrary machine learning models. For federated learning, we integrate robust aggregation strategies to mitigate the impact of malicious participants, while for decentralized learning we employ approximate decode-and-compare and group testing techniques to enable lightweight verification and adversary isolation without relying on a trusted aggregator. Crucially, we evaluate the proposed framework through an explicit, attack-driven analysis. We implement representative privacy attacks and malicious behaviors, and empirically demonstrate that the combination of GPBACC with robust aggregation and verification mechanisms significantly reduces privacy leakage and improves resilience against active adversaries. These results suggest that privacy-enhancing coded computing, when combined with appropriate adversary-resistance strategies, provides a practical and deployable foundation for secure distributed machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个与模型无关的对抗鲁棒分布式学习框架，联合解决隐私保护和恶意行为检测问题，适用于联邦学习和去中心化学习两种场景。该框架结合了范式特定的防御机制和GPBACC（一种适用于任意机器学习模型的隐私增强编码计算技术），并通过攻击驱动的实验验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有分布式学习防御方法通常孤立地处理隐私泄露或恶意操纵，且多针对特定学习范式或模型架构，缺乏统一框架。联邦学习和去中心化学习面临不同的对抗面，很少被统一处理。
Method: 提出一个模型无关的对抗鲁棒分布式学习框架，包含：1）针对联邦学习采用鲁棒聚合策略；2）针对去中心化学习采用近似解码比较和群组测试技术实现轻量级验证和恶意节点隔离；3）结合GPBACC隐私增强编码计算技术，该技术适用于任意机器学习模型。
Result: 通过攻击驱动分析，实证表明GPBACC与鲁棒聚合和验证机制的组合能显著降低隐私泄露并提高对主动攻击的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 隐私增强编码计算与适当的对抗鲁棒策略结合，为安全分布式机器学习提供了实用且可部署的基础。

papers.title: UA-ChatDev: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Agent Collaboration for Reliable Software Development
papers.abstract_en: Software development is a complex task that demands cooperation among agents with diverse roles. Large language models (LLMs) have enabled autonomous multi-agent software development frameworks that leverage role-based collaboration to automate requirements analysis, coding, testing, and refinement. However, existing approaches typically assume that intermediate agent outputs are equally reliable, leaving them vulnerable to hallucination propagation, where incorrect decisions generated in early development phases are transferred to downstream agents and negatively impact final software quality. To address this challenge, we propose UA-ChatDev, an uncertainty-aware multi-agent software development framework that integrates uncertainty quantification into agent interactions. It introduces a lightweight uncertainty estimation mechanism based on token-level log probabilities to assess the confidence of agent responses and employs phase-aware threshold calibration to selectively trigger retrieval-based verification when uncertainty exceeds acceptable levels. Extensive experiments on the SRDD benchmark demonstrate that UA-ChatDev consistently outperforms existing single-agent and multi-agent software development frameworks across completeness, executability, consistency, and overall quality metrics. Further ablation studies and communication analyses verify that uncertainty-aware interactions enhance code execution reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UA-ChatDev，一种不确定性感知的多智能体软件协作开发框架，通过集成token级对数概率的轻量级不确定性估计和阶段感知阈值校准，触发检索验证以减少幻觉传播。在SRDD基准上的实验表明，该方法在完整性、可执行性、一致性和整体质量上优于现有单智能体和多智能体框架。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体软件开发框架假设中间智能体输出同等可靠，易受幻觉传播影响，早期阶段的错误决策会传递给下游智能体，损害最终软件质量。
Method: 提出不确定性感知的多智能体框架UA-ChatDev，包括基于token级对数概率的轻量级不确定性估计机制和阶段感知阈值校准，当不确定性超过阈值时触发基于检索的验证。
Result: 在SRDD基准上，UA-ChatDev在完整性、可执行性、一致性和整体质量指标上一致优于现有单智能体和多智能体软件开发框架；消融和通信分析验证了不确定性感知交互提升了代码执行可靠性。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知的多智能体协作可有效缓解幻觉传播，提升软件开发的可靠性。

papers.title: RadiomicNet: A Hybrid Radiomics-Guided Lightweight Architecture for Interpretable Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has achieved remarkable performance in medical image segmentation, yet it suffers from critical limitations: mathematical intractability, substantial parameter requirements, and lack of clinical interpretability. We propose RadiomicNet, a novel two-stream hybrid architecture that enhances standard deep learning by integrating handcrafted radiomics features directly into the segmentation learning process. The key contribution is the Radiomics Attention Gate (RAG), which leverages Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) and Local Binary Pattern (LBP) features to modulate skip-connection attention in a lightweight MobileNetV2-based encoder-decoder, providing ante-hoc interpretability without post-hoc approximations. A novel Radiomics Consistency Loss further enforces alignment between texture complexity and prediction uncertainty, reducing Expected Calibration Error (ECE) from 0.142 to 0.118. RadiomicNet achieves a Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 0.763 +/- 0.231 on the Breast Ultrasound Images (BUSI) dataset and 0.854 +/- 0.112 on Kvasir-SEG, outperforming U-KAN by 1.2% and 1.8%, respectively (p < 0.05, Wilcoxon signed-rank test), with only 3.27M parameters, 9.5x fewer than standard U-Net and 4.3x fewer than U-KAN. Gradient-based feature importance analysis reveals that GLCM dissimilarity (15.24%), GLCM energy (14.56%), and LBP entropy (11.49%) are the dominant radiomics cues, providing clinically meaningful explanations for segmentation decisions. The proposed approach demonstrates that compact, interpretable models grounded in domain knowledge can deliver state-of-the-art segmentation performance with substantially reduced computational overhead.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IEEE ICIP 2026 LBDL 2 Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RadiomicNet，一种融合手工放射组学特征（GLCM、LBP）与深度学习的轻量级双流分割架构，通过放射组学注意力门（RAG）提供 ante-hoc 可解释性，并引入放射组学一致性损失校准预测不确定性。在 BUSI 和 Kvasir-SEG 数据集上，RadiomicNet 以 3.27M 参数（比 U-Net 少 9.5 倍）取得优于 U-KAN 的 Dice 系数（分别提升 1.2% 和 1.8%），同时将期望校准误差（ECE）从 0.142 降至 0.118。
Motivation: 深度学习在医学图像分割中性能优异，但存在数学不可解释性、参数需求大、缺乏临床可解释性等关键限制。
Method: 提出双流混合架构，在 MobileNetV2 编码器-解码器中集成基于 GLCM 和 LBP 的放射组学注意力门（RAG）以调节跳跃连接注意力，并设计放射组学一致性损失，强制纹理复杂度与预测不确定性对齐。
Result: 在 BUSI 数据集上 DSC 为 0.763±0.231，在 Kvasir-SEG 上为 0.854±0.112，优于 U-KAN（p<0.05）；参数仅 3.27M，比 U-Net 少 9.5 倍；ECE 从 0.142 降至 0.118。GLCM 不相似性（15.24%）、GLCM 能量（14.56%）和 LBP 熵（11.49%）是主要放射组学线索。
Conclusion: 基于领域知识的紧凑、可解释模型可以在大幅降低计算开销的同时实现最先进的分割性能。

papers.title: Bayesian Sparse Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Model Uncertainty Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable reasoning capabilities, but their task-specific fine-tuning is notoriously plagued by overconfidence, severely hindering trustworthy deployment. We propose Data-Adaptive Lower-Rank Adaptation (DALorRA), a simple and effective variational Bayesian sparse framework that shifts the paradigm of uncertainty quantification from the dense parameter space to the lightweight rank level of low-rank adaptation (LoRA). With the insight that LoRA essentially aggregates multiple rank-one components that may provide superfluous model capacity, DALorRA imposes stochastic masking on rank dimensions, enabling Bayesian regularization of model capacity during training and ensemble-like calibration during inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate DALorRA's excellent calibration of LLMs without compromising reasoning accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DALorRA，一种变分贝叶斯稀疏框架，用于大语言模型不确定性估计，通过在低秩适配（LoRA）的秩维度上施加随机掩码，实现贝叶斯正则化和校准，实验表明校准效果好而不损害推理精度。
Motivation: LLM微调时过度自信，阻碍可信部署。现有不确定性量化方法通常关注密集参数空间，效率低。
Method: 提出数据自适应低秩适配（DALorRA），在LoRA的秩维度上施加随机掩码，在训练时进行贝叶斯正则化，推理时集成校准。
Result: 实验表明DALorRA显著提升LLM的校准性能，且不影响推理准确性。
Conclusion: 该方法将不确定性量化从密集参数空间转移到轻量级秩级别，简单有效。

papers.title: A rubric-based controlled comparison of frontier language models on expert-authored clinical reasoning tasks
papers.abstract_en: Multiple-choice medical benchmarks are increasingly saturated, and recent rubric-based evaluations such as HealthBench have shown that open-ended clinical performance is far from solved - its "Hard" subset top score remains 32%. We present a small, deliberately difficult evaluation dataset of five clinician-authored clinical scenarios spanning four specialties (anaesthesia, internal/family medicine, emergency medicine, and obstetrics), each accompanied by an atomic, weighted, MECE rubric (25-62 criteria per task; 184 criteria total) authored from a clinician-drafted golden answer. We evaluate three frontier models: GPT 5.4, Claude Opus 4.7, and Gemini 3.1 Pro. Mean rubric pass rates were 0.47 (Claude), 0.39 (GPT), and 0.37 (Gemini). The central finding is an inversion of clinical priority: the highest-weighted (weight-5, critical) criteria passed at only 32.4-41.7%, while low-stakes weight-1 criteria passed at 80-90%. 56 of 108 critical (weight-5) criteria (52%) were satisfied by no model. Three LLM autoraters reproduced expert met/not-met labels on 92.8-94.7% of 552 graded criteria. We position this as a methods-and-preliminary-findings contribution: the five tasks demonstrate a scalable, defensible pipeline ready to develop into a large-scale benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对临床推理评估中选择题基准饱和的问题，提出了一个由临床专家设计的小规模、高难度开放式评估数据集（5个场景，184条原子化加权评分标准），并评测了GPT 5.4、Claude Opus 4.7和Gemini 3.1 Pro三个前沿模型。结果显示，最高权重关键标准的通过率仅32.4-41.7%，而低权重标准通过率达80-90%，存在严重的临床优先级反转现象。作者将其定位为方法和初步发现贡献，旨在发展为大规摸基准。
Motivation: 现有的选择题式医学基准趋于饱和，而像HealthBench这样的评分式评估显示开放式临床表现远未解决（其“困难”子集最高分仅32%），亟需更具挑战性和细粒度的评估方法来衡量模型的实际临床能力。
Method: 由临床医生编写五个涵盖四个专科的临床场景，并为每个场景制定原子化、加权、MECE（相互独立、完全穷尽）的评分标准（共184条），使用这些标准对GPT 5.4、Claude Opus 4.7和Gemini 3.1 Pro三个前沿模型进行人工评分，同时用三个LLM自动评分器复现专家判断。
Result: Claude Opus 4.7平均通过率最高（0.47），GPT 5.4为0.39，Gemini 3.1 Pro为0.37；关键权重（权重5）的标准通过率仅32.4-41.7%，而低权重（权重1）标准通过率达80-90%；108条关键标准中56条（52%）未被任何模型满足；三个LLM自动评分器在552条标准上准确率92.8-94.7%。
Conclusion: 当前前沿模型在临床推理中表现出明显的优先级反转，即忽视关键临床线索而过多关注次要细节。本文提供的方法和初步结果展示了可扩展、可辩护的评估流水线，可作为开发大规模临床推理基准的基础。

summary_sections.result: Claude Opus 4.7平均通过率最高（0.47），GPT 5.4为0.39，Gemini 3.1 Pro为0.37；关键权重（权重5）的标准通过率仅32.4-41.7%，而低权重（权重1）标准通过率达80-90%；108条关键标准中56条（52%）未被任何模型满足；三个LLM自动评分器在552条标准上准确率92.8-94.7%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前前沿模型在临床推理中表现出明显的优先级反转，即忽视关键临床线索而过多关注次要细节。本文提供的方法和初步结果展示了可扩展、可辩护的评估流水线，可作为开发大规模临床推理基准的基础。

papers.title: Conformal Bayes for Two-Sided Censored Gaussian Regression under Label Shift
papers.abstract_en: Prediction under label shift becomes nonstandard when responses are censored. In a two-sided censored Gaussian model, latent values below $L$ and above $U$ are recorded at the boundary values, so the observed predictive distribution is mixed, with atoms at $L$ and $U$ and a continuous density on $(L,U)$. In this paper we develop conformal Bayes for this mixed-space setting by combining posterior predictive tilting with weighted conformal calibration. Under a two-sided Tobit Gaussian Bayesian prediction head with a Laplace posterior approximation, the tilted predictive distribution has left-atom, interior, and right-atom components, with a three-term closed-form normalizer. The resulting prediction set is a mixed highest density region that can combine boundary atoms with an interior interval and can reduce to atom-only sets under strong censoring. The main technical issue is that latent label shift does not directly give an ordinary density ratio on the observed censored scale. A latent exponential tilt induces tail-averaged atom weights at the censored boundaries, while the interior ratio remains density based. This yields a mixed observed-space calibration weight with two atom ratios and one interior density ratio. The weight corrects the calibration measure, while predictive tilting gives target-adapted mixed-HDR geometry. Synthetic experiments show that weighted tilted conformal Bayes restores marginal coverage with smaller sets than weighted source-score calibration, while revealing a trade-off between marginal coverage and component-wise behavior across atoms and interior observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对标签偏移下双侧删失高斯回归的预测问题，提出共形贝叶斯方法。通过结合后验预测倾斜和加权共形校准，在混合空间（边界原子和内部连续密度）中构建预测集。方法利用潜在指数倾斜导出观测尺度上的混合校准权重，合成实验显示该方法恢复了边际覆盖，且集合小于加权源评分校准。
Motivation: 当响应变量被删失时，标签偏移下的预测变得非标准。现有方法无法直接处理双侧删失高斯模型中观测预测分布的混合性质（边界原子和内部连续密度）。
Method: 提出共形贝叶斯方法，使用后验预测倾斜和加权共形校准。在双侧Tobit高斯贝叶斯预测头下，通过拉普拉斯后验近似得到倾斜后的预测分布（左原子、内部和右原子分量），并给出三部分闭式归一化因子。利用潜在指数倾斜推导混合观测空间校准权重（两个原子比率和一个内部密度比率），用于修正校准测度。
Result: 合成实验表明，加权倾斜共形贝叶斯恢复了边际覆盖，且预测集比加权源评分校准更小。同时揭示了边际覆盖与原子及内部观测分量行为之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 该方法在混合空间（边界原子与内部区间）中构建共形预测集，可适应强删失下的原子集合。摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: Dynamic Neural Graph Encoding of Inference Processes in Deep Weight Space
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancements in using neural networks as implicit data representations have attracted significant interest in developing machine learning methods that analyze and process the weight spaces of other neural networks. However, efficiently handling these highdimensional weight spaces remains challenging. Existing methods often overlook the sequential nature of layer-by-layer processing in neural network inference. In this work, we propose a novel approach using dynamic graphs to represent neural network parameters, capturing the temporal dynamics of inference. Our Dynamic Neural Graph Encoder (DNG-Encoder) processes these graphs, preserving the sequential nature of neural processing. Additionally, we also leverage DNG-Encoder to develop INR2JLS (Implicit Neural Representation to Joint Latent Space) for facilitate downstream applications, such as classifying Implicit Neural Representations (INRs). Our approach demonstrates significant improvements across multiple tasks, surpassing the state-of-the-art INR classification accuracy by approximately 10% on the CIFAR-100-INR.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态神经图编码器（DNG-Encoder），将神经网络参数表示为动态图，捕捉推理过程中的时间动态，并在隐式神经表示（INR）分类等任务上显著提升性能。
Motivation: 现有权重空间处理方法常忽略神经网络逐层推理的序列性，导致高维权重空间处理效率低且性能受限。
Method: 构建动态图表示神经网络参数，设计DNG-Encoder处理这些图以保留序列处理特性，并基于此开发INR2JLS框架用于下游任务如INR分类。
Result: 在CIFAR-100-INR数据集上，INR分类准确率相比现有最优方法提升约10%。
Conclusion: 方法有效保留了推理过程的时序特性，在权重空间分析中取得显著改进，但未提及泛化到其他任务或规模限制。

papers.title: Mathematical Exploration of Earth Gravitational Field Impact on Seasonal Wind Flux in a Tropical Region
papers.abstract_en: The Earth's gravitational field exerts a significant influence on atmospheric dynamics, including the behavior of seasonal wind flux, defined by periodic variations in wind speed and direction. While temperature gradients and Earth's rotation are established drivers of wind patterns, the role of gravitational forces in modulating these processes remains poorly understood. This study investigates the mathematical relationship between gravitational variations and seasonal wind flux in Nigeria, a region of pronounced climatic variability and varied wind patterns. Utilizing Navier-Stokes equations for atmospheric dynamics, Fourier decomposition for seasonal wind flux analysis, and Pearson correlation coefficients for gravitational-wind interactions, we analyze 2010-2020 meteorological data, alongside gravitational field measurements from the GRACE (Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment) satellite. Results show significant annual fluctuations in average wind speed (5.1-5.6 m/s) and gravitational variations (9.60-9.95 mGal), with an inverse relationship observed in certain years, suggesting a coupling between atmospheric dynamics and gravitational forces. Seasonal wind flux exhibits a distinct sinusoidal pattern, peaking mid-year and declining toward year-end, consistent with Nigeria's monsoon climate. Correlation coefficients between gravitational variations and wind flux range from 0.79 to 0.87, indicating a strong positive relationship. These findings underscore the importance of gravitational forces in modulating wind patterns and highlight the potential for integrating gravitational data into climate models, thereby enhancing accuracy of weather forecasting and renewable energy planning. This study provides a foundational framework for further exploration of gravitational influences on atmospheric processes, with implications for global climate science and sustainable energy strategies.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用2010-2020年尼日利亚气象数据和GRACE卫星重力测量，通过Navier-Stokes方程、傅里叶分解和皮尔逊相关系数，研究地球重力场对季节性风通量的影响。结果显示平均风速（5.1-5.6 m/s）和重力变化（9.60-9.95 mGal）存在显著年际波动，且两者相关系数高达0.79-0.87，表明强正相关关系。
Motivation: 虽然温度梯度和地球自转已被认为是风的主要驱动因素，但重力在调节风过程中的作用尚不明确。本研究旨在揭示重力变化与季节性风通量之间的数学关系。
Method: 采用Navier-Stokes方程描述大气动力学，傅里叶分解分析季节性风通量，皮尔逊相关系数量化重力与风的相互作用，并使用GRACE卫星重力数据。
Result: 风速和重力均呈现年际波动，两者在特定年份呈负相关，整体相关系数在0.79至0.87之间，表明强正相关。季节性风通量呈正弦模式，年中达到峰值。
Conclusion: 重力对风模式有重要调节作用，将重力数据纳入气候模型可提高天气预报和可再生能源规划的准确性。本文为重力对大气过程的影响提供了基础框架。
Relevance: 30
