papers.title: NeoMap: Training-free Novel-View Synthesis from Single Images and Videos
papers.abstract_en: We study the challenging problem of novel view video synthesis from single images or monocular videos. Existing methods, which operate under the assumption that pre-trained video models lack native novel view synthesis capability and enforce view alignment via camera conditioning, task-specific fine-tuning, or stepwise hard denoising guidance, often suffer from artifacts and compromised global scene consistency. In this paper, we introduce NeoMap, a novel training-free framework designed to locate high-fidelity, view-consistent novel view solutions from general pre-trained video models. The key to our approach is the core insight that promising novel view solutions are inherently encoded within the natural video data manifold learned by pre-trained models, and the core challenge is simply to locate this optimal solution. We solve this via our core mechanism: convergent manifold alternating projection iterations that optimize the initial noise. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeoMap significantly outperforms all existing methods across 3 standard novel view synthesis benchmarks, including the challenging Tanks-and-Temples, LLFF and DAVIS datasets, achieving state-of-the-art generation fidelity and top-tier view consistency.
papers.comment: ECCV 2026. Jinxi and Tianyi are co-first authors. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/vLAR-group/NeoMap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeoMap是一个无需训练的新颖视图合成框架，利用预训练视频模型的内在视频数据流形，通过收敛的流形交替投影迭代（convergent manifold alternating projection iterations）优化初始噪声，从而定位高保真、视图一致的解。在Tanks-and-Temples、LLFF和DAVIS三个标准基准上，NeoMap显著优于所有现有方法，达到最先进的生成保真度和视图一致性。
Motivation: 现有方法在相机条件、任务微调或逐步去噪指导下常产生伪影，且全局场景一致性差。
Method: 提出无需训练的框架，核心机制是收敛的流形交替投影迭代，通过优化初始噪声在预训练模型的视频数据流形中定位最优解。

papers.title: Inverse Suitability: Identifying Condition Difficulty and Rider Skill from Behavioural Outcomes via Continuous-Item Response Theory
papers.abstract_en: Suitability scoring for outdoor activities (kitesurfing, paragliding, ski touring) maps environmental conditions to a go/no-go verdict via expert-defined curves. These curves conflate two distinct quantities: the intrinsic difficulty of a condition and the skill of the person facing it. We introduce Inverse Suitability, a continuous-item Item Response Theory (IRT) model that identifies both from behavioural outcomes alone. Each outcome is a triple (rider r, condition metric x at site s, binary outcome y); we model P(y=1) = sigma(a (theta_r - delta(x, s))), where theta_r is latent rider skill, delta(x, s) is a latent difficulty function anchored to a physics-derived expert curve as its prior, and a is a discrimination parameter. The formulation is strictly more general than a single suitability curve, which it recovers exactly when skill is integrated out under the population distribution. Parameters are estimated by marginal maximum likelihood with Gauss-Hermite quadrature; identification holds when the rider-by-condition incidence graph is connected, with a documented single-curve fallback otherwise. We validate via synthetic recovery: on a reference cohort (80 riders times 30 outcomes) the model recovers latent skill at r = 0.96, locates the difficulty minimum within 3 units of ground truth, and improves held-out Brier Skill Score by +0.33 over the expert-curve baseline. The recovered difficulty function defines a measurable, site-level construct, an intrinsic difficulty atlas, that existing meteorological observation networks do not capture. All results reproduce from a single command on synthetic data, requiring no proprietary observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出逆适用性（Inverse Suitability）模型，基于连续项目反应理论（IRT）从行为结果中同时识别户外活动（如风筝冲浪、滑翔伞）的条件难度和参与者技能。模型将物理专家曲线作为先验，通过边际最大似然估计参数，在合成数据上恢复潜在技能相关系数0.96，并提升Brier技能得分0.33。
Motivation: 现有适用性评分曲线将条件内在难度和参与者技能混为一谈，无法区分二者，导致对实际风险和能力评估不准确。
Method: 采用连续项目IRT模型，定义条件难度函数（以物理专家曲线为先验），骑手技能和区分度为潜在参数，通过Gauss-Hermite求积的边际最大似然法估计，需保证骑手-条件遭遇图连通。
Result: 在合成参考队列（80骑手×30结果）上，模型恢复潜在技能相关系数为0.96，困难最小值位置误差在3个单位内，相比专家曲线基线，保留外Brier技能得分提升0.33。
Conclusion: 模型可构建可测量的站点级内在难度地图，补充现有气象观测网络无法捕获的信息；但需要连通性条件，否则回退为单一曲线。

papers.title: Autorelevance function and other feature relevance measures for univariate time series
papers.abstract_en: We propose a model agnostic methodology to measure lag relevance in machine learning forecasting models applied to univariate time series. Particularly, we are working in the context of time series using the frameworks of Ghost variables and Shapley values, together with additive importance measures, to introduce the auto-relevance and partial auto-relevance functions as the lag importance values. Additionally, we propose a novel method to replace absent features in coalition based methods with a one step forecast from the same model. We evaluate these proposals under different simulations and real data cases. This combined framework perspective is particularly suitable for time series. In addition, to show our discoveries we use a pull of models from the seasonal ARMA family and recurrent neural networks. We found that the calculated relevance measures successfully demonstrate the expected lag structure in almost all cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模型无关的方法来度量单变量时间序列中滞后项的重要性，基于幽灵变量 (Ghost variables) 和 Shapley 值框架，引入自相关函数 (auto-relevance function) 和偏自相关函数 (partial auto-relevance function)。同时提出了一种新颖的方法来替代基于联盟的方法中缺失的特征，即使用同一模型的一步预测。在模拟和真实数据案例中，使用季节性 ARMA 和循环神经网络模型验证了该方法。
Motivation: 现有时序特征重要性度量方法多针对多变量情况或特定模型，缺乏模型无关且能捕捉滞后结构的统一框架。
Method: 结合幽灵变量和 Shapley 值，定义自相关和偏自相关函数作为滞后重要性度量；对于联盟方法中缺失的特征，用模型的一步预测进行填充。
Result: 在模拟数据和真实数据上，使用季节性 ARMA 和循环神经网络模型，所提方法在几乎所有情况下成功展示了预期的滞后结构。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种模型无关的滞后重要性度量，特别适用于单变量时间序列的机器学习预测模型。
Relevance: 65

papers.title: A More Accurate Algorithm Comparison through A/B Testing using Offline Evaluation Methods
papers.abstract_en: A/B testing is the gold standard for selecting the better algorithm in online services. While offline evaluation has attracted attention as a safer alternative due to the high experimental costs and the potential risk of degrading user experience and revenue in A/B testing, it is widely recognized that the estimation accuracy of offline evaluation is substantially lower. As a result, final selection decisions are typically made through A/B testing. Contrary to this conventional view, we reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon in which A/B testing can produce a higher algorithm selection error rate than offline evaluation. This occurs because the sample mean estimator used in A/B testing does not induce positive correlation, which is crucial for reducing critical selection errors, namely underestimating the truly superior algorithm and overestimating the truly inferior one. In contrast, offline evaluation methods unintentionally generate this beneficial correlation by relying on shared offline data when estimating and comparing the performance of multiple algorithms. Building on this insight, we propose an estimator that intentionally induces positive correlation to improve algorithm selection in A/B testing. The key idea is to introduce a hypothetical middle algorithm and to estimate the performance difference between algorithms A, M, and B in a stepwise manner using shared data at each step. This approach enables the application of offline evaluation techniques in each step, thereby inducing positive correlation and reducing critical selection errors. Furthermore, we derive the optimal middle algorithm regarding the resulting variance and analyze its advantages over existing methods through bias-variance analysis. Experiments on real-world data demonstrate that our estimator achieves the same selection error rate as existing approaches while using only one half of the A/B testing data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了传统观点，发现A/B测试可能比离线评估产生更高的算法选择错误率，原因是A/B测试的样本均值估计不能诱导正相关性，而离线评估通过共享数据无意中产生了这种有益的相关性。作者提出一种估计器，通过引入虚拟中间算法并分步共享数据来主动诱导正相关，从而减少关键选择错误。实验表明，该估计器使用一半的A/B测试数据即可达到与现有方法相同的选择错误率。
Motivation: A/B测试是算法选择的黄金标准，但成本高且可能损害用户体验；离线评估更安全但估计精度低，通常仅用于最终决策前的辅助。然而，本文发现A/B测试可能比离线评估产生更高的错误率，这一反直觉现象源于其估计器缺乏正相关性，导致低估优质算法、高估劣质算法的关键错误。
Method: 提出一种在A/B测试中主动诱导正相关性的估计器：引入一个虚拟中间算法M，通过分步使用共享数据估计A与M、M与B的性能差异，从而将离线评估技术应用于每一步，最终得到A与B的差异估计。作者还推导了最优中间算法的方差特性，并通过偏差-方差分析与传统方法对比。
Result: 在真实世界数据上的实验表明，所提估计器使用一半的A/B测试数据即可达到与现有方法相同的选择错误率。
Conclusion: 本文揭示并利用了A/B测试与离线评估中相关性差异的现象，提出一种更高效的算法选择方法，可减少所需实验数据量。

papers.title: Personalized 4D Whole-Heart Mesh Reconstruction from Cine MRI via Multi-Scale Temporal Modeling and Differentiable Contour Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 4D whole-heart mesh reconstruction from sparse cine MRI is critical for creating cardiac digital twins, but remains challenging due to limited 2D slice coverage and the complex coupling between cardiac shape and motion. Existing methods often rely on intermediate contour fitting and typically reconstruct static, single-phase, or partial cardiac geometries, limiting their ability to capture full-chamber dynamics. We propose a novel end-to-end framework for reconstructing temporally resolved whole-heart meshes from multi-view 2D cine MRI sequences by learning an image-to-mesh mapping. The framework incorporates a differentiable contour renderer inspired by the Beer-Lambert attenuation principle, enabling anatomy-aware supervision of 3D+t mesh deformation through contour-based projection losses. To improve temporal consistency across the cardiac cycle, we further introduce a multi-scale temporal modeling module that integrates global cycle-level dynamics with local inter-frame coherence to generate smooth and physiologically plausible mesh trajectories. The proposed method achieved a whole-heart mean absolute error of 1.68 $\pm$ 0.31 mm and a motion jitter of 0.77 $\pm$ 0.17 $\mathrm{mm}/\mathrm{frame}^{3}$, outperforming existing methods with lower reconstruction error and substantially improved motion smoothness. It also improved 2D contour alignment across multiple cine MRI views and supported downstream proof-of-concept electrophysiological simulation. The code will be released publicly upon acceptance of the manuscript for publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个端到端框架，从稀疏Cine MRI序列重建个性化4D全心房网格，通过可微分的轮廓渲染器（基于Beer-Lambert原理）和多尺度时间建模模块，实现解剖感知监督和时空一致性，在指标上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法通常依赖中间轮廓拟合，只能重建静态、单相位或部分心脏几何，难以捕捉全腔室动态，且稀疏切片覆盖限制了准确性。
Method: 框架包括一个可微分轮廓渲染器（基于Beer-Lambert衰减原理）用于轮廓投影损失监督，以及一个多尺度时间建模模块（整合全局周期级动态与局部帧间一致性）生成平滑网格轨迹。
Result: 全心房平均绝对误差1.68±0.31 mm，运动抖动0.77±0.17 mm/frame³，重建误差更低，运动平滑性显著提升，并改进了多视图Cine MRI的2D轮廓对齐。
Conclusion: 方法在心电生理仿真等下游任务中具有潜力，代码将在录用后公开。

papers.title: Robust for the Wrong Reasons: The Representational Geometry of LLM Robustness to Science Skepticism
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly consulted on contested scientific questions, raising the concern that they will sycophantically retreat from established consensus when a user signals doubt -- drifting toward a false balance that treats settled science as one view among several. We test this across three open instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B), three consensus-science domains (climate, vaccines, evolution), and single- and multi-turn settings, combining behavioral measurement with linear probing and activation patching. We do not observe sycophantic retreat. Instead, models show three distinct policies under the same skeptical pressure: reactive assertion, where consensus assertion increases rather than decreases (Llama); surface hedging, where tone softens while the position holds (Qwen); and non-response (Mistral). Pairwise judgments confirm the reactive shift is stance, not style (63.6%, p=.007), and a decomposition identifies increased consensus assertion, not false balance, as its driver (beta=+0.042 per dose, p<1e-77). Linear probes localize the divergence to middle layers -- perfect separation in Llama and Qwen versus 72% in Mistral, with non-overlapping confidence intervals -- indicating the non-responsive model does not linearly represent the skepticism signal at all. Crucially, this robustness does not transfer: it attenuates across domains and, in the safety-critical vaccine domain, can reverse, with myth-rebuttal weakening under skeptical pressure. We synthesize these into a four-way taxonomy separating active from accidental robustness, and argue that behavioral evaluation alone cannot distinguish a model that resists skepticism because it understands the signal from one that only appears to resist because it fails to perceive it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型在科学争议问题上的行为，发现模型并未表现出迎合用户怀疑的趋同倾向，而是呈现三种不同策略：反应性断言、表面模糊处理和无响应。鲁棒性不会跨领域转移，且在疫苗安全领域可能反转。
Motivation: LLM在用户对科学共识提出质疑时，可能会虚假平衡地将已确立的科学观点降为众多观点之一，这种趋同行为将侵蚀公众对科学的信任。
Method: 通过行为测量、线性探针和激活修补，在三种指令微调模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B）上测试对气候、疫苗、进化三个科学领域的怀疑压力，包括单轮和多轮对话设置。
Result: 未观察到趋同退让。Llama表现为反应性断言（共识断言增加），Qwen为表面模糊处理（语气软化但立场不变），Mistral无响应。对反应性断言的分解表明驱动因素是共识断言增加而非虚假平衡。线性探针定位差异在中间层，无响应模型完全不线性表示怀疑信号。鲁棒性不会跨领域转移，在疫苗领域甚至可能反转。
Conclusion: 行为评估无法区分模型是真正理解怀疑信号而抵抗，还是仅仅因为感知不到信号而看似抵抗。需要结合表示分析。

summary_sections.conclusion: 行为评估无法区分模型是真正理解怀疑信号而抵抗，还是仅仅因为感知不到信号而看似抵抗。需要结合表示分析。

papers.title: LiZAD: A Lightweight Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection Framework for Industrial Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: In modern high-throughput industrial production lines, product configurations and visual characteristics frequently change, making it impractical to collect and annotate data for every new scenario. This dynamic setting makes Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection (ZSAD) particularly suitable, as it enables defect detection without requiring training on target-specific samples. Although recent ZSAD approaches show promising results, they are computationally intensive and thus unsuitable for deployment on resource-constrained devices. We propose LiZAD: a lightweight framework designed for real-time ZSAD specifically tailored for use on edge devices. The proposed approach pairs the dense and spatially aware visual features of DINOv3, crucial for precise pixel-level localization, with the highly computationally efficient text embeddings of MobileCLIP2. These features are then mapped into a shared latent space via low-memory trainable projection heads. Compared to six state-of-the-art ZSAD models, LiZAD achieves an average memory reduction of 61.5%, a parameter reduction of 74.6%, and a speedup of 3.02x in terms of latency. Despite substantial reductions in computational and memory costs, our approach maintains competitive anomaly detection performance, dropping the average P-AUROC by just 6.4% relative to the best state-of-the-art model across the VisA, BTAD, MPDD, and MVTec-AD datasets. Finally, it is successfully deployed on the NVIDIA Jetson NX and Jetson AGX edge devices and tested on the real production line of the Industrial Computer Engineering Laboratory (ICE Lab) at the University of Verona. The code is available at https://github.com/intelligolabs/LiZAD.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Omni-Layer Intelligent Systems (COINS) 2026

papers.title: Statistical Properties of $k$-means Clustering for Data Missing Completely at Random
papers.abstract_en: The classical $k$-means clustering cannot be directly used to incomplete data, and existing $k$-means-based clustering for missing data primarily focus on improving the practical accuracy of clustering, whereas most of them lack theoretical guarantees in the asymptotic sense. In this paper, we investigate the statistical properties of $k$-means clustering in the presence of missing data. We first establish the $\sqrt{n}$-excess risk bound and prove the consistency of the estimated cluster centers under general missing mechanisms. For the Missing Completely at Random (MCAR) mechanism, we further derive the $\sqrt{n}$-convergence rate and asymptotic normality of the estimated cluster centers. Moreover, we study in what cases the cluster centers estimated by incomplete data converge to the true cluster centers of original fully observed data, and give a sufficient condition about the missing probability and the separation among true clusters. These results provide a theoretical guarantee for missing-data-$k$-means. Notably, our analysis reveal that under MCAR mechanism, both achieving the $\sqrt{n}$-rate and converging to the true cluster centers require $k$ true centers to be distinct in every dimension, highlighting the significant challenges of application in high-dimensional regimes. Finally, we conduct numerical simulations on synthetic incomplete datasets to support our theoretical analysis results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了缺失数据下k-means聚类的统计性质，建立了在一般缺失机制下的√n-超额风险界和聚类中心估计的相合性，并针对完全随机缺失（MCAR）机制推导了√n-收敛速率和渐近正态性，给出了不完全数据估计的聚类中心收敛到真实聚类中心的条件。
Motivation: 现有缺失数据k-means聚类方法缺乏渐近理论保证，本文旨在填补这一空白，为缺失数据下的k-means聚类提供严格的统计理论基础。
Method: 基于经验风险最小化框架，建立了缺失数据下k-means的有限样本超额风险界，并利用经验过程理论推导了估计量的收敛性质。
Result: 在MCAR机制下，聚类中心估计达到√n-收敛速率且具有渐近正态性，但实现这一速率要求真实聚类中心在每个维度上均不同，揭示了高维应用的挑战。
Conclusion: 本文为缺失数据下的k-means聚类提供了理论支撑，但高维条件下聚类中心估计的收敛要求严格，实际应用需谨慎。

papers.title: Hybrid quantum-classical neural network for sentiment analysis
papers.abstract_en: Quantum machine learning has recently emerged as a promising paradigm that leverages the expressive power of quantum circuits to address complex learning tasks. In this work, we investigate the applicability of hybrid quantum-classical neural networks to sentiment analysis, a central problem in natural language processing. We focus on a dataset of tweets related to COVID-19, where the textual content is vectorized using TF-IDF and fed into both classical feedforward networks and hybrid architectures incorporating parameterized quantum circuits. Our results show that hybrid models can achieve accuracy comparable to the classical baseline, while exhibiting distinct learning dynamics, especially in terms of validation loss and accuracy, that suggest a richer representational capacity. Moreover, when applying transfer learning to an SMS spam classification task, the hybrid models consistently outperform the classical counterpart, achieving an accuracy increase of 15 percentage points (from 66% to 81%) on the spam class, demonstrating enhanced generalization. These findings highlight the feasibility of employing QML for natural language processing and point toward the potential advantages of hybrid models as quantum hardware continues to advance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了混合量子-经典神经网络在情感分析中的应用，使用TF-IDF向量化的COVID-19推文数据集。混合模型在准确性上与经典基线相当，但展现出不同的学习动态；在迁移学习到SMS垃圾邮件分类时，混合模型在垃圾邮件类别上准确率从66%提升至81%，证明其更强的泛化能力。
Motivation: 量子机器学习在复杂学习任务中具有潜力，但尚未在情感分析这一NLP核心任务中得到充分验证。
Method: 采用TF-IDF将推文文本向量化，分别输入经典前馈网络和融合参数化量子电路的混合架构中进行训练和比较。
Result: 在COVID-19推文数据集上，混合模型准确率与经典基线持平；在迁移至SMS垃圾邮件分类时，混合模型在垃圾邮件类别的准确率从66%提升至81%。
Conclusion: 混合量子-经典模型在NLP任务中具有可行性，尤其在高泛化需求场景下可能优于纯经典模型，未来随着量子硬件进步潜力更大。

papers.title: Atomic Task Graph: A Unified Framework for Agentic Planning and Execution
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents have shown strong potential for solving complex multi-step tasks, yet existing performance improvements often rely on either scaling to larger backbone models or task-specific fine-tuning. The former incurs substantial computational costs, while the latter typically generalizes poorly across different tasks. Although prompt-based control is training-free and broadly applicable, existing methods still leave input-output dependencies between subtasks implicit in textual trajectories, making verified intermediate results difficult to reuse. To address these limitations, we propose Atomic Task Graph (ATG), a unified control framework for planning and execution. Specifically, ATG maintains an explicit graph to expose dependencies and support reuse. During planning, it recursively decomposes a high-level task into subtasks, forming a sequence of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) whose evolution can be traced. During execution, the dependencies exposed by ATG allow independent branches to be executed in parallel, thereby improving execution efficiency. When failures are detected, ATG leverages the graph evolution history to localize the error source and repair only the affected region, preserving validated regions unchanged. Experiments show that ATG consistently outperforms strong baselines in success rate and execution efficiency across three interactive benchmarks using only 7B-8B backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出原子任务图（Atomic Task Graph, ATG），一种统一的LLM智能体规划与执行控制框架。ATG通过维护显式有向无环图（DAG）来暴露子任务间的依赖关系，支持并行执行和失败局部修复。在三个交互式基准测试中，使用7B-8B大小的骨干模型，ATG在成功率和执行效率上一致优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体性能提升依赖大模型规模或任务微调，前者计算成本高，后者泛化差；基于提示的方法虽免训练但隐式依赖难以复用。需一种训练免费、通用且支持验证结果复用的控制框架。
Method: 提出Atomic Task Graph (ATG) 框架，规划阶段递归分解高层任务为子任务，形成可追踪演化的DAG序列；执行阶段根据显式依赖并行执行独立分支，检测到失败时利用图演化历史定位错误源并仅修复受影响区域。
Result: 在三个交互基准上，使用7B-8B骨干模型，ATG在成功率和执行效率上一致优于强基线。
Conclusion: ATG通过显式依赖图支持并行执行和局部修复，为LLM智能体提供了一种统一、高效且泛化的规划与执行框架。

papers.title: Conditional Co-Ablation: Recovering Self-Repair Backups in Transformer Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability often relies on component-level interventions to discover how a model produces a behavior. This guides attribution, capability knockout, and model pruning downstream to operate by scoring each unit by the effect of ablation in isolation. Such first-order scoring is natural when component importance is additive, but becomes misleading when a transformer self-repairs: after a primary component is removed, a dormant backup can take over, muting the primary's measured effect while the backup itself appears irrelevant on the intact model. We recast this failure as a recovery task, conditional circuit completion, and introduce Conditional Co-Ablation (CoAx), a label-free, output-grounded score that asks how much each remaining unit's ablation effect grows once a primary set has been removed. This conditional growth exposes the second-order interaction that single-unit scores discard. On the GPT-2-small IOI circuit, CoAx raises backup-head recovery from 0.33 to 0.91 ROC-AUC, outperforming all baselines, including self-repair-aware gradient scores (best 0.82); counterfactual patching verifies that the recovered heads causally carry the repair. The same label-free procedure transfers to induction across eight models. Beyond discovery, the recovered backups correct self-repair-masked attribution, identify the components required for capability knockout, and yield repair-aware structured pruning scaling from 124M to 7B. Component importance is therefore not merely an isolated-unit property: in robust circuits, the components that matter can become visible only under the interventions that make them necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Transformer电路机械可解释性中自修复（self-repair）现象导致单组件消融评分失效的问题，提出条件共消融（Conditional Co-Ablation, CoAx）方法。该方法通过测量在移除主要组件后剩余组件消融效应的增长，暴露被掩盖的二阶交互作用。在GPT-2-small IOI电路上，CoAx将备份头恢复的ROC-AUC从0.33提升至0.91，优于所有基线，包括自修复感知梯度分数（最佳0.82）。反事实修补验证了恢复的头部因果性地承担修复任务。该方法无需标签，可迁移至八种模型的归纳任务，并支持从1.24亿到70亿参数的修剪。
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法依赖单组件消融评分，但在Transformer自修复场景下，移除主要组件后备份组件会接管，导致主要组件效果被低估，而备份组件在完整模型中看似无关，造成误导。
Method: 提出条件共消融（CoAx）分数，通过条件电路补全任务，计算在移除主要组件后每个剩余单元消融效应的增长量，从而揭示单组件评分忽略的二阶交互。
Result: 在GPT-2-small IOI电路上，CoAx恢复备份头的ROC-AUC达0.91，优于自修复感知梯度分数（0.82）等基线。反事实修补验证了因果修复。该方法无需标签，可迁移至八种模型的归纳任务，并支持从1.24亿到70亿参数的修复感知结构化修剪。
Conclusion: 组件重要性不是孤立的单元属性：在鲁棒电路中，重要的组件只有在使其变得必要的干预下才可见。CoAx能够纠正自修复掩盖的归因，识别能力击倒所需的组件，并实现修复感知的修剪。

papers.title: PhysMani: Physics-principled 3D World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Manipulating fast and dynamically moving targets in unstructured 3D environments remains challenging for embodied AI. Existing visual-language-action models and world models struggle with accurate 3D geometry and physically meaningful forecasting. We propose PhysMani, a framework that couples a physics-principled 3D Gaussian world model with a future-aware action policy model. The world model learns a divergence-free Gaussian velocity field via online optimization for fast and physically grounded future dynamics prediction. The policy model integrates the predicted 3D scene future dynamics through a learnable token based cross-attention module. We introduce PhysMani-Bench, a dynamic manipulation benchmark with 16 tasks, and demonstrate a superior success rate over strong baselines in both simulation and real-world robot experiments.
papers.comment: ECCV 2026. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/vLAR-group/PhysMani
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysMani，一个物理原型的 3D 高斯世界模型 (physics-principled 3D Gaussian world model) 与未来感知动作策略模型相结合的框架，用于在非结构化环境中操纵快速动态移动的目标。世界模型通过在线优化学习无散度高斯速度场，实现物理合理且快速的未来动态预测。策略模型通过可学习 token 的交叉注意力模块整合预测的 3D 场景未来动态。作者还提出包含 16 个任务的动态操作基准 PhysMani-Bench，在仿真和真实机器人实验中取得了优于强基线的成功率。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型和世界模型在非结构化 3D 环境中难以准确预测动态目标的几何和物理运动，导致操纵快速移动目标效果不佳。
Method: 提出一个耦合物理原型的 3D 高斯世界模型与未来感知动作策略模型的框架。世界模型通过在线优化学习无散度高斯速度场进行物理驱动的前向预测；策略模型通过可学习 token 的交叉注意力模块融合预测的未来 3D 动态信息。
Result: 在提出的包含 16 个任务的动态操作基准 PhysMani-Bench 上，以及在仿真和真实机器人实验中，PhysMani 相比强基线取得了显著更高的成功率。
Conclusion: 将物理原型的 3D 高斯世界模型与未来感知策略结合，能够有效提升动态目标操纵的成功率。代码和数据已开源。

papers.title: CausalSteward: An Agentic Divide-Conquer-Combine Copilot for Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Learning causal models from high-dimensional data is a significant challenge, particularly in real-world settings where violations of core assumptions lead to causal identifiability issues. Although massive amounts of prior knowledge are available, and contain valuable causal information, effectively integrating this knowledge into the causal discovery process remains an open problem. We introduce CausalSTeward (CAST), a novel human-in-the-loop framework for interactively assembling large causal models. CausalSteward is a multi-agent collaborative system that tackles high-dimensional causality through a divide-and-conquer approach where large clusters of variables are iteratively partitioned and then separately analyzed. Our framework fuses prior knowledge with a data-driven approach by using tailored tools such as retrieval augmented generation and conditional independence tests. Finally, we use this work to examine the capabilities and limitations of causal reasoning in multi-agent frameworks, and how the human-in-the-loop can contribute to accurate and trustworthy results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CausalSTeward（CAST），一个多智能体协作框架，用于从高维数据中交互式组装大规模因果模型。框架采用分治策略，迭代划分变量簇并分别分析，融合先验知识与数据驱动方法，如检索增强生成和条件独立性检验。
Motivation: 从高维数据学习因果模型面临挑战，尤其是现实世界中核心假设违例导致因果可识别性问题。大量先验知识可用，但有效整合进因果发现过程仍是开放问题。
Method: 提出人类参与的CausalSTeward框架，多智能体协作系统，通过分治方法将变量大簇迭代划分并单独分析，使用检索增强生成和条件独立性检验等工具融合先验知识与数据驱动方法。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果。
Conclusion: 该工作考察了多智能体框架中因果推理的能力与局限性，以及人类参与如何贡献于准确可信的结果。

papers.title: A-TMA: Decoupling State-Aware Memory Failures in Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long term memory lets LLM agents act as persistent assistants, but user facts change. A useful memory system must know what is true now, what used to be true, and what changed. We study \emph{ghost memory}, a state coordination failure in which old, current, and transition facts coexist in the memory bank, remain mixed during retrieval, and mislead the answer model. We argue that memory systems should be understood and optimized from three levels: bank maintenance, retrieval, and answer time resolution. We propose ATMA, a state aware overlay for existing memory systems. ATMA keeps superseded and transition records in the bank, builds evidence packets for the query's requested state view, and exposes current, historical, and transition labels to QA. We further call for decoupled evaluation of bank, retrieval, and answer level failures, since final QA accuracy can hide where ghost memory occurs. To make this failure measurable, we build LTP (LoCoMo Temporal Plus), a conflict heavy benchmark for ghost memory, and evaluate on LoCoMo for long conversation generalization. On LTP, Graphiti+ATMA improves conflict accuracy by 0.240 absolute over Graphiti. On LoCoMo, Graphiti+ATMA raises temporal F1 from 0.0295 to 0.1705. The gains are host dependent, but they indicate that explicit state roles can reduce memory failures hidden by final QA accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长期记忆系统中由于事实变更导致的“鬼影记忆”（ghost memory）问题，即旧、当前和过渡事实共存且混淆。提出ATMA状态感知覆盖层，通过构建证据包并赋予当前、历史和过渡标签来消除混淆，并建立冲突丰富的基准LTP用于评估。在LTP上，Graphiti+ATMA提升冲突准确率0.240；在LoCoMo上，时间F1从0.0295提升至0.1705。
Motivation: 长期记忆系统需追踪事实变更，但现有系统易出现状态协调故障（鬼影记忆），不同时间状态的事实共存且误导答案模型，影响智能体可靠性。
Method: 提出ATMA状态感知覆盖层，维护被取代和过渡记录，为查询构造证据包，并显式标注当前、历史和过渡标签；同时设计解耦评估框架，分别衡量银行维护、检索和回答层面的故障。
Result: 在LTP基准上，Graphiti+ATMA将冲突准确率绝对提升0.240；在LoCoMo上，时间F1从0.0295升至0.1705。增益依赖于宿主系统，但表明显式状态角色可减少最终QA准确率掩盖的记忆故障。
Conclusion: 作者强调记忆系统应从银行维护、检索和回答三个层面解耦优化，ATMA证明显式状态标签能有效缓解鬼影记忆，但效果依赖基础系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AIriskEval-edu: New Dataset for Risk Assessment in AI-mediated K-12 Educational Explanations
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces AIriskEval-edu-db2, a new dataset designed to train and evaluate auditors based on LLMs for an explainable pedagogical risk assessment in instructional content for grades K-12. The dataset comprises 1,639 explanations from 170 curated ScienceQA questions, covering science, language arts, and social sciences. For each question, the dataset includes an explanation written by a human teacher alongside 11 explanations generated by LLM-simulated teacher profiles associated with distinct pedagogical risks. We propose a comprehensive risk rubric aligned with established educational standards that covers five complementary dimensions: factual precision, depth and completeness, focus and relevance, student-level appropriateness, and ideological bias. A key contribution is the addition of 785 explanations with structured explainability annotations, including risk localization and risk description. The annotations are produced through a semi-automatic process with expert teacher validation. Finally, we present validation experiments comparing state-of-the-art proprietary models with a lightweight local Llama 3.1 8B model in both the pedagogical risk detection and the explainability assessment. These experiments evaluate whether supervised fine-tuning on AIriskEval-edu-db2 enables a locally deployable model to approach or outperform stronger frontier models while preserving privacy in educational auditing and assessment tasks.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the IEEE International Carnahan Conference on Security Technology (ICCST 2026), October 14, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个新数据集 AIriskEval-edu-db2，用于训练和评估基于 LLM 的审计者，对 K-12 教育内容进行可解释的教学风险评估。数据集包含 170 个 ScienceQA 问题生成的 1,639 条解释，涵盖教师撰写和 LLM 模拟的 11 种教师画像，并从事实准确性、深度完整性、焦点相关性、学生适切性和意识形态偏见五个维度进行风险标注。此外，还添加了 785 条带有结构化可解释性注释（包括风险定位和描述）的数据，通过半自动过程与专家验证生成。验证实验表明，经过微调的本地 Llama 3.1 8B 模型在教育风险检测和可解释性评估上能够接近或超越更强的前沿专有模型，同时保护隐私。
Motivation: 现有缺乏专门用于评估 K-12 教育解释中教学风险的带标注数据集和统一风险标准，难以训练和评估基于 LLM 的审计系统。
Method: 构建了 AIriskEval-edu-db2 数据集，包含 1639 条解释，提出五维风险评定标准（事实精确性、深度与完整性、焦点与相关性、学生适切性、意识形态偏见），并通过半自动流程与专家验证生成结构化的可解释性注释。
Result: 验证实验显示，在风险检测和可解释性评估任务上，经过监督微调的本地 Llama 3.1 8B 模型性能接近或超越 OpenAI 等前沿专有模型，且支持隐私保护下的本地部署。
Conclusion: 该数据集和评估框架能够赋能本地可部署的轻量级 LLM，在教育审计中实现有效的风险评估与可解释性，同时避免数据隐私泄露风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sparse-Aware Vector Quantization for Bandwidth-Efficient Collaborative 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative perception extends single-agent perception by enabling multiple vehicles to exchange complementary perceptual information. However, it introduces an inherent trade-off between perception gain and communication overhead, which is particularly severe for 3D semantic occupancy prediction that relies on fine-grained spatial structures. Existing methods typically compress 3D features into 2D, causing severe spatial information loss, or transmit dense 3D representations, hindering real-world deployment. To overcome these limitations, we propose a bandwidth-efficient collaborative Vector Quantization Semantic Occupancy Prediction (VQSOP) framework. VQSOP employs a Sparse-Aware Vector Quantization (SAVQ) mechanism that exploits 3D scene sparsity to compactly encode informative regions, drastically reducing communication overhead while preserving complete geometric context. Furthermore, to enhance structural consistency and feature continuity, we design a Dual-Branch Adaptive Spatial Refinement (ASR) module that dynamically fuses local high-frequency details with broad contextual semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing communication volume by up to 82x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出VQSOP框架，利用稀疏感知向量量化（SAVQ）机制压缩3D语义占用特征，在协作感知中大幅降低通信开销，同时保持几何完整性。双分支自适应空间细化模块（ASR）增强结构一致性。实验表明，通信量降低82倍且性能达到SOTA。
Motivation: 协作感知中3D语义占用预测依赖精细空间结构，现有方法压缩3D为2D导致信息丢失，或传输密集3D表示阻碍部署，存在感知增益与通信开销的严重权衡。
Method: 提出VQSOP框架，核心是稀疏感知向量量化（SAVQ），利用3D场景稀疏性紧凑编码信息区域；并设计双分支自适应空间细化模块（ASR），动态融合局部高频细节与全局上下文语义。
Result: 在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能，同时通信量降低高达82倍。
Conclusion: 稀疏感知量化可有效解决协作3D占用预测中的带宽瓶颈，为实际部署提供可行方案。

papers.title: TUDUM: A Turkish-Thinking Reasoning Pipeline for Qwen3.5-27B
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents TUDUM (Türkçe Düşünen Üretken Model), a project pipeline for adapting a Qwen-family 27B thinking model toward Turkish reasoning. The central problem is not only to answer Turkish prompts in Turkish, but to make the explicit reasoning trace itself Turkish. A thinking model may translate a Turkish prompt into an English-centered internal or visible scratchpad, solve the problem mostly in English, and only localize the final answer. TUDUM instead treats the generated <think>...</think> block as a trainable behavior. The pipeline starts from the project base checkpoint unsloth/Qwen3.5-27B, applies supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on 15,991 Turkish reasoning examples using LoRA adapters, and then applies GRPO-family reinforcement learning on a proxy-filtered Turkish mathematics environment. The results are mixed. SFT made the model shorter and more consistently Turkish in its reasoning behavior, with large reductions in average response length and thinking exhaustion, but reduced benchmark accuracy. RL recovered some mathematical performance, especially AIME24 at the best early checkpoint, yet did not uniformly improve all benchmarks and did not exceed the base model on the reported Macro-6 average. The contribution is therefore best framed as a technically honest Turkish-thinking reasoning pipeline and evaluation, not as a claim of state-of-the-art Turkish reasoning. The released step-50 model is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TUDUM 管道，将 Qwen3.5-27B 思维模型适配为土耳其语推理，核心是让思考痕迹本身也变为土耳其语。通过 LoRA 在 15,991 个土耳其语推理样本上进行监督微调（SFT），随后使用 GRPO 系列强化学习在代理过滤的土耳其数学环境中训练。结果混合：SFT 使模型更短且更一致地使用土耳其语，但降低了基准准确率；RL 恢复部分数学性能（如 AIME24 早期检查点），但未超过基线模型的 Macro-6 平均值。贡献在于提供了一个技术诚实的土耳其语推理管道和评估，而非声称最新技术。
Motivation: 现有思维模型在处理土耳其语问题时，通常将提示翻译为英语并在英语中进行思考，仅将最终答案本地化。目标是从思考到答案全程使用土耳其语。
Method: 基于 unsloth/Qwen3.5-27B 检查点，使用 LoRA 在 15,991 个土耳其语推理样本上进行 SFT，随后在代理过滤的土耳其数学环境中应用 GRPO 系列强化学习。
Result: SFT 大幅减少了平均响应长度和思考耗尽，但降低了基准准确率。RL 改善了部分数学性能（如 AIME24 最佳早期检查点），但未一致提升所有基准，且 Macro-6 平均未超过基模。
Conclusion: 本文贡献是一个技术诚实的土耳其思维推理管道和评估，不声称达到最新技术水平。模型已公开。

papers.title: Low-Latency Task-Oriented Image Transmission with Opportunistic Spectrum Access
papers.abstract_en: Communication systems designed for reliable data reconstruction, rather than task-oriented communication, typically rely on separate source and channel coding and incur high latency under limited spectrum availability and fading channels. To address this, we propose a transmission framework with opportunistic spectrum access, in which the transmitter sends discrete latent representations learned via a vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) over idle licensed channels using standard digital modulation. The AI-powered receiver is still able to reconstruct task-related information from the heavily compressed data. We develop a cross-layer latency model that accounts for compression, block errors, retransmissions, and stochastic channel access. Results on latency-accuracy trade-offs show that the proposed scheme achieves at least 79- and 3.3-fold latency reductions with only 5.7% and 2.4% drops in classification accuracy compared to benchmarks using conventional source and channel coding. The framework enables low-latency communication and reliable task execution even under limited spectrum availability and challenging channel conditions.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for presentation at IEEE SPAWC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向任务的低延迟图像传输框架，利用机会频谱接入和VQ-VAE压缩，在空闲授权信道上传输离散潜在表示。跨层延迟模型涵盖压缩、块错误、重传和随机信道接入，实验表明相比传统信源信道编码方案，延迟降低至少79倍和3.3倍，分类准确率仅下降5.7%和2.4%。
Motivation: 传统通信系统注重可靠数据重建，在有限频谱和衰落信道下延迟高，难以满足任务导向通信的低延迟需求。
Method: 提出机会频谱接入框架，发送端用VQ-VAE学习离散潜在表示，通过空闲授权信道以标准数字调制发送，AI接收器从压缩数据重建任务相关信息；开发了跨层延迟模型，联合考虑压缩、块错误、重传和随机信道接入。
Result: 与使用传统信源和信道编码的基准相比，所提方案实现至少79倍和3.3倍的延迟降低，分类准确率仅下降5.7%和2.4%。
Conclusion: 该框架在有限频谱和挑战性信道条件下能实现低延迟通信和可靠任务执行。

papers.title: ElephantAgent: Contextual State Continuity in Agentic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems enhance their capabilities by invoking external tools and maintaining persistent memory. However, these external dependencies introduce novel attack surfaces. Recent tool and memory poisoning attacks show that maliciously crafted tool descriptors and poisoned memory can covertly bias agent behavior. These threats reflect a deeper issue: the lack of verifiable continuity in the agent's contextual state for planning and execution. We present ElephantAgent, a protocol that enforces Contextual State Continuity to defend against contextual state poisoning. Inspired by prior state-continuity mechanisms (e.g., Nimble), ElephantAgent extends this protection to the evolving contextual state of agentic systems. We define the contextual state as the bounded, security-critical subset of the agent's entire context (e.g., tool state and memory). Before processing each query, ElephantAgent recomputes the digest of the local contextual state and verifies it against the latest authorized digest. Using replicated trusted hardware, ElephantAgent maintains a linearizable ledger of authorized contextual state transitions and detects out-of-band state tampering. To handle in-band semantic abuse, ElephantAgent additionally provides Historical Traceability, enabling conditional post-hoc audit and recovery to a known-good prior state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI智能体系统面临的外部工具和记忆投毒攻击，提出ElephantAgent协议，通过强制上下文状态连续性来防御。该协议在每次查询前重新计算本地上下文状态摘要，并与授权摘要比对，利用复制可信硬件维护线性化账本，检测带外状态篡改，同时提供历史可追溯性用于事后审计和恢复。
Motivation: 现有智能体系统依赖外部工具和持久化记忆，但恶意构造的工具描述和投毒记忆可隐蔽地偏斜智能体行为，缺乏可验证的上下文状态连续性。
Method: 定义上下文状态为安全关键的上下文子集，采用复制可信硬件维护线性化账本，每次查询前重新计算摘要并与授权摘要比对，并引入历史可追溯性以支持条件性事后审计和恢复。
Result: 摘要未明确报告定量实验结果，主要描述协议机制及其防御能力。
Conclusion: ElephantAgent通过强制上下文状态连续性，可防范带外状态篡改，并借助历史可追溯性应对带内语义滥用，但摘要未讨论局限性或性能开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Zeus: Towards Tuning-Free Foundation Model for Time Series Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We present Zeus, a unified tuning-free Time Series Foundation Model (TSFM) that delivers superior performance across diverse analysis tasks without any task-specific fine-tuning. Unlike prior studies that primarily focus on zero-shot forecasting but require task-specific tuning for other tasks, Zeus bridges this gap by addressing two fundamental challenges in multi-task generalization. First, to reconcile point-level granularity with long-sequence scalability, Zeus incorporates a multi-scale Transformer featuring point-wise tokenization and a U-shaped hierarchy, effectively balancing fine-grained fidelity with computational efficiency. Second, to accommodate varying inductive biases across different tasks, Zeus introduces Multi-Objective Temporal Masking (MOTM), a unified strategy that supports heterogeneous tasks (e.g., extrapolation, interpolation, and global abstraction) within a single framework. Extensive experiments across five representative tasks demonstrate that Zeus consistently achieves competitive results in tuning-free settings, underscoring its potential as a general-purpose TSFM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Zeus 是一个统一的无调优时间序列基础模型，通过多尺度 Transformer 和多目标时间掩码（MOTM）实现多种分析任务（如外推、插值、全局抽象）的零样本泛化，无需任务特定微调。实验在五个代表性任务上展示了竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型主要聚焦于零样本预测，但其他任务（如插值、分类）仍需任务特定调优，缺乏统一的无调优多任务泛化方案。
Method: 提出多尺度 Transformer 架构（点级 tokenization + U 形层次结构）以平衡细粒度与长序列可扩展性，以及多目标时间掩码（MOTM）统一策略，通过不同掩码模式支持异构任务。
Result: 在五个代表性时间序列分析任务（包括外推、插值、全局抽象等）上，Zeus 在无调优设置下持续取得竞争性结果。
Conclusion: Zeus 作为通用时间序列基础模型，展示了无调优多任务泛化的潜力，为简化下游应用提供了新方向。
Relevance: 65

papers.title: ContextSniper: AntTrail's Token-Efficient Code Memory for Repository-Level Program Repair
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents can repair real repository issues, but they often spend large context budgets on whole-file reads, broad searches, and long terminal outputs where useful evidence is mixed with irrelevant code and logs. This paper presents ContextSniper, AntTrail's token-efficient code memory layer for repository-level program repair. As the coding specialization of AntTrail's broader agent memory engine, ContextSniper implements the Sniper feature for precision evidence selection: it retrieves candidate code and runtime evidence, ranks it with hybrid retrieval signals, filters long outputs through an intention-aware context gate, and returns compact evidence packets while preserving recoverable source context outside the prompt. We evaluate ContextSniper on SWE-bench Lite with OpenClaw and Claude Code, using 50 task runs per host-agent condition. ContextSniper reduces total token use by 51.5% and logged cost by 36.4% for OpenClaw, and reduces total token use by 38.9% and estimated cost by 27.3% for Claude Code. Submitted-resolution rates decrease slightly, from 26.0% to 24.0% for OpenClaw and from 32.0% to 30.0% for Claude Code. ContextSniper's pilot testing scripts are open-sourced at https://github.com/Calluking/ContextSniper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ContextSniper，作为 AntTrail 代理在仓库级程序修复中的 token 高效代码记忆层。它通过精确证据选择（Sniper 机制）减少上下文预算，在 SWE-bench Lite 上对 OpenClaw 和 Claude Code 分别降低 51.5% 和 38.9% 的 token 使用，成本降低 36.4% 和 27.3%，但提交解决率略微下降约 2 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代理在修复仓库级问题时，常常将大量 token 用于读取整个文件、进行广泛搜索以及处理冗长的终端输出，其中有用证据与无关代码和日志混杂，导致上下文预算效率低下。
Method: ContextSniper 实现了 Sniper 特征：通过混合检索信号对候选代码和运行时证据进行排序，利用意图感知的上下文门控过滤长输出，并在提示之外保留可恢复的源代码上下文，从而返回紧凑的证据包。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Lite 上，每套主-代理条件运行 50 次任务：OpenClaw 的总 token 使用减少 51.5%，记录成本降低 36.4%；Claude Code 的总 token 使用减少 38.9%，估计成本降低 27.3%。提交解决率从 26.0% 小幅下降至 24.0%（OpenClaw），从 32.0% 下降至 30.0%（Claude Code）。
Conclusion: ContextSniper 通过 token 高效的内存层显著降低了修复仓库级缺陷的计算成本，同时解决了率仅有轻微下降，证明了精确证据选择的实际效益。作者开源了初步测试脚本。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Robust Image Processing Techniques for Construction Environment Monitoring Using Underwater Robots
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a robust image processing framework for underwater robot-based construction environment monitoring, targeting complex degradations observed in real marine environments. Unlike conventional approaches that mainly consider absorption and backscattering, real underwater imagery is strongly affected by depth-dependent forward scattering blur and particle-induced degradations such as marine snow. To address this, we introduce a staged processing pipeline that sequentially models background degradation via depth-aware forward scattering and foreground degradation using realistic marine snow patterns extracted from real images. The resulting synthetic data are used to retrain an existing Joint-ID network without modifying its architecture, enabling an isolated evaluation of dataset realism. In addition, a lightweight post-processing scheme is applied to enhance contrast and structural clarity. Experiments on real underwater datasets collected in Korean coastal environments demonstrate consistent improvements in visual quality and UIQM scores. The results indicate that explicitly modeling forward scattering and realistic particle effects effectively reduces the synthetic-to-real gap and improves practical applicability in real-world underwater robotic operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向水下机器人建筑环境监测的鲁棒图像处理框架，针对真实海洋环境中深度相关的前向散射模糊和海洋雪等粒子退化进行建模。通过分阶段处理流水线依次模拟背景和前景退化，生成合成数据用于重新训练现有Joint-ID网络，并添加轻量级后处理增强对比度与结构清晰度。在韩国沿海真实水下数据集上，该方法提升了视觉质量和UIQM分数，缩小了合成到真实的差距。
Motivation: 真实水下图像除吸收和背向散射外，还受深度相关前向散射和海洋雪等粒子退化影响，现有方法未充分考虑这些因素，导致合成数据与真实场景存在差距。
Method: 提出分阶段处理流水线：首先通过深度感知前向散射建模背景退化，然后利用从真实图像提取的海洋雪模式模拟前景退化。使用生成的合成数据重新训练Joint-ID网络（不修改架构），并采用轻量级后处理以增强对比度和结构清晰度。
Result: 在韩国沿海真实水下数据集上，该方法一致提升了视觉质量和UIQM分数，表明显式建模前向散射和粒子效应有效缩小了合成到真实的差距，增强了实际应用性。
Conclusion: 该框架通过更真实地模拟水下退化条件，提高了基于水下机器人的建筑环境监测在实际海洋操作中的实用性。

summary_sections.method: 提出分阶段处理流水线：首先通过深度感知前向散射建模背景退化，然后利用从真实图像提取的海洋雪模式模拟前景退化。使用生成的合成数据重新训练Joint-ID网络（不修改架构），并采用轻量级后处理以增强对比度和结构清晰度。
summary_sections.result: 在韩国沿海真实水下数据集上，该方法一致提升了视觉质量和UIQM分数，表明显式建模前向散射和粒子效应有效缩小了合成到真实的差距，增强了实际应用性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架通过更真实地模拟水下退化条件，提高了基于水下机器人的建筑环境监测在实际海洋操作中的实用性。

papers.title: Towards Real-World Ultrasound Understanding: Large Vision-Language Models from Multi-Image Examinations with Long-Form Reports
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved strong performance across many medical imaging tasks, yet their application to ultrasound remains limited due to its inherent complexity and variability. In this work, we revisit what is truly needed to enable real-world ultrasound understanding. Instead of introducing complex architectures or elaborate training strategies, we show that data scale and clinically faithful data alignment are the key factors. We construct a large-scale dataset of 1.5M real-world ultrasound examinations, containing 17.7M images, multi-organ coverage, and paired uncurated clinical reports. Crucially, we organize the data at the examination level, aligning multiple images with their corresponding reports to reflect real clinical workflows. We then fine-tune a standard LVLM using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) on this dataset without task-specific modifications. Surprisingly, this simple recipe already leads to strong performance across diverse ultrasound understanding tasks, outperforming prior methods designed with more complex pipelines. Beyond these results, we present model and data scaling analyses that provide insights into the role of scale in ultrasound LVLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了包含150万次真实超声检查、1770万张图像的大规模数据集，以检查级别组织数据，将多张图像与对应的临床报告对齐，并利用低秩适配（LoRA）微调标准视觉语言模型（LVLM），无需任务特定修改即可在多种超声理解任务上取得优异性能，优于此前更复杂的方法。
Motivation: 现有大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在医学影像任务中表现强劲，但应用于超声领域仍受限于其固有的复杂性和变异性。需要探索实现真实世界超声理解的关键因素。
Method: 构建大规模、检查级别的超声数据集（150万次检查，1770万张图像，多器官覆盖，配对的非整理临床报告），并采用低秩适配（LoRA）微调标准LVLM，不引入复杂架构或训练策略。
Result: 该简单方案在多种超声理解任务上优于此前采用更复杂流程的方法。此外，通过模型和数据规模分析，揭示了规模对超声LVLM的作用。
Conclusion: 数据规模和临床忠实的数据对齐是推动真实世界超声理解的关键因素，而非复杂架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Population-Based Multi-Objective Training of Discriminators for Semi-Supervised GANs
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised generative adversarial networks (SSL-GANs) can exploit large unlabeled datasets while retaining a classifier in the discriminator, but their training is often unstable. This paper proposes a population-based evolutionary training strategy in which discriminator learning is formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem. Instead of aggregating the supervised and unsupervised components of the SSL objective into a single scalar loss, the method maintains a population of discriminators ranked by Pareto dominance, enabling the exploration of different trade-offs between classification accuracy and real/fake discrimination. This formulation aims to improve both roles of SSL-GANs: learning accurate classifiers and training generators capable of producing realistic samples. We analyze several variants, including an elitist strategy and a mono-objective ablation, to assess the role of multi-objective selection. Experiments on MNIST with limited labels show improved training robustness compared to SSL-GAN and CE-SSL-GAN state-of-the-art baselines, while the elitist variant consistently achieves the highest classification accuracy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对半监督生成对抗网络（SSL-GANs）训练不稳定的问题，提出一种基于种群的进化训练策略，将判别器学习表述为多目标优化问题。通过Pareto支配排序维护判别器种群，探索分类准确性与真假判别之间的不同权衡。实验在有限标签的MNIST数据集上表明，该方法相比SSL-GAN和CE-SSL-GAN基线提高了训练鲁棒性，精英变体始终达到最高分类准确率。
Motivation: 半监督GANs（SSL-GANs）可以同时利用无标签数据并保留分类器，但其训练往往不稳定，传统方法将监督和无监督损失聚合成单个标量损失，难以平衡两者。
Method: 提出基于种群的进化训练策略，将判别器学习形式化为多目标优化问题。维护一个由Pareto支配排序的判别器种群，并分析精英策略和单目标消融等变体，以评估多目标选择的作用。
Result: 在有限标签的MNIST数据集上，该方法相比SSL-GAN和CE-SSL-GAN基线提高了训练鲁棒性；精英变体在分类准确率上始终最高。
Conclusion: 多目标选择能有效改善SSL-GANs的判别器训练，平衡分类与对抗任务，提升训练鲁棒性和分类性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SFKD: Spatial--Frequency Joint-Aware Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation via Multi-Level Wavelet Spectral Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Most existing knowledge distillation methods focus on homogeneous models (e.g., CNN-to-CNN), thereby overlooking the flexibility and potential of knowledge transfer across heterogeneous models. Due to intrinsic inductive bias discrepancies between heterogeneous models that cause spatial distribution inconsistencies, prior heterogeneous distillation methods often weaken or discard spatial information in heterogeneous representations. However, the spatial information in representations often encodes transferable global structural semantics as well as architecture-specific local details, and therefore should not be directly ignored. To better leverage the spatial information encoded in heterogeneous representations, we propose a Spatial-Frequency Joint-Aware Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation framework (SFKD). By leveraging the complementary properties of wavelet transform spatial locality and Fourier representations in characterizing global energy distributions, we first apply multi-level discrete wavelet transform to explicitly decouple spatial information. The resulting wavelet sub-bands are further refined by a dual-stream dual-stage refinement module, and finally combined with a Gaussian-filtered frequency loss to selectively capture informative global information. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets under both homogeneous and heterogeneous models demonstrate the superiority of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SFKD框架，利用多级小波变换解耦空间信息，并结合傅里叶全局能量分布，实现异构模型（如CNN与Transformer）之间的知识蒸馏。通过双流双阶段细化模块和高斯滤波频率损失，在多个同构/异构基准上取得优于现有蒸馏方法的性能。
Motivation: 现有异构知识蒸馏方法因模型归纳偏差导致空间分布不一致，往往丢弃或弱化空间信息，但空间信息编码了可迁移的全局结构语义和架构特有局部细节，不应被直接忽略。
Method: 提出空间-频率联合感知异构知识蒸馏（SFKD）：首先对教师和学生特征进行多级离散小波变换，显式解耦空间信息；然后通过双流双阶段细化模块精炼小波子带；最后结合高斯滤波频率损失选择性捕获全局信息。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的同构和异构蒸馏实验均表明SFKD优于现有方法，摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 利用小波变换的空间局部性和傅里叶变换的全局能量分布互补特性，可以有效利用异构表示中的空间信息进行知识蒸馏。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Complexity Metrics for LLM-Integrated Applications: Beyond Source Code
papers.abstract_en: LLM-integrated applications blend natural language prompts with program code, and much of their runtime behavior originates in the prompt layer rather than in the code itself. Existing complexity metrics, however, operate solely at the code level and therefore overlook this behavioral logic entirely. We present HECATE, the first tool designed to assess complexity in both the prompt and code layers of such applications. Central to HECATE is Prompt-as-Specification, a Hoare-logic-inspired formalism that interprets every prompt as a specification of intended behavior. Grounded in 25 complexity dimensions identified across published taxonomies, the tool generates 52 candidate metrics. We assess each metric against 118 components collected from 18 open-source repositories, relying on maintenance activity derived from version history as an empirical proxy for complexity, and discard any metric that loses significance once code size is accounted for. Only ten metrics withstand this test. Seven belong to our newly introduced set; rather than measuring sheer volume, each tallies structurally distinct elements, such as LLM call sites, memory attributes, and prompt templates, an attribute we call structural breadth. Of the three surviving conventional metrics, RFC exhibits a similar breadth-oriented character, while Halstead N and V survive only as a residual effect of size; our top-performing metrics exceed all three. Crucially, the prompt-layer metrics retain significance even when the strongest code-level metric is added as a covariate, establishing prompt complexity as a dimension in its own right. A final validation on 20 components spanning six held-out repositories shows that the two best-performing metrics continue to predict maintenance effort, supporting their generalizability beyond the training set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HECATE，首个同时评估LLM集成应用中提示层和代码层复杂性的工具。基于Hoare逻辑的Prompt-as-Specification形式化方法，从25个复杂性维度生成52个候选度量，经维护活动代理验证后仅保留10个有效度量，其中7个为新增的“结构广度”度量，且提示层度量在控制代码级度量后仍具显著性，证明提示复杂性是一个独立维度。
Motivation: 现有复杂性度量仅针对代码层，忽略了LLM集成应用中运行时行为主要源于提示层的事实，导致无法全面评估此类应用的实际复杂性。
Method: 提出HECATE工具，核心是Prompt-as-Specification形式化方法，将提示解释为行为规范；从已发表分类学中提炼25个复杂性维度，生成52个候选度量，通过版本历史维护活动作为经验代理，在118个组件上验证并剔除仅依赖代码规模的度量。
Result: 仅10个度量通过验证，其中7个为新增的结构广度度量（如LLM调用点、记忆属性、提示模板数量），3个传统度量中RFC表现类似广度，Halstead N和V仅体现规模效应；提示层度量在控制最强代码级度量后仍显著，最终在两个保留库上验证了最佳度量的泛化性。
Conclusion: 提示层复杂性是LLM集成应用的一个独立维度，HECATE的度量方法能有效预测维护努力，且结构广度比单纯规模更能反映复杂性。

papers.title: Rethinking Post-Hoc Calibration in Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable confidence estimates are essential in semantic segmentation, especially in safety-critical settings where overconfident errors can mislead downstream decisions. Yet modern segmentation models often remain miscalibrated. Post-hoc calibration offers a practical way to correct confidence estimates without retraining the segmentation model, but its use in dense prediction raises structural issues that are often overlooked. We study two such issues. First, adding a constant to all logits leaves the softmax probabilities unchanged, but several standard calibrators can still depend on this arbitrary offset. As a result, two logit representations encoding the same predictive distribution may yield different calibrated probabilities. We define translation-invariant (TI) calibrators as those whose outputs are unchanged under such shifts, characterize which common calibrators satisfy this property, and construct TI counterparts of shift-sensitive calibrators to isolate the effect of removing representation dependence. Second, post-hoc calibration is typically fitted by minimizing a likelihood-based objective, whereas segmentation models are trained with task-specific metrics such as Dice. This mismatch can cause calibration to alter class orderings and degrade the deployed segmentation map. We study decision-preserving calibration under argmax- and order-preservation constraints. Since enforcing these constraints collapses affine softmax calibrators to temperature scaling, we introduce class-conditional affine calibrators that can be made argmax- or order-preserving while retaining greater expressivity, allowing us to quantify the calibration-segmentation trade-off induced by decision preservation. Across natural-image and medical segmentation benchmarks, and under corruption-based covariate shift, matched comparisons show that TI variants generally improve calibration metrics, while decision-preserving variants prevent segmentation degradation and retain strong calibration performance. These results provide practical design principles for well-defined post-hoc calibration pipelines in semantic segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视语义分割中的后验校准问题，指出两个被忽视的结构性问题：1）某些校准器对logit的平移敏感（即对同一预测分布的不同logit表示给出不同校准概率），2）基于似然的校准目标与分割任务指标（如Dice）不匹配，可能改变类别排序并降低分割质量。作者定义了平移不变（TI）校准器，并构造了决策保持（argmax或顺序保持）的类条件仿射校准器，在自然图像和医学图像基准上比较了这些变体。
Motivation: 语义分割中的现代模型通常校准不良，后验校准实用但存在结构性问题：校准器可能依赖于logit的任意偏移量，且基于似然的校准目标与分割任务指标不匹配，可能导致校准后分割性能下降。
Method: 定义平移不变（TI）校准器并构造对偏移敏感的校准器的TI版本；引入类条件仿射校准器，并施加argmax保持或顺序保持约束以保留分割决策，同时保持表达能力。
Result: 在自然图像和医学图像分割基准上（包括协变量偏移下），TI变体通常改善校准指标，决策保持变体防止分割退化且保持良好校准性能。
Conclusion: 研究为语义分割中定义良好的后验校准流程提供了实用设计原则，指出平移不变性和决策保持性对于可靠校准的重要性。

summary_sections.conclusion: 研究为语义分割中定义良好的后验校准流程提供了实用设计原则，指出平移不变性和决策保持性对于可靠校准的重要性。

papers.title: SABER: A Semantic-Aligned Brain Network Analysis Framework via Multi-scale Hypergraphs
papers.abstract_en: Effective brain disease diagnosis requires the synergy of brain connectivity patterns and high-level semantic knowledge. Existing methods, however, largely treat semantics from large language models (LLMs) as auxiliary features or supervision, limiting their direct role in decision-making and constraining classification stability and robustness. To overcome this, we propose a semantic-aligned brain network framework that actively integrates LLM-derived semantics into the prediction process. Specifically, ROI-level semantics are first incorporated via global self-attention to enrich node representations and provide whole-brain context. Multi-scale hypergraphs are then constructed to explicitly model functional subnetworks and multi-ROI interactions, addressing the locality limitations of traditional GNNs and capturing high-order dependencies. Finally, a decision-level semantic alignment mechanism selectively injects patient-specific textual embeddings into graph representations, enabling semantics to directly guide predictions without perturbing the underlying network structure. Experiments on public brain network datasets ABIDE and ADHD-200 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, enhanced stability, and improved interpretability, particularly in small-sample settings.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Multimedia and Expo (ICME) 2026;
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SABER框架，通过全局自注意力引入ROI级语义、构建多尺度超图建模功能子网络和高阶交互，并采用决策级语义对齐机制将LLM语义直接融入预测过程。在ABIDE和ADHD-200数据集上取得最优性能，尤其在小样本场景下提升了稳定性和可解释性。
Motivation: 现有方法将LLM语义仅作为辅助特征或监督信号，限制了语义在决策中的直接作用，导致分类稳定性和鲁棒性不足。
Method: 首先通过全局自注意力整合ROI级语义以丰富节点表示，然后构建多尺度超图显式建模功能子网络和多ROI交互，最后采用决策级语义对齐机制将患者特定文本嵌入注入图表示，使语义直接指导预测而不扰动底层结构。
Result: 在ABIDE和ADHD-200数据集上达到当前最优性能，且在小样本设置下展现出增强的稳定性和可解释性。
Conclusion: 该框架通过主动整合LLM语义，有效提升了脑疾病诊断的稳定性和鲁棒性，尤其适用于小样本场景。

papers.title: FoundDP: Revisiting Weak Disparity Observability in Dual-Pixel Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Dual-pixel (DP) imaging enables metric depth estimation from a single camera using sub-aperture disparity. However, the extremely small effective baseline limits disparity observability, leading to structural degradation and depth failure in textureless, low-contrast, or downsampled regions. Existing DP-based methods rely primarily on local disparity cues and therefore become unreliable when disparity signals are weak or ambiguous. To address this limitation, we propose \emph{FoundDP}, a unified framework that integrates metric DP depth with global structural priors from a monocular depth foundation model. Our method preserves metric scale through DP-derived depth and leverages Vision Transformer (ViT) features to restore structural consistency in weak-disparity regions. To ensure reliable metric guidance under DP imaging conditions, we identify and mitigate ViT representation degradation induced by DP defocus blur via ViT feature alignment, enabling stable metric-guided depth estimation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world DP benchmarks show that FoundDP delivers superior performance, with consistent gains in structural fidelity and metric accuracy, especially under reduced disparity observability. Code will be available at: https://github.com/EchoLighting/FoundDP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FoundDP，一个统一框架，将双像素（DP）深度与单目深度基础模型的全局结构先验相结合，以解决弱视差区域的结构退化和深度失效问题。通过Vision Transformer（ViT）特征对齐来缓解DP散焦模糊导致的表示退化，在合成和真实DP基准上取得了优越性能。
Motivation: 现有DP深度估计方法在纹理稀少、低对比度或下采样区域因有效基线极小导致视差可观测性弱，产生结构退化。
Method: 提出FoundDP框架，融合DP度规深度与单目深度基础模型的全局结构先验，利用ViT特征保持结构一致性，并通过ViT特征对齐减轻DP散焦模糊引起的表示退化。
Result: 在合成和真实DP基准上，FoundDP在结构保真度和度量精度上取得一致提升，尤其在视差可观测性降低时。
Conclusion: FoundDP有效改善了弱视差条件下的DP深度估计，并提供了稳定度量引导。

papers.title: Rank-Then-Act: Reward-Free Control from Frame-Order Progress
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Rank-Then-Act (RTA), a framework for learning control policies from expert video demonstrations without environment rewards. RTA trains a Vision-Language Model (VLM) offline as a progress-based ordinal scorer, using a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) objective over shuffled frame sequences, which forces the model to recover temporal ordering from visual semantics rather than trivial time cues. Importantly, instead of using the scorer directly as a scalar reward model, we propose a correlation-based reward function for reinforcement learning: at each interaction window, we compute the Spearman rank correlation between predicted progress rankings and true temporal indices, yielding a bounded, scale-invariant learning signal. This design decouples reward learning from absolute calibration and enables stable transfer across tasks and environments. We evaluate RTA on discrete control benchmarks (PyBoy: Catrap, Kirby) and continuous control tasks (PointMaze, MetaWorld). RTA consistently matches or outperforms prior video-based reward learning methods and rank-based baselines, while demonstrating strong cross-task reuse of a single pretrained progress scorer. Our results suggest that correlation-structured supervision over video-derived ordinal signals is sufficient for policy learning, offering a scalable alternative to explicit reward design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Rank-Then-Act (RTA) 框架，利用专家视频演示无需环境奖励即可学习控制策略。RTA 训练视觉语言模型作为基于进度的排序评分器，通过 GRPO 目标在打乱帧序列上恢复时间顺序，并采用 Spearman 秩相关作为奖励信号，使得奖励学习与绝对标定解耦。在离散和连续控制任务上，RTA 匹配或优于先前基于视频的奖励学习方法，并展示了跨任务重用单个进度评分器的能力。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法通常依赖手工设计的奖励函数，限制了其可扩展性和泛化能力。从视频演示中学习控制策略无需显式奖励，但如何从视频中提取有效的学习信号仍然是一个挑战。
Method: 提出 RTA 框架，包括离线训练一个 VLM 作为进度排序评分器，使用 GRPO 目标在打乱帧序列上学习时间顺序；然后提出基于相关系数的奖励函数，在交互窗口内计算预测进度排序与真实时间索引的 Spearman 秩相关，作为 RL 的奖励信号。
Result: 在 PyBoy (Catrap, Kirby)、PointMaze、MetaWorld 等基准上，RTA 一致匹配或优于先前基于视频的奖励学习方法及基于排名的基线，并展示了单个预训练进度评分器在跨任务重用中的有效性。
Conclusion: 基于视频派生有序信号的相关结构监督足以学习控制策略，为显式奖励设计提供了可扩展的替代方案。

papers.title: Regularized Variational and Spectral Log-Density-Ratio Estimation in the Gaussian Location Model
papers.abstract_en: We study ridge-regularized log-density-ratio estimation in the Gaussian location model with a common covariance matrix. By affine invariance, the model is written as q $\sim$ N(0, I), p $\sim$ N($Δ$, I), with linear features, where $Δ$ is a mean vector. The variational estimator is the empirical Kullback-Leibler (KL) log-normalized fit with a squared L2-penalty on its nonconstant coefficient, and the spectral estimator recently introduced in [1] replaces a single variational problem by a continuum of ridge-regularized least-squares problems. We derive high-dimensional deterministic asymptotic equivalents when the numbers of observations and dimension tend to infinity with fixed ratios. The regularized variational limit is characterized by a scalar entropy minimization problem derived from the convex-Gaussian-min-max theorem (CGMT), while the regularized spectral limit follows from deterministic equivalents for resolvents of weighted sums of two independent Gaussian sample covariance matrices. We use these formulas to compare population risks, with experiments focused on fixed-signal aspect-ratio sweeps and optimized regularization. Our conclusion is that with many observations, under the criteria and asymptotic regimes analyzed here, the well-specified variational estimator has the smaller risk, while with fewer observations, the spectral estimator is favored because its covariance-based construction has lower variance. We also study how a nuclear penalty can be used and partially analyzed to perform feature learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了高斯位置模型（共同协方差矩阵）中岭正则化对数密度比估计的变分和谱方法。通过仿射不变性将模型写为线性特征形式，利用凸高斯极小极大定理（CGMT）和解析子方法分别推导了变分和谱估计的高维确定性渐近等价表达式。实验表明，在多次观测下良设定变分估计风险更小，而观测较少时谱估计因协方差构造方差更优。还讨论了核范数惩罚用于特征学习。
Motivation: 高维正则化密度比估计的理论分析不足，特别是变分和谱估计在不同观测数量下的性能比较缺乏严格的渐近结果。
Method: 在带共同协方差的高斯位置模型中，定义变分估计为经验KL对数归一化拟合加平方L2惩罚，谱估计通过连续岭正则化最小二乘问题构造。利用CGMT和随机矩阵理论推导两者在样本与维度同比例增长时的确定性渐近等价。
Result: 推导了正则化变分和谱估计风险的高维渐近公式，发现观测多时变分估计风险更小，观测少时谱估计因方差低更优。
Conclusion: 在分析的高斯位置模型和渐近机制下，变分与谱估计各有优劣，核范数惩罚可进行特征学习。

papers.title: Spec-AUF: Accept-Until-Fail Training under Train-Inference Misalignment for Masked Block Drafters
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting a block of tokens that the target model verifies left-to-right, committing only the longest accepted prefix. Block (DLM-style) drafters predict the whole block in parallel, which is fast but trained with a full-block cross-entropy that supervises every position against the gold continuation -- even though inference discards every token after the first rejection. Recent acceptance-aware objectives patch this by reweighting the full-block loss; we instead use teacher-forced learning as a motivation for how supervision should concentrate on the accepted prefix. A mask-only block drafter has no input-side channel for gold-prefix conditioning, so AUF approximates that prefix-sensitive supervision on the loss side by keeping the cross-entropy support only through the drafter's first predicted failure. AUF is a single, detached change to the CE support -- no auxiliary objective, no verifier rollouts, and no change to the inference pipeline or the exactness contract. Within fixed drafter backbones and serving settings on Qwen3-8B, AUF raises the DFlash drafter's average emitted length $τ$, averaged over six benchmarks, from 2.40 to 2.61, with a gain on every benchmark, and transfers to Domino's two-branch head (2.56 to 2.68). Two findings sharpen the picture: the decay-only baseline reaches higher token accuracy on the shared block mask yet decodes worse, and on DFlash, once AUF truncates the support, the standard exponential position-decay weighting becomes empirically inert.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Spec-AUF（Accept-Until-Fail）训练方法，用于解决掩码块草稿者（masked block drafters）在推测解码中训练与推理不一致的问题。该方法通过仅保留草稿者第一次预测失败之前的交叉熵损失支持，使得监督集中在被接受的token前缀上，无需辅助目标或推理改动。在Qwen3-8B上，使用DFlash草稿者将平均发射长度从2.40提升到2.61，Domino草稿者从2.56提升到2.68。
Motivation: 推测解码中块草稿者训练时使用全块交叉熵，但推理时只接受第一个拒绝之前的token，导致训练与推理不一致。现有方法通过重新加权来修补，但作者提出直接用teacher-forced学习作为动机，使监督集中在被接受的前缀上。
Method: 提出AUF方法，一种简单、单独的改变：将交叉熵损失的支持范围截断到草稿者第一次预测失败的位置，即只对接受前缀计算损失。这近似了前缀敏感监督，无需辅助目标、验证器rollout或更改推理管线。
Result: 在固定草稿者骨架和服务设置下，使用Qwen3-8B，AUF使DFlash草稿者的平均发射长度在六个基准上从2.40提升到2.61，每个基准都有提升；同样提升Domino的二分支头从2.56到2.68。此外，仅衰减基线在共享块掩码上达到更高token准确率但解码更差，且AUF截断损失后，标准指数位置衰减权重变得经验上无效。
Conclusion: AUF是一种有效的训练方法，修复了掩码块草稿者的train-inference misalignment，无需复杂改动即可带来一致的性能提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diversity-aware View Partitioning for Scalable VGGT
papers.abstract_en: Geometry transformers such as VGGT achieve strong performance by jointly reasoning over multiple views with global attention. However, scaling them to large view collections remains challenging due to the quadratic cost of attention. Moreover, our empirical analysis reveals that the reconstruction quality in VGGT is sensitive to the distribution of viewpoints. Simply increasing the number of views without sufficient viewpoint diversity can even degrade performance, as redundant views introduce highly similar tokens that dilute informative geometric signals in the attention mechanism. Motivated by this observation, we propose a training-free and plug-and-play VGGT inference framework that organizes views into diversity-aware balanced chunks. The chunks are constructed through combinatorial graph partitioning over visual dissimilarity and spatial dispersion. This view organization allows the transformer to focus attention on geometrically informative views while reducing redundant attention interactions. To estimate spatial dispersion without full pose estimation, we approximate spatial relationships via a soft pose propagation strategy based on visual similarity from a small set of seed frames. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved performance in camera pose estimation, multi-view depth prediction, and 3D reconstruction while reducing memory usage and inference latency. Our framework also complements existing VGGT variants, enabling scalable multi-view reconstruction without sacrificing geometric fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对VGGT几何变换器在大规模视图集合中推理效率低的问题，提出一种免训练、即插即用的推理框架，通过基于视觉不相似性和空间分散性的组合图划分，将视图组织成多样性感知的平衡块，从而减少冗余注意力交互。实验表明该方法在相机姿态估计、多视图深度预测和3D重建上提升性能，同时降低内存和延迟。
Motivation: VGGT等几何变换器在处理多个视图时使用全局注意力，但注意力成本是二次的，且随着视图数量增加，冗余视图会引入高度相似的token，稀释几何信号，甚至导致性能下降。
Method: 提出免训练即插即用的推理框架：首先通过视觉相似性从少量种子帧估计空间关系（软姿态传播），然后基于视觉不相似性和空间分散性进行组合图划分，将视图组织成平衡的多样性感知块，使注意力聚焦于几何信息丰富的视图。
Result: 摘要报告在相机姿态估计、多视图深度预测和3D重建上提升性能，同时减少内存使用和推理延迟。
Conclusion: 该框架可补充现有VGGT变体，在不牺牲几何保真度的前提下实现可扩展的多视图重建。

papers.title: Learning the Supports for Categorical Critic in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Value functions are an essential component in actor-critic based deep reinforcement learning (RL). Conventionally, these functions are trained as a regression task by minimising the mean squared error (MSE) relative to bootstrapped target values. Meanwhile, in distributional RL, a distribution of returns is modelled based on the distributional Bellman operator. This work investigates the Gaussian Histogram Loss (HL-Gauss), a recent approach that reframes value estimation as classification by encoding each scalar Bellman target as a Gaussian-smoothed categorical target. Despite its potential, applying histogram-based losses to RL presents inherent challenges, most notably the requirement to pre-define a fixed support interval, which is often complicated by the non-stationary and stochastic nature of target values typically found in RL tasks. In this work, we propose an approach that dynamically learns the lower and upper bounds of the support instead of assigning them beforehand. We derive an objective that jointly learns these bounds whilst learning the categorical representation of the scalar values, and we show that this objective forms an upper bound on the mean-squared Bellman error. Our theoretical analysis further shows that this bound is tighter than that of non-learned supports of HL-Gauss. Empirically, the proposed objective enables stable adaptation of the support interval and matches HL-Gauss-based actor-critic algorithms on most continuous-control tasks whilst improving on a subset, without requiring a pre-specified support interval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在强化学习中动态学习分类评论家（categorical critic）支持区间的方法，通过联合学习支持上下界和标量值的分类表示，推导出该目标构成均方贝尔曼误差的上界，且理论上比非学习支持的HL-Gauss更紧。实验表明该方法在连续控制任务上匹配或超越基于HL-Gauss的演员-评论家算法，且无需预设支持区间。
Motivation: 基于直方图损失的强化学习方法需要预定义固定的支持区间，而目标值的非平稳性和随机性使得固定区间难以设定，影响了方法的适用性和性能。
Method: 提出一种动态学习支持区间上下界的方法，联合优化支持边界和标量值的分类表示，并证明该目标函数是均方贝尔曼误差的上界。
Result: 该方法在大多数连续控制任务上匹配基于HL-Gauss的演员-评论家算法，并在其中一部分任务上表现更优，且无需预先指定支持区间。
Conclusion: 动态学习支持区间可以稳健地适应目标值分布的变化，理论上比固定支持边界更紧，实际中简化了超参数选择。

papers.title: SAB-LVLM: Significance-Aware Binarization for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in multimodal understanding, yet their enormous parameter scale and cross-modal computation incur substantial memory and latency overhead, severely limiting real-world deployment on resource-constrained devices. Binarization offers an attractive solution by drastically reducing storage and computational costs. However, existing binarization methods neglect the varying importance of weights across different layers and modalities. This causes parameters irrelevant to downstream tasks to be unnecessarily retained, whereas modality-critical weights may not be adequately optimized, resulting in significant performance degradation. To address these challenges, we develop a novel \underline{S}ignificance-\underline{A}ware \underline{B}inarization for \underline{L}arge \underline{V}ision-\underline{L}anguage \underline{M}odels (SAB-LVLM). Specifically, after constructing Hessian matrices for textual and visual inputs, we propose a spatial significance map to distinguish full-precision weights activated under a single modality from those activated across modalities. We then devise a modality-guided integration strategy to obtain the significance-aware binarization map, which measures weight significance across layers and modalities. Subsequently, this binarization map is incorporated into the binarization objective as an error reweighting term, and binarization fitting is performed through an alternating significance-weighted update scheme. Extensive experiments illustrate the superiority of our SAB-LVLM over existing binary PTQ methods under an approximately 1-bit compression constraint. Our code is accessible at https://github.com/LyuQi127/SAB_LVLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAB-LVLM，一种面向大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的二值化方法，通过构建海森矩阵和空间重要性图来衡量不同层和模态下权重的重要性，并设计模态引导的集成策略生成重要性感知二值化图，以约1比特压缩约束下提升二值化性能。
Motivation: 现有LVLM二值化方法忽略了不同层和模态下权重的重要性差异，导致与任务无关的参数被保留而关键模态权重优化不足，造成性能下降。
Method: 构建文本和视觉输入的海森矩阵，提出空间重要性图区分单模态激活与跨模态激活的全精度权重；设计模态引导集成策略得到重要性感知二值化图，作为误差重加权项融入二值化目标，并通过交替重要性加权更新方案进行拟合。
Result: 实验表明，在约1比特压缩约束下，SAB-LVLM优于现有二值化后训练量化（PTQ）方法。
Conclusion: 本文通过重要性感知的二值化方案有效缓解了LVLM二值化中的性能退化问题，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SkillCoach: Self-Evolving Rubrics for Evaluating and Enhancing Agentic Skill-Use
papers.abstract_en: Skills are becoming a reusable operational layer for LLM agents, encoding SOPs, domain rules, tool workflows, scripts, and validation routines. In realistic skill repositories, overlapping skills make reliable skill-use difficult. Final verifier success is too coarse for both evaluation and training, since an agent may pass through trial and error while selecting distractor skills, skipping required steps, composing workflows incorrectly or omitting final checks. We introduce SkillCoach, a self-evolving rubric framework for evaluating and enhancing agentic skill-use. SkillCoach derives skill-grounded process rubrics from real rollouts and evaluates trajectories along four dimensions: skill selection, skill following, skill composition, and skill-grounded reflection. It keeps the external verifier as a separate outcome signal, allowing process quality to be distinguished from accidental task success. The evolved rubrics further serve as process supervision for selecting high-quality training trajectories. Experiments show that evolved rubrics substantially improve evaluation quality, expose failures hidden by final accuracy, and provide stronger supervision signals than outcome-only filtering for enhancing agentic skill-use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkillCoach，一个自演化rubric框架，用于评估和提升LLM代理的技能使用（skill-use）。该框架从真实轨迹中推导出基于技能的流程rubric，从技能选择、技能遵循、技能组合和技能基础反思四个维度评估轨迹，并将外部验证器作为独立的结果信号，区分过程质量与偶然成功。实验表明，演化后的rubric显著提高了评估质量，暴露了最终准确性掩盖的失败，并为增强代理技能使用提供了比仅结果过滤更强的监督信号。
Motivation: 真实的技能库中存在重叠技能，使得可靠的技能使用变得困难。最终验证器的成功对于评估和训练都过于粗糙，因为代理可能通过试错通过，同时选择了干扰技能、跳过必要步骤、错误组合工作流或遗漏最终检查。
Method: SkillCoach框架：从真实轨迹中推导技能基础的流程rubric，沿四个维度（技能选择、技能遵循、技能组合、技能基础反思）评估轨迹，并保持外部验证器作为独立结果信号，以区分过程质量和偶然成功。演化后的rubric进一步作为过程监督，用于选择高质量训练轨迹。
Result: 实验表明，演化后的rubric显著提高了评估质量，暴露了最终准确性隐藏的失败，并为增强代理技能使用提供了比仅结果过滤更强的监督信号。
Conclusion: SkillCoach通过自演化rubric有效评估和提升代理技能使用，过程质量与任务成功分离，提供更细致的监督。

papers.title: Descriptor: LYNRED Mobility Dataset Multimodal Detection Subset (LYNRED-MDS)
papers.abstract_en: Current road safety systems primarily focus on minimizing post-collision damage. However, advances in algorithmic perception are shifting focus toward early collision prediction, especially in lowvisibility conditions like nighttime or fog, where thermal infrared sensing outperforms both human vision and RGB imaging. While available RGB-infrared datasets such as FLIR ADAS and LLVIP are good benchmarks, they mostly consist of clear weather and overly simple scenarios. In this article, we introduce the LYNRED-MDS: Multimodal Detection Subset, a subset of the LYNRED Mobility Dataset, comprised of 4000 RGB-infrared image pairs captured under diverse weather, lighting, and road conditions around Grenoble, France. Our dataset spans varied driving contexts (urban, rural, mountainous, etc.) and a vehicle fleet compliant with Western European standards. Thermal cross-dataset evaluation using a YOLOv8n baseline suggests that our dataset offers strong generalization potential for pedestrian detection in driving scenarios. By covering critical edge cases, our dataset supports the development of more reliable and deployable vision systems for advanced driver-assistance systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了LYNRED-MDS，一个包含4000对RGB-红外图像的多模态检测子集，数据采集于法国格勒诺布尔附近的多样化天气、光照和道路条件，涵盖城市、乡村、山区等驾驶场景。使用YOLOv8n基线进行热红外跨数据集评估，结果表明该数据集在驾驶场景的行人检测中具有较强的泛化潜力，有助于开发更可靠的辅助驾驶视觉系统。
Motivation: 现有RGB-红外数据集（如FLIR ADAS、LLVIP）多为晴朗天气和简单场景，缺乏覆盖边缘案例的多样化数据，难以支持低能见度条件下的早期碰撞预测。
Method: 从LYNRED Mobility数据集中提取4000对RGB-红外图像子集，覆盖多种天气、光照和道路条件，并基于YOLOv8n进行跨数据集评估验证泛化能力。
Result: 摘要报告YOLOv8n基线评估表明，该数据集在行人检测任务上具有强泛化潜力，尤其适用于夜间和雾天等低能见度场景。
Conclusion: 通过覆盖关键边缘场景，该数据集为高级辅助驾驶系统（ADAS）的视觉感知提供了更可靠和可部署的基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CamoNAS: Neural Architecture Search for Enhanced Camouflaged Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Camouflaged Object Detection (COD) aims to locate and segment objects that blend into their surroundings, presenting challenges due to weak edge cues and ill-defined boundaries. Traditional COD models rely on hand-designed architectures and multi-scale feature fusion, which are often guided by intuition rather than systematic search. This paper introduces CamoNAS, a frequency-aware multi-resolution Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework for COD. CamoNAS automatically searches both cell-level operations and network-level downsampling paths, forming a hierarchical search space tailored to detect camouflaged objects. Additionally, it adopts an RGB frequency dual-stream architecture, where a learnable wavelet transform complements the RGB spatial stream. CamoNAS achieves state-of-the-art performance on four COD benchmarks (CAMO, COD10K, NC4K, CHAMELEON), highlighting the effectiveness of NAS for COD. Our code is available at https://github.com/rendaweiSIMIT/CamoNAS.
papers.comment: Published in The Visual Computer. Author manuscript version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CamoNAS是一个面向伪装目标检测（COD）的神经架构搜索（NAS）框架，采用频率感知的多分辨率搜索空间，自动搜索单元级操作和网络级下采样路径。同时引入RGB频率双流架构，用可学习的 wavelet 变换补充空间流。在四个COD基准上达到最新性能。
Motivation: 传统COD模型依赖手工设计和多尺度特征融合，缺乏系统搜索，难以捕捉伪装目标的弱边缘和模糊边界。
Method: 提出CamoNAS，包含层次化搜索空间（单元级操作和网络级下采样路径），以及RGB频率双流架构（可学习小波变换）。
Result: 在CAMO、COD10K、NC4K、CHAMELEON四个基准上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 展示了NAS在伪装目标检测中的有效性，代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: QWERTY: Training-Free Motion Control via Query-Warped Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate high-fidelity and temporally coherent videos, yet motion control remains implicit, primarily relying on text prompts. As a result, achieving desired motion often requires extensive prompt engineering and repeated resampling. While fine-tuning models with additional spatial prompts (e.g., bounding boxes or point trajectories) enables explicit control, it demands substantial data curation and computation, and may compromise the generative capabilities of pretrained models. Consequently, training-free motion control using such spatial prompts has been explored in U-Net-based video diffusion models, but remains largely unexplored for DiTs. We introduce QWERTY, a training-free framework that enables flexible motion control in pretrained image-to-video DiTs via user-defined object warping and optical flow. We carefully manipulate the 3D full attention of DiTs by warping the frame-invariant semantic subspace of queries. We find that the noise predicted by the query-warped DiT naturally guides the diffusion trajectory toward the desired motion, and further show that leveraging this noise as self-guidance for latent optimization improves control stability and visual quality. Experiments show that QWERTY achieves the most effective motion control among existing training-free approaches on a recent image-to-video DiT, with performance comparable to fine-tuning-based methods.
