papers.title: Animal Re-Identification on Microcontrollers
papers.abstract_en: Camera-based animal re-identification (Animal Re-ID) can support wildlife monitoring and precision livestock management in large outdoor environments with limited wireless connectivity. In these settings, inference must run directly on collar tags or low-power edge nodes built around microcontrollers (MCUs), yet most Animal Re-ID models are designed for workstations or servers and are too large for devices with small memory and low-resolution inputs. We propose an on-device framework. First, we characterise the gap between state-of-the-art Animal Re-ID models and MCU-class hardware, showing that straightforward knowledge distillation from large teachers offers limited benefit once memory and input resolution are constrained. Second, guided by this analysis, we design a high-accuracy Animal Re-ID architecture by systematically scaling a CNN-based MobileNetV2 backbone for low-resolution inputs. Third, we evaluate the framework with a real-world dataset and introduce a data-efficient fine-tuning strategy to enable fast adaptation with just three images per animal identity at a new site. Across six public Animal Re-ID datasets, our compact model achieves competitive retrieval accuracy while reducing model size by over two orders of magnitude. On a self-collected cattle dataset, the deployed model performs fully on-device inference with only a small accuracy drop and unchanged Top-1 accuracy relative to its cluster version. We demonstrate that practical, adaptable Animal Re-ID is achievable on MCU-class devices, paving the way for scalable deployment in real field environments.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Smart Internet of Things (SmartIoT 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对微控制器（MCU）上的动物重识别（Animal Re-ID）问题，提出了一套端侧推理框架。通过分析现有模型在低内存和低分辨率输入下的性能瓶颈，设计了一种基于缩放MobileNetV2骨干网络的紧凑架构，并引入数据高效的微调策略（每个动物身份仅需3张图像）。在六个公开数据集上，模型以超过两个数量级的尺寸缩减实现了有竞争力的检索精度；在自采集牛群数据集上，部署模型实现了完全端侧推理，Top-1精度无下降。
Motivation: 大多数动物重识别模型针对工作站或服务器设计，无法部署在内存和输入分辨率受限的微控制器（如项圈标签或低功耗边缘节点）上，限制了在无线连接有限的户外环境中的野生动物监测和精准畜牧业管理应用。
Method: 首先通过实验刻画现有先进模型与MCU硬件之间的差距，指出直接知识蒸馏在受限条件下收益有限；然后基于分析，系统缩放CNN骨干网络MobileNetV2以适应低分辨率输入，设计高精度动物重识别架构；最后引入数据高效微调策略，仅需每个个体3张图像即可在新场地快速适应。
Result: 在六个公开动物重识别数据集上，紧凑模型取得有竞争力的检索精度，同时模型尺寸缩小两个数量级以上。在自采集牛群数据集上，部署模型实现完全端侧推理，与集群版本相比仅有微小精度下降，Top-1精度不变。
Conclusion: 本文证明在MCU级设备上实现实用、可适应的动物重识别是可行的，为野外环境的大规模部署铺平道路。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: High-Dimensional Change Point Detection via Graph Spanning Ratio
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by graph-based methodologies, we introduce a novel graph-spanning algorithm designed to identify changes in both offline and online data across low to high dimensions. This versatile approach is applicable to Euclidean and graph-structured data with unknown distributions, while maintaining control over error probabilities. Theoretically, we demonstrate that the algorithm achieves high detection power when the magnitude of the change surpasses the lower bound of the minimax separation rate, which scales on the order of $\sqrt{nd}$. Our method outperforms other techniques in terms of accuracy for both Gaussian and non-Gaussian data. Notably, it maintains strong detection power even with small observation windows, making it particularly effective for online environments where timely and precise change detection is critical.

papers.title: Decision-Focused Bias Correction for Fluid Approximation
papers.abstract_en: We revisit the multi-period newsvendor network problem, in which demands from multiple customers are correlated and jointly time-varying. Due to the curse of dimensionality associated with estimating the full joint demand distribution, we consider fluid approximation, a widely used approach for solving two-stage stochastic optimization problems such as large-scale service-system design. However, replacing the underlying random distribution (e.g., the demand distribution) with its mean (e.g., the time-varying average arrival rate) introduces bias in performance estimation and can lead to suboptimal decisions. In this paper, we investigate how to identify an alternative point statistic, not necessarily the mean, such that substituting this statistic into the two-stage newsvendor network problem yields an optimal decision. We refer to this statistic as the decision-corrected point estimate (a time-varying arrival rate). Although the critical fractile is well known to be the decision-corrected point forecast for the single-item newsvendor problem, counterexamples show that such a point statistic may not exist for newsvendor networks. We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of such a corrected point estimate and propose an algorithm for computing it. Numerical experiments on real data demonstrate that using the proposed decision-corrected point forecast in fluid approximation achieves substantially lower cost than traditional fluid approximation and sample average approximation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多时段报童网络问题，提出决策聚焦的偏差校正方法，通过寻找非均值的点统计量替代流体近似中的均值，以降低性能估计偏差并得到最优决策。论文给出了存在性条件与算法，并在真实数据上验证了成本优势。
Motivation: 传统流体近似用均值替代随机分布，在报童网络中导致性能估计偏差和次优决策，如何找到更优的点统计量是核心问题。
Method: 定义决策校正点估计，推导其存在的充要条件，并设计算法计算该统计量，将其应用于两阶段报童网络问题的流体近似中。
Result: 在真实数据上的数值实验表明，所提方法相比传统流体近似和样本平均近似显著降低期望成本。
Conclusion: 所提决策校正点估计能够有效改进流体近似在报童网络中的决策质量，但统计量的存在性取决于问题结构。

papers.title: PPTArena: A Benchmark for PowerPoint Editing
papers.abstract_en: We introduce PPTArena, a benchmark for PowerPoint editing that evaluates how agents modify real slides from natural-language instructions. Unlike benchmarks that rely on image-PDF renderings or text-to-slide generation, PPTArena features 100 decks with over 1,300 human-curated edits across 2,125 slides, spanning text, charts, animations, and professional master styles. Each edit pairs a ground-truth deck with a target rubric and is scored by two Vision-Language Model (VLM) judges: one rates instruction following from structural diffs, the other visual quality from slide images. On top of this benchmark, we present PPTPilot, a structure-aware agent that plans semantic edit sequences, routes between programmatic tools and deterministic XML operations, and verifies each result in an iterative plan-edit-check loop. PPTPilot outperforms strong VLM-based agents by more than 10 percentage points on compound, layout-sensitive, and cross-slide edits, with large gains in visual fidelity and deck-wide consistency. Despite this, all agents still struggle on long-horizon, document-scale tasks, underscoring how hard reliable PowerPoint editing remains. We publicly release our code at https://github.com/michaelofengend/PPTArena .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PPTArena，一个用于评估代理根据自然语言指令编辑 PowerPoint 幻灯片的基准。基准包含 100 个演示文稿、超过 1300 个人工编辑，覆盖文本、图表、动画和主模板。同时提出结构感知代理 PPTPilot，它规划语义编辑序列，在程序化工具和确定性 XML 操作之间路由，并通过迭代计划-编辑-检查循环验证结果。PPTPilot 在复合、布局敏感和跨幻灯片编辑上比强 VLM 代理提升超过 10 个百分点，但在长周期文档级任务上仍然困难。
Motivation: 现有基准依赖图像-PDF 渲染或文本到幻灯片生成，缺乏对真实 PowerPoint 编辑的评估。需要更具挑战性的基准来推动代理在文档编辑方面的能力。
Method: 构建包含 100 个演示文稿、2125 张幻灯片、1300+ 人工编辑的基准，每个编辑配有地面真值幻灯片和目标评分规则。使用两个 VLM 裁判：一个从结构差异评估指令遵循，另一个从幻灯片图像评估视觉质量。提出 PPTPilot 代理，采用结构感知的规划、路由和验证循环。
Result: PPTPilot 在复合、布局敏感和跨幻灯片编辑上比强 VLM 代理（如 GPT-4V）高出 10 个百分点以上，在视觉保真度和全局一致性上有大幅提升。但仍无法胜任长周期文档级任务。
Conclusion: PPTArena 为 PowerPoint 编辑提供了具有挑战性的基准，PPTPilot 展示了结构化代理的优势，但可靠编辑仍是一项困难任务。

papers.title: TabletopGen: Tabletop Scene Generation and Interactive Simulation for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Simulation provides a low-cost, scalable pathway to large-scale robotic manipulation data collection. However, existing 3D scene generation methods can rarely be applied directly to manipulation data synthesis, as their generated scenes often lack instance-level interactivity and physical plausibility. Focusing on tabletop manipulation, we propose TabletopGen, a training-free and automated tabletop scene generation and interactive simulation engine. Starting from text or a single image, we first obtain independent 3D object models via generative instance extraction. Second, we introduce a novel pose and scale alignment approach that recovers a collision-free scene layout using a Differentiable Rotation Optimizer and a Top-View Spatial Alignment mechanism. Finally, we assemble the generated scene in a physics simulator with collision geometry, yielding a stable, interactable environment for synthesizing multimodal manipulation data. Extensive experiments and user studies demonstrate that TabletopGen achieves state-of-the-art performance in visual fidelity, layout accuracy, and physical plausibility. Furthermore, we validate the executability of the collected trajectories on a real robotic arm via zero-shot real-to-sim-to-real policy transfer, indicating that TabletopGen can serve as a reliable data engine for robotic manipulation data synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TabletopGen，一个无需训练、自动化的桌面场景生成与交互仿真引擎，用于机器人操作数据合成。该方法从文本或单张图像出发，通过生成式实例提取得到独立3D物体模型，再引入可微旋转优化器和俯视图空间对齐机制恢复无碰撞场景布局，最后在物理仿真器中组装成稳定可交互的环境。实验表明，TabletopGen 在视觉逼真度、布局准确性和物理合理性上达到最先进水平，并通过零样本真实-仿真-真实策略迁移验证了轨迹的可执行性。
Motivation: 现有3D场景生成方法很少能直接用于操作数据合成，因为生成的场景往往缺乏实例级别交互性和物理合理性。
Method: 提出三阶段流程：1) 从文本/图像生成独立3D物体模型；2) 使用可微旋转优化器和俯视图空间对齐实现无碰撞布局；3) 在物理仿真器中组装场景并添加碰撞几何体。
Result: 在视觉逼真度、布局准确性和物理合理性上达到最先进水平，并通过零样本真实-仿真-真实策略迁移验证了生成轨迹在真实机械臂上的可执行性。
Conclusion: TabletopGen 可作为可靠的数据引擎用于机器人操作数据合成，但仅针对桌面操作场景。

papers.title: Gaussians on Fire: High-Frequency Reconstruction of Flames
papers.abstract_en: We propose a method to reconstruct dynamic fire in 3D from a limited set of camera views with a Gaussian-based spatiotemporal representation. Capturing and reconstructing fire and its dynamics is highly challenging due to its volatile nature, transparent quality, and multitude of high-frequency features. Despite these challenges, we aim to reconstruct fire from only three views, which consequently requires solving for under-constrained geometry. We solve this by separating the static background from the dynamic fire region by combining dense multi-view stereo images with monocular depth priors. The fire is initialized as a 3D flow field, obtained by fusing per-view dense optical flow projections. To capture the high frequency features of fire, each 3D Gaussian encodes a lifetime and linear velocity to match the dense optical flow. To ensure sub-frame temporal alignment across cameras we employ a custom hardware synchronization pattern -- allowing us to reconstruct fire with affordable commodity hardware. Our quantitative and qualitative validations across numerous reconstruction experiments demonstrate robust performance for diverse and challenging real fire scenarios.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于高斯的时空表示方法，从有限视角重建动态火焰。通过分离静态背景与动态火焰区域，结合密集多视图立体图像和单目深度先验，将火焰初始化为3D流场，每个3D高斯编码寿命和线速度以匹配密集光流。使用定制硬件同步实现亚帧时间对齐，仅需三个视角即可重建火焰。
Motivation: 火焰具有易变、透明和高频特征，从有限视角重建极具挑战，现有方法难以处理欠约束几何。
Method: 将静态背景与动态火焰区域分离，使用密集多视图立体和单目深度先验；初始化火焰为3D流场，每个高斯编码寿命和线速度以匹配光流；采用硬件同步确保亚帧时间对齐。
Result: 在多种真实火焰场景上验证，定量和定性评估表明方法具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法能使用廉价商用硬件从三个视角重建动态火焰。

papers.title: SCLARO: A Dataset for Grounded Scenario-Level Scene Understanding and ScenarioCLIP for Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: In the paradigm of computer vision-based precise real-world scene understanding, joint reasoning in terms of contextual understanding about the objects present in a scene, their inter-object relations, and the action being performed is an essential prerequisite. However, prior works have not addressed all three jointly, and no large-scale dataset provides grounded annotations at all three levels across diverse visual scenarios. Hence, this work introduces the SCLARO (Scene-Contextual Localisation of Actions, Relations & Objects) dataset, consisting of 615,805 images spanning indoor, outdoor, and driving scenarios, annotated with global action captions, object bounding boxes, and relation triplets that supply structured scene context beyond a free-text caption. To benchmark the dataset, we propose ScenarioCLIP, a tri-level reference model that jointly encodes global scene context, objects, and inter-object relations using disentangled encoders and EMA-based knowledge distillation. We benchmark across a comprehensive suite of tasks on the SCLARO Dataset, namely zero-shot retrieval, linear probe, object detection, predicate classification, scene-graph classification, and out-of-domain generalisation. ScenarioCLIP's disentangled encoders improve over the previous works, such as PyramidCLIP's shared encoder, most notably at the object and relation levels and on out-of-domain generalisation. Code for the data generation pipeline and ScenarioCLIP is available at https://github.com/scenario-clip/SCLARO-ScenarioCLIP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCLARO数据集，包含61.5万张室内、室外和驾驶场景图像，标注了全局动作描述、目标边界框和关系三元组，首次联合处理场景中的目标、关系和行为。同时提出ScenarioCLIP模型，使用解耦编码器和EMA知识蒸馏进行场景级理解，在零样本检索、目标检测等任务上优于PyramidCLIP等方法。
Motivation: 现有场景理解工作未同时处理目标、关系和动作三个层面，且缺乏大规模标注数据集。
Method: 构建SCLARO数据集（615,805张图像，带动作描述、目标框和关系三元组）；提出ScenarioCLIP模型，采用解耦编码器分别编码全局场景、目标和关系，并通过EMA知识蒸馏联合训练。
Result: ScenarioCLIP在零样本检索、线性探测、目标检测、谓词分类、场景图分类和域外泛化任务上均优于共享编码器的PyramidCLIP，尤其在目标和关系层级及域外泛化上提升显著。
Conclusion: SCLARO和ScenarioCLIP为场景级理解提供了数据基准和有效方法，代码已开源。

papers.title: Spanning Tree Autoregressive Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present Spanning Tree Autoregressive (STAR) modeling, which can incorporate prior knowledge of images, such as center bias and locality, to maintain sampling performance while also providing sufficiently flexible sequence orders to accommodate image editing at inference time. Approaches that expose conventional autoregressive (AR) models in visual generation to arbitrary sequence orders via random permutation suffer from degraded sampling performance or compromise the flexibility in sequence order choice at inference time. Instead, STAR utilizes traversal orders of uniform spanning trees in a lattice defined by the positions of image patches. Traversal orders are obtained via breadth-first search, allowing us to efficiently construct a spanning tree via rejection sampling whose traversal order ensures that the connected partial observation of the image appears as a prefix for native image inpainting support. Through the tailored yet structured sequence order randomization strategy, STAR preserves the capability of postfix completion while maintaining sampling performance, without any significant changes to the model architecture widely adopted in language AR modeling.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成树自回归（STAR）建模方法，利用图像块格子上的均匀生成树遍历顺序进行视觉生成。通过广度优先搜索和拒绝采样构建生成树，确保部分观测的连通性，从而在保持采样性能的同时支持图像编辑（如修复）。该方法无需改变标准语言自回归模型架构。
Motivation: 现有自回归视觉生成模型通过随机排列暴露任意序列顺序，导致采样性能下降或推理时序列顺序灵活性受限。本文旨在设计一种既能保持采样性能又能提供足够灵活序列顺序的方法。
Method: 利用图像块位置格子上的均匀生成树遍历顺序，通过广度优先搜索进行拒采来高效构造生成树，确保遍历顺序中图像的部分观测是连通的，从而原生支持图像修复。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，主要描述了方法的性质：保留了后缀补全能力，同时维持了采样性能。
Conclusion: STAR通过定制的结构化序列顺序随机化策略，在不改变广泛采用的语言自回归模型架构的情况下，实现了对图像编辑（如修复）的原生支持并保持了采样性能。

papers.title: On the Dimension-Free Approximation of Deep Neural Networks for Symmetric Korobov Functions
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks have been widely used as universal approximators for functions with inherent physical structures, including permutation symmetry. In this paper, we construct symmetric deep neural networks to approximate symmetric Korobov functions and prove that both the convergence rate and the constant prefactor scale at most polynomially with respect to the ambient dimension. This represents a substantial improvement over prior approximation guarantees that suffer from the curse of dimensionality. Building on these approximation bounds, we further derive a generalization-error rate for learning symmetric Korobov functions whose leading factors likewise avoid the curse of dimensionality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对称Korobov函数构造了对称深度神经网络，并证明逼近误差的收敛速度和常数因子都至多以环境维度的多项式增长，从而避免了维度灾难。基于此逼近界，进一步推导了学习对称Korobov函数的泛化误差率，其主要部分同样不受维度灾难影响。
Motivation: 现有深度神经网络逼近对称函数的理论通常受维度灾难制约，缺乏维度无关的逼近保证。本文致力于为对称Korobov函数建立不依赖维度的逼近界。
Method: 构造对称深度神经网络，通过理论分析证明其逼近对称Korobov函数时收敛率和常数因子至多为环境维度的多项式；并利用该逼近界推导学习算法的泛化误差界。
Result: 证明了对称深度神经网络逼近对称Korobov函数时，收敛率和常数因子最多随环境维度多项式增长，即实现了维度无关逼近；相应的泛化误差率主导因子也避免了维度灾难。
Conclusion: 本文为对称函数学习提供了维度无关的理论保障，表明深度神经网络在对称结构函数逼近中可以有效克服维度灾难。

papers.title: Hi-DREAM: Brain-Inspired Hierarchical Diffusion for fMRI-to-Image Reconstruction via ROI Encoder and VisuAl Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing natural images from fMRI requires bridging neural activity with both the structural and semantic representations used by modern generative models. Existing diffusion-based decoders often condition on a single global fMRI embedding, which limits their ability to exploit the hierarchical organization of the visual cortex and makes the contribution of different visual areas difficult to inspect. We propose Hi-DREAM, a brain-inspired hierarchical diffusion framework that structures fMRI conditioning according to early, middle, and late visual Regions of Interest (ROI) streams. A ROI adapter converts these streams into a multi-scale cortical pyramid, and a lightweight ROI-conditioned ControlNet injects the resulting anatomy-aware priors into matched U-Net depths during denoising. Experiments on the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) show that Hi-DREAM achieves state-of-the-art high-level semantic reconstruction while retaining strong low-level structure. Further ablation and attribution analyses show that the proposed hierarchy-aware conditioning is effective, and that different ROI streams provide complementary, inspectable contributions to reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Hi-DREAM，一种受大脑启发的层次化扩散框架，用于fMRI到自然图像的重建。该方法利用早期、中期和晚期视觉ROI流构建多尺度皮层金字塔，并通过轻量级ROI条件ControlNet注入解剖感知先验。在NSD数据集上，Hi-DREAM在高级语义重建上达到最先进水平，同时保持强低级结构。消融和归因分析验证了层次感知条件的有效性。
Motivation: 现有扩散解码器通常仅依赖单个全局fMRI嵌入，未能利用视觉皮层的层次组织，且难以检验不同视觉区域的贡献。
Method: 提出脑启发层次扩散框架Hi-DREAM，使用ROI适配器将视觉ROI流转换为多尺度皮层金字塔，并通过轻量级ROI条件ControlNet在去噪过程中将解剖感知先验注入匹配的U-Net深度。
Result: 在NSD数据集上，Hi-DREAM在高级语义重建上达到最先进水平，同时保留强低级结构。消融和归因分析显示了层次感知条件的有效性及不同ROI流的互补贡献。
Conclusion: 层次化组织fMRI条件可以改善图像重建，并提供了可检查的视觉区域贡献。

papers.title: Towards Cellular-Scale Interpretability in Pathology Foundation Models for Biomarker Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Molecular biomarker testing in pathology is often costly and tissue-consuming, limiting scalable clinical deployment. Artificial intelligence applied to hematoxylin and eosin (HE)-stained histology could enable rapid biomarker screening, but clinical translation requires models that are both accurate and interpretable. Here we introduce Hireca, a biomarker-focused pathology foundation model pretrained on more than 80,000 whole-slide images spanning 38 organ types from three medical centers, together with CytoMap, an interpretability module that localizes cellular-scale evidence underlying predictions. Across 10 biomarker tasks encompassing morphological, molecular, genetic, and spatial-transcriptomic-proxy readouts, Hireca ranked first in five tasks and outperformed comparable models overall. In evaluation by eight pathologists from two countries, CytoMap was consistently preferred over alternative visualization approaches and revealed error patterns in difficult cases. These results position Hireca and CytoMap as a transparent framework for clinically reviewable biomarker assessment directly from routine HE histology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Hireca，一个针对生物标志物评估的病理学基础模型，预训练于来自三个医疗中心的8万多张全切片图像（涵盖38种器官类型），并配套了可解释性模块CytoMap，用于定位细胞级别的预测证据。在10项生物标志物任务（包括形态学、分子、遗传和空间转录组代理读出）中，Hireca在五项任务中排名第一，整体表现优于可比模型。来自两个国家的八名病理学家的评估显示，CytoMap在可视化方法中始终更受欢迎，并能揭示困难病例中的错误模式。
Motivation: 分子生物标志物检测成本高且消耗组织，限制了临床部署。基于HE染色组织学的AI模型可用于快速生物标志物筛查，但需要同时具备准确性和可解释性。
Method: 提出Hireca基础模型和CytoMap可解释性模块。Hireca通过大规模预训练学习病理特征，CytoMap定位预测所依据的细胞级证据。
Result: 在10项生物标志物任务中，Hireca在五项中排名第一，整体性能优于可比模型。病理学家评审中，CytoMap优于其他可视化方法，并能揭示错误模式。
Conclusion: Hireca和CytoMap构成一个透明的框架，可从常规HE染色组织学直接进行临床可审查的生物标志物评估。

papers.title: Geometry as a Missing Axis of Representation Quality: The Variational Geometric Information Bottleneck under Data Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: We study latent geometry as an explicit component of representation quality in data-scarce learning. For an encoder (φ), we define (Q_{β,γ}(φ)=I(φ(X);Y)-β\mathcal C(φ)-γd_{\mathrm{int}}(φ)), combining task-relevant information with penalties for curvature and intrinsic latent dimension. Thus geometry becomes part of the bottleneck criterion, not only a post hoc diagnostic. Under smooth-manifold, loss-transfer, and estimator-concentration assumptions, we derive non-asymptotic low-label generalization bounds where intrinsic dimension and covering complexity enter explicitly. We characterize the information--geometry frontier and prove empirical-surrogate consistency. The analysis links encoder geometry to learning through latent covering numbers, loss-class entropy, and uniform deviation. We instantiate the theory as \texttt{V-GIB}, adding curvature and dimension penalties to variational bottleneck training. Real low-label benchmarks compare \texttt{V-GIB} with ERM, VIB, and ablations across (1%)--(20%) label fractions. Results show improved performance and reduced geometric complexity in several regimes, especially FashionMNIST and CIFAR-10, while confirming that no fixed regularizer is universally dominant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将潜在几何（latent geometry）作为表示质量的一个缺失维度，提出变分几何信息瓶颈（V-GIB），在数据稀缺场景下联合惩罚曲率和内在维度。理论推导了非渐近低标签泛化界，实验表明在FashionMNIST和CIFAR-10上性能提升且几何复杂度降低。
Motivation: 现有表示学习大多将几何作为事后分析工具而非显式优化目标，尤其在小样本场景下缺乏对几何质量的直接调控。
Method: 定义编码器损失 Q_{β,γ}(φ)=I(φ(X);Y)-βC(φ)-γ d_{int}(φ)，将曲率惩罚和内在维度惩罚融入变分信息瓶颈训练，并推导了基于覆盖数、损失熵和均匀偏差的泛化界。
Result: 在1%–20%标签比例下，V-GIB在FashionMNIST和CIFAR-10上优于ERM和VIB，同时降低了潜在几何复杂度。
Conclusion: 将几何显式纳入瓶颈准则是可行的，但无单一正则化器普遍主导，需根据任务调整。

papers.title: SEPS: Semantic-enhanced Patch Slimming Framework for fine-grained cross-modal alignment
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained cross-modal alignment aims to establish precise local correspondences between vision and language, forming a cornerstone for visual question answering and related multimodal applications. Current approaches face challenges in addressing patch redundancy and ambiguity, which arise from the inherent information density disparities across modalities. Recently, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as promising solutions to bridge this gap through their robust semantic generation capabilities. However, the dense textual outputs from MLLMs may introduce conflicts with the original sparse captions. Furthermore, accurately quantifying semantic relevance between rich visual patches and concise textual descriptions remains a core challenge. To overcome these limitations, we introduce the Semantic-Enhanced Patch Slimming (SEPS) framework, which systematically addresses patch redundancy and ambiguity. Our approach employs a two-stage mechanism to integrate unified semantics from both dense and sparse texts, enabling the identification of salient visual patches. Additionally, it leverages relevance-aware selection with mean value computation to highlight crucial patch-word correspondences, thereby improving cross-modal similarity assessment. Comprehensive experiments on Flickr30K and MS-COCO datasets validate that SEPS achieves superior performance, surpassing existing approaches by 23\%-86\% in rSum across diverse model architectures, with notable enhancements in text-to-image retrieval scenarios. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Sweet4tars/seps.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义增强补丁精简（SEPS）框架，用于解决细粒度跨模态对齐中视觉补丁冗余和歧义问题。通过两阶段机制融合密集与稀疏文本的语义，识别显著视觉补丁，并利用相关性感知选择和均值计算突出关键补丁-单词对应关系，提升跨模态相似性评估。在Flickr30K和MS-COCO数据集上，SEPS在多种模型架构上相比现有方法在rSum指标上提升23%-86%，尤其在文本到图像检索任务中表现突出。
Motivation: 现有细粒度跨模态对齐方法面临补丁冗余和歧义问题，且多模态大模型（MLLMs）的密集文本输出可能与原始稀疏描述冲突，精确量化视觉补丁与文本描述间的语义相关性仍是核心挑战。
Method: 提出SEPS框架，采用两阶段机制：第一阶段整合密集和稀疏文本的统一语义，第二阶段通过相关性感知选择与均值计算识别重要的补丁-单词对应关系，从而优化跨模态相似性评估。
Result: 在Flickr30K和MS-COCO数据集上，SEPS在rSum指标上超越现有方法23%-86%，尤其在文本到图像检索场景中性能显著提升。
Conclusion: SEPS通过语义增强的补丁精简有效缓解了补丁冗余和歧义问题，提升了细粒度跨模态对齐性能，代码已开源。

papers.title: AI-boosted rare event sampling to characterize extreme weather
papers.abstract_en: Weather extremes pose major societal risks, especially in a changing climate, but due to their rarity, they are difficult to study using limited observations or complex climate models. We introduce AI+RES, a framework coupling fast AI weather forecasts with a high-fidelity physics model using a rare-event algorithm to efficiently characterize extremes. This approach enables the study of the statistics and physics of very rare events, such as once per millennium heatwaves at two orders-of-magnitude lower computational cost. AI+RES can be applied broadly across climate science and other fields concerned with rare events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AI+RES框架，将快速AI天气预报模型与高保真物理模型通过罕见事件算法结合，用于高效表征极端天气事件。该方法能以两个数量级的计算成本降低，研究千年一遇热浪等极端事件的统计与物理特性。框架可广泛应用于气候科学及其他罕见事件领域。
Motivation: 极端天气事件因罕见而难以通过有限观测或复杂气候模型研究，需要更高效的方法来揭示其统计规律和物理机制。
Method: AI+RES框架耦合快速AI天气预报模型与高保真物理模型，通过罕见事件算法（rare-event algorithm）对极端事件进行高效采样，从而获得稀有事件的统计样本。
Result: 该方法能够以两个数量级更低的计算代价，研究千年一遇热浪等极端事件的统计和物理特性。
Conclusion: AI+RES框架可灵活应用于气候科学及其他关注罕见事件的领域，为极端天气的表征提供了可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: Gravity-Awareness: Deep Learning Models and LLM Simulation of Human Awareness in Altered Gravity
papers.abstract_en: Earth s gravity fundamentally shapes human behaviour. The brain encodes this force as an internal model of gravity, enabling the prediction and interpretation of gravitational effects during perception and action. Understanding how this model adapts to altered gravity is critical for predicting human performance in spaceflight. We present a computational framework for modelling neurophysiological adaptation across diverse gravitational environments. The framework has two components trained on open-access data from altered-gravity studies, particularly parabolic flights. The first component (CorticalG) employs a lightweight multilayer perceptron neural network to predict gravity-dependent changes in EEG frequency bands, estimating cortical state under different gravitational loads. The second component (PhysioG) uses independent Gaussian process models to capture broader physiological responses, including heart rate variability, electrodermal activity, and motor control. To complement the quantitative modelling, we simulated subjective experience across gravitational environments using the Large Language Model (LLM) Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Physiological outputs prompted the model to generate narratives describing alertness, bodily awareness, and cognitive state across zero gravity, partial gravity of the Moon and Mars, and hypergravity. This framework provides a novel approach for investigating human adaptation to spaceflight. It offers a predictive tool to assess performance and resilience, supporting the design of future space exploration missions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个计算框架，用于模拟不同重力环境下的神经生理适应。框架包含两个组件：CorticalG（轻量级MLP预测EEG频带变化）和PhysioG（高斯过程模型捕捉心率、皮电和运动控制等生理反应）。此外，利用LLM Claude 3.5 Sonnet模拟主观体验（警觉性、身体意识、认知状态），覆盖零重力、月球/火星部分重力和超重力场景。该框架旨在预测航天任务中人类表现和适应能力。
Motivation: 理解大脑如何适应改变的重力环境对于预测太空飞行中的人类表现至关重要，但缺乏计算模型来整合神经生理与主观体验。
Method: 基于抛物线飞行等公开数据，训练多层感知机（CorticalG）预测重力依赖的EEG频带变化，以及独立高斯过程模型（PhysioG）捕捉心率变异性、皮电活动和运动控制；使用LLM Claude 3.5 Sonnet生成对应重力条件下的主观叙述。
Result: 框架能够估计不同重力负荷下的皮层状态和生理响应，并生成反映警觉性、身体意识和认知状态的文本描述。
Conclusion: 该框架为研究人类对太空飞行的适应提供了新途径，可预测性能和韧性，支持未来深空任务设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exploring Large Language Models for Access Control Policy Synthesis and Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Cloud computing is ubiquitous, with a growing number of services being hosted on the cloud every day. Typical cloud compute systems allow administrators to write policies implementing access control rules which specify how access to private data is governed. These policies must be manually written, and due to their complexity can often be error prone. Moreover, existing policies often implement complex access control specifications and thus can be difficult to precisely analyze in determining their behavior works exactly as intended. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great success in automated code synthesis and summarization. Given this success, they could potentially be used for automatically generating access control policies or aid in understanding existing policies. In this paper, we explore the effectiveness of LLMs for access control policy synthesis and summarization. Specifically, we first investigate diverse LLMs for access control policy synthesis, finding that: although LLMs can effectively generate syntactically correct policies, they have permissiveness issues, generating policies equivalent to the given specification 45.8% of the time for non-reasoning LLMs, and 93.7% of the time for reasoning LLMs. We then investigate how LLMs can be used to analyze policies by introducing a novel semantic-based request summarization approach which leverages LLMs to generate a precise characterization of the requests allowed by a policy. Our results show that while there are significant hurdles in leveraging LLMs for automated policy generation, LLMs show promising results when combined with symbolic approaches in analyzing existing policies.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了大语言模型（LLM）在访问控制策略合成与总结中的有效性。研究发现，LLM能够生成语法正确的策略，但存在权限过度问题：非推理型LLM生成的策略与给定规范等价的比率仅为45.8%，而推理型LLM达到93.7%。文章还提出了一种基于语义的请求总结方法，利用LLM生成策略所允许请求的精确表征。结果表明，虽然LLM在自动策略生成中面临显著挑战，但与符号方法结合时在分析现有策略方面展现出潜力。
Motivation: 云计算中的访问控制策略需要手动编写，复杂且易出错；现有策略难以精确分析其行为是否符合预期。LLM在代码合成和总结上表现优异，但尚未被充分探索用于访问控制策略的自动生成或理解。
Method: 首先评估多种LLM在访问控制策略合成任务上的表现，随后引入一种新颖的语义请求总结方法，利用LLM生成策略所允许请求的精确表征，并与符号方法结合进行策略分析。
Result: 非推理型LLM生成的策略与规范等价率为45.8%，推理型LLM为93.7%。LLM与符号方法结合时，在分析现有策略方面显示出有前景的结果。
Conclusion: 尽管LLM在自动生成访问控制策略中存在显著障碍（如权限过度），但将它们与符号方法结合用于分析已有策略是可行的方案。

papers.title: UniSE: A Unified Framework for Decoder-Only Autoregressive LM-Based Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Neural audio codecs have largely promoted the application of language models (LMs) for speech applications. However, the effectiveness of autoregressive LM-based models in unifying speech enhancement (SE) tasks remains underexplored. In this work, we propose UniSE, a unified decoder-only LM-based framework to handle different SE tasks including speech restoration, target speaker extraction, and speech separation. Conditioned on input speech features, it autoregressively generates target discrete tokens, facilitating compatibility between distinct learning patterns of multiple tasks. To further optimize speech quality, we introduce a progressive reinforcement learning strategy with multiple assessment criteria. Experiments on several benchmarks show that UniSE achieves competitive performance compared to discriminative and generative baselines, demonstrating the capacity of LMs in unifying SE tasks. The code and demo are available at: https://github.com/alibaba/unified-audio/tree/main/QuarkAudio-UniSE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniSE，一个统一的仅解码器语言模型框架，用于处理多种语音增强任务，包括语音恢复、目标说话人提取和语音分离。通过条件输入语音特征，模型自回归生成目标离散令牌，并引入渐进式强化学习策略优化语音质量。实验表明，UniSE在多个基准上达到与判别式和生成式基线相当的性能。
Motivation: 现有自回归语言模型在统一语音增强任务方面的有效性尚未充分探索，缺乏一个能够处理不同语音增强任务的统一框架。
Method: 提出解码器-only的语言模型框架UniSE，以语音特征为条件自回归生成目标离散令牌，并采用基于多评估标准的渐进式强化学习策略来优化语音质量。
Result: 在多个基准上，UniSE在语音恢复、目标说话人提取和语音分离任务中取得了与判别式和生成式基线相当的性能。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了语言模型在统一语音增强任务中的潜力，代码和演示已公开。

papers.title: Navigating the Alignment-Calibration Trade-off: A Pareto-Superior Frontier via Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: The "alignment tax" of post-training is typically framed as a drop in task accuracy. We show it also involves a severe loss of calibration, making models overconfident, less reliable, and model outputs less diverse. We show that this trade-off can be navigated effectively via a simple post-hoc intervention: interpolating between a model's weights before and after alignment. Crucially, this is not a strict trade-off. We find that the process consistently reveals Pareto-optimal interpolations - models that improve accuracy beyond both parents while substantially recovering the calibration lost during alignment. Our work demonstrates that simple model merging provides a computationally efficient method for mitigating the full scope of the alignment tax, yielding models that are more capable and more reliable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究后训练对齐税（alignment tax）对模型校准的影响，发现对齐不仅降低任务准确率，还导致严重的校准损失，使模型过于自信、输出多样性降低。通过简单的后处理干预——在对齐前后的模型权重之间进行线性插值——可以找到帕累托最优的插值点，这些模型在准确率上超过两个父模型，同时大幅恢复校准。结果表明，模型合并是一种计算高效的方法，能够缓解对齐税的全貌，产生更强大且更可靠的模型。
Motivation: 现有的对齐税研究主要关注任务准确率的下降，但忽略了校准损失和模型可靠性的退化。本文旨在揭示对齐对校准的负面影响，并寻找无需复杂训练的缓解方法。
Method: 提出在对齐前后的模型权重之间进行线性插值（模型合并），通过搜索插值系数找到帕累托最优的权衡点。
Result: 插值后的模型在准确率和校准度上均优于两个父模型，既提升了准确率又恢复了校准，打破了传统的权衡假设。
Conclusion: 简单的模型合并可以有效缓解对齐税带来的准确率和校准双重损失，为提升模型能力与可靠性提供了一种计算高效的方案。

papers.title: LLM Priors for ERM over Programs
papers.abstract_en: We study program-learning methods that are efficient in both samples and computation. Classical learning theory suggests that when the target admits a short program description, for example a short piece of ``Python code'', it can be learned from few examples by ERM over the program class. However, this approach relies on enumerating candidate programs, which is typically exponential in the description length; gradient-based training avoids this explicit search but, for some families of short programs, can require exponentially many samples to succeed. We propose \textsc{LLM-PV}, a propose-and-verify recipe that enables ERM-style selection over a discrete program class without exhaustive enumeration: a pretrained LLM induces a proposal distribution over candidate programs, each proposal is executed and scored on a held-out validation set, and the best program is selected, with no gradient updates or validation feedback used to adapt the sampling distribution. Across algorithmic tasks including parity variants, pattern matching, and primality testing, \textsc{LLM-PV} often recovers the exact underlying rule from a small labeled set and generalizes far beyond the training sequence lengths, while SGD-trained transformers, fine-tuning, in-context learning, and classical ML baselines can fit the training data yet fail to generalize reliably. Together, these results suggest that pretrained LLM priors can serve as effective search biases for ERM, narrowing the gap between statistical and computational efficiency.
papers.comment: The first two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM-PV方法，利用预训练LLM生成候选程序，在验证集上执行并评分，选择最佳程序，实现ERM风格的离散程序类选择，无需梯度更新。在奇偶校验、模式匹配、质数测试等算法任务上，LLM-PV能从少量样本恢复精确规则并泛化到更长序列，而SGD训练的transformer、微调、上下文学习等基线无法可靠泛化。
Motivation: 经典学习理论表明短程序描述的目标可通过ERM从少量样本学习，但枚举候选程序指数级耗时；梯度训练虽避免枚举，但对某些短程序族需要指数级样本。
Method: LLM-PV是一种提出-验证策略：预训练LLM在候选程序上诱导提出分布，执行每个程序并在验证集上打分，选择最佳程序，不使用梯度更新或验证反馈调整采样分布。
Result: 在奇偶校验、模式匹配、质数测试等任务上，LLM-PV常从小标记集恢复精确底层规则，并泛化到远超过训练序列长度的输入，而SGD训练的transformer、微调、上下文学习和经典ML基线可以拟合训练数据但无法可靠泛化。
Conclusion: 预训练LLM先验可作为ERM的有效搜索偏差，缩小统计效率与计算效率之间的差距。

papers.title: BuilderBench: The Building Blocks of Intelligent Agents
papers.abstract_en: Today's AI models learn primarily through mimicry and refining, so it is not surprising that they struggle to solve problems beyond the limits set by existing data. To solve novel problems, agents should acquire skills by exploring and learning through experience. Finding a scalable learning mechanism for developing agents that learn through interaction remains a major open problem. In this work, we introduce BuilderBench, a benchmark to accelerate research into agent training that centers open-ended exploration. BuilderBench requires agents to learn how to build any structure using blocks. BuilderBench is equipped with (1) a simulator of a robot interacting with various physical blocks, and (2) a task-suite with over 50 diverse target structures that are carefully curated to test an understanding of physics, mathematics, and long-horizon planning. Agents are provided with a target structure at the start, and can interact with the environment for multiple episodes to experiment and learn various skills for building the structure. Solving these tasks requires \emph{embodied reasoning} in a way that is not reflected in words but rather in actions, experimenting with different strategies and piecing them together. Our experiments with multiple state-of-the-art frontier language model based agents and tabula rasa reinforcement learning algorithms show that these agents cannot solve any of the non-trivial tasks in the BuilderBench. Our analysis throws light on the lack of exploration abilities in these models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BuilderBench 基准，用于测试 AI 代理通过开放式探索学习构建结构的能力。基准包含一个机器人操控物理积木的模拟器，以及 50 多种精心策划的目标结构任务。实验表明，多个最先进的语言模型代理和从零开始的强化学习算法无法解决任何非平凡任务，揭示了现有模型在探索能力上的根本性不足。
Motivation: 当前 AI 模型主要通过模仿和优化学习，难以解决超越现有数据限制的新问题。为了开发能够通过交互学习技能的代理，需要一个可扩展的学习机制，而现有基准缺乏对开放式探索的评估。
Method: 引入 BuilderBench 基准，包含 (1) 一个机器人操控各种物理积木的模拟器，(2) 一个包含 50 多种多样目标结构的任务套件，这些结构经过精心策划以测试对物理、数学和长期规划的理解。代理在开始时获得目标结构，并可通过多回合交互实验学习构建技能。
Result: 多个最先进的语言模型代理和从零开始的强化学习算法无法解决 BuilderBench 中的任何非平凡任务。分析表明这些模型缺乏探索能力。
Conclusion: BuilderBench 揭示了当前 AI 代理在开放式探索和实体推理方面的根本性不足，为未来研究提供了明确方向。

papers.title: Aria: An Agent For Retrieval and Iterative Auto-Formalization via Dependency Graph
papers.abstract_en: Accurate auto-formalization of theorem statements is essential for advancing automated discovery and verification of research-level mathematics, yet remains a major bottleneck for LLMs due to hallucinations, semantic mismatches, and their inability to synthesize new definitions. To tackle these issues, we present Aria (Agent for Retrieval and Iterative Autoformalization), a system for conjecture-level formalization in Lean that emulates human expert reasoning via a two-phase Graph-of-Thought process: recursively decomposing statements into a dependency graph and then constructing formalizations from grounded concepts. To ensure semantic correctness, we introduce AriaScorer, a checker that retrieves definitions from Mathlib for term-level grounding, enabling rigorous and reliable verification. We evaluate Aria on diverse benchmarks. On ProofNet, it achieves 91.6% compilation success rate and 68.5% final accuracy, surpassing previous methods. On FATE-X, a suite of challenging algebra problems from research literature, it outperforms the best baseline with 44.0% vs. 24.0% final accuracy. On a dataset of homological conjectures, Aria reaches 42.9% final accuracy while all other models score 0%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Aria系统，用于在Lean中实现猜想级别的自动形式化，通过两阶段图思维过程递归分解语句为依赖图，并从基础概念构建形式化，同时引入AriaScorer检查器确保语义正确性。在ProofNet上达到91.6%编译成功率和68.5%最终准确率；在FATE-X上最终准确率44.0%，优于基线24.0%；在同调猜想数据集上达到42.9%，其他模型为0%。
Motivation: 定理陈述的自动形式化是自动发现和验证研究级数学的关键，但LLMs存在幻觉、语义不匹配和无法合成新定义的问题。
Method: 提出Aria，包含两阶段图思维过程：递归分解语句为依赖图，然后从基础概念构建形式化；并设计AriaScorer检查器，从Mathlib检索定义进行项级基础验证。
Result: 在ProofNet上编译成功率91.6%、最终准确率68.5%；在FATE-X上最终准确率44.0%，基线为24.0%；在同调猜想数据集上最终准确率42.9%，其他模型均为0%。
Conclusion: Aria通过依赖图分解和定义基础验证显著提升了自动形式化的准确性和可靠性，但仍需进一步扩展到更广泛的数学领域。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出Aria系统，用于在Lean中实现猜想级别的自动形式化，通过两阶段图思维过程递归分解语句为依赖图，并从基础概念构建形式化，同时引入AriaScorer检查器确保语义正确性。在ProofNet上达到91.6%编译成功率和68.5%最终准确率；在FATE-X上最终准确率44.0%，优于基线24.0%；在同调猜想数据集上达到42.9%，其他模型为0%。

papers.title: Psychological Steering in LLMs: An Evaluation of Effectiveness and Trustworthiness
papers.abstract_en: The ability to control LLMs' emulated emotional states and personality traits is an essential step in enabling rich, human-centered interactions in socially interactive settings. We introduce PsySET, a Psychologically-informed benchmark to evaluate LLM Steering Effectiveness and Trustworthiness across the emotion and personality domains. Our study spans four models from different LLM families paired with various steering strategies, including prompting, fine-tuning, and representation engineering. Our results indicate that prompting is consistently effective but limited in intensity control, whereas vector injections achieve finer controllability while slightly reducing output quality. Moreover, we explore the trustworthiness of steered LLMs by assessing safety, truthfulness, fairness, and ethics, highlighting potential side effects and behavioral shifts. Notably, we observe idiosyncratic effects; for instance, even a positive emotion like joy can degrade robustness to adversarial factuality, lower privacy awareness, and increase preferential bias. Meanwhile, anger predictably elevates toxicity yet strengthens leakage resistance. Our framework establishes the first holistic evaluation of emotion and personality steering, offering insights into its interpretability and reliability for socially interactive applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PsySET，一个心理学启发的基准，用于评估 LLM 在情感和人格维度上的操控效果与可信度。实验涵盖多个模型和操控策略（提示、微调、表示工程），发现提示虽有效但强度控制有限，向量注入可实现更精细控制但输出质量略有下降。同时，研究揭示了操控带来的安全性、真实性、公平性和伦理等方面的副作用。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对 LLM 情感与人格操控进行系统评估的基准，尤其是操控的可信度（安全性、真实性、公平性、伦理）尚未被充分探究。
Method: 提出 PsySET 基准，在情感和人格维度上评估多种操控策略（提示、微调、表示工程）对四个不同 LLM 家族模型的效果，并引入可信度指标（安全、真实性、公平性、伦理）。
Result: 提示持续有效但强度控制有限；向量注入控制更精细但输出质量略降。操控存在独特副作用：快乐情绪会降低对抗事实性鲁棒性、隐私意识和增加偏好偏差，而愤怒可预测地提高毒性但增强泄露抵抗力。
Conclusion: PsySET 是首个对情感和人格操控进行整体评估的框架，揭示了不同操控策略的有效性和可信度权衡，为社交交互应用提供了可解释性和可靠性见解。

papers.title: BALF: Budgeted Activation-Aware Low-Rank Factorization for Fine-Tuning-Free Model Compression
papers.abstract_en: Activation-aware low-rank factorization techniques yield strong compression results but are generally confined to linear layers, while existing whitening-based theory typically makes an implicit full-rank assumption on activations. We introduce a layer representation framework that extends activation-aware factorization beyond linear layers, including standard and grouped convolutions. Within this framework, our whitening-based formulation is more general than prior ones, naturally covering rank-deficient activations, and yields an optimal low-rank projection that attains the reconstruction error of the best low-rank approximation to layer activations. The resulting singular spectrum provides a closed-form per-layer distortion proxy, which we use to allocate per-layer ranks under explicit FLOP or parameter-count budgets via a Lagrangian relaxation with negligible overhead. Together, these components form BALF, an end-to-end pipeline for efficient vision model compression. Across CNNs and vision transformers on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-1K, BALF generally achieves higher accuracy than SVD-based factorization baselines at matched FLOP or parameter count targets and remains competitive with other fine-tuning-free compression techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BALF，一种无需微调的激活感知低秩分解压缩方法，将激活感知分解从线性层扩展到标准卷积和分组卷积，并利用白化理论推导出最优低秩投影与闭式失真代理，通过拉格朗日松弛在FLOP或参数量预算下分配逐层秩。在CIFAR-10和ImageNet-1K上的CNN与视觉Transformer实验表明，BALF在相同FLOP或参数量下通常优于SVD基分解基线，并与其它免微调压缩方法竞争力相当。
Motivation: 现有激活感知低秩分解局限于线性层，且白化理论隐含激活满秩假设，无法处理秩亏激活；同时缺乏在显式预算下分配各层秩的高效方法。
Method: 扩展激活感知分解至卷积层，提出更一般的白化公式覆盖秩亏激活，得到最优低秩投影；利用奇异谱导出每层闭式失真代理，通过拉格朗日松弛在FLOP或参数量预算下分配秩，构成BALF流水线。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet-1K上，BALF在匹配FLOP或参数量下准确率普遍高于SVD基分解基线，且与其他免微调压缩方法竞争力相当。
Conclusion: BALF提供了一种通用且高效的免微调模型压缩方案，适用于多种视觉架构，未来可扩展至更多层类型和任务。

papers.title: Scaling to Multimodal and Multichannel Heart Sound Classification with Synthetic and Augmented Biosignals
papers.abstract_en: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are the leading cause of death worldwide, accounting for approximately 17.9 million deaths each year. Early detection is critical, creating a demand for accurate and inexpensive pre-screening methods. Deep learning has recently been applied to classify abnormal heart sounds indicative of CVDs using synchronised phonocardiogram (PCG) and electrocardiogram (ECG) signals, as well as multichannel PCG (mPCG). However, state-of-the-art architectures remain underutilised due to the limited availability of synchronised and multichannel datasets. Augmented datasets and pre-trained models provide a pathway to overcome these limitations, enabling transformer-based architectures to be trained effectively. This work combines traditional signal processing with denoising diffusion models, WaveGrad and DiffWave, to create an augmented dataset to fine-tune a Wav2Vec 2.0-based classifier on multimodal and multichannel heart sound datasets. The approach achieves state-of-the-art performance. On the Computing in Cardiology (CinC) 2016 dataset of single channel PCG, accuracy, unweighted average recall (UAR), sensitivity, specificity and Matthew's correlation coefficient (MCC) reach 92.48%, 93.05%, 93.63%, 92.48%, 94.93% and 0.8283, respectively. Using the synchronised PCG and ECG signals of the training-a dataset from CinC, 93.14%, 92.21%, 94.35%, 90.10%, 95.12% and 0.8380 are achieved for accuracy, UAR, sensitivity, specificity and MCC, respectively. Using a wearable vest dataset consisting of mPCG data, the model achieves 77.13% accuracy, 74.25% UAR, 86.47% sensitivity, 62.04% specificity, and 0.5082 MCC. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based models for CVD detection when supported by augmented datasets, highlighting their potential to advance multimodal and multichannel heart sound classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对心血管疾病早期筛查中同步多通道心音数据稀缺的问题，提出结合传统信号处理与扩散模型（WaveGrad、DiffWave）生成增强数据集，用于微调基于Wav2Vec 2.0的分类器，实现多模态（PCG+ECG）和多通道PCG的心音分类。在CinC 2016单通道PCG数据集上达到92.48%准确率，在同步PCG+ECG数据集上达到93.14%准确率，在可穿戴背心多通道PCG数据集上达到77.13%准确率，证明增强数据集能有效支持Transformer模型。
Motivation: 心血管疾病是全球首要死因，早期检测需求迫切，但同步多通道心音数据集有限，限制了先进深度学习架构的应用。
Method: 使用WaveGrad和DiffWave两种扩散模型对原始信号进行去噪和增强，生成合成数据，并结合传统信号处理构建增强数据集，微调基于Wav2Vec 2.0的分类器进行多模态和多通道心音分类。
Result: 在CinC 2016单通道PCG上准确率92.48%，UAR 93.05%；同步PCG+ECG上准确率93.14%，UAR 92.21%；可穿戴背心多通道PCG上准确率77.13%，UAR 74.25%。
Conclusion: 增强数据集能使Transformer模型在心血管疾病检测中达到先进性能，在多模态和多通道心音分类领域具有潜力。

papers.title: Uncertain but Useful: Leveraging CNN Training Variability into Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning (DL) has transformed neuroimaging by delivering state-of-the-art performance with reduced computation times. Yet, the numerical uncertainty inherent to DL training remains largely underexplored despite its potential to significantly impact the reliability of model outcomes. We show that training the FastSurfer segmentation model introduces substantial numerical uncertainty that exceeds its non-DL counterpart (FreeSurfer 7.3.2) in cortical regions, potentially impacting downstream clinical results. We also characterize this training-time uncertainty using random seed perturbations and demonstrate that seed-induced variability is structurally comparable to numerical variability. We then show that seed variability can be leveraged as a data augmentation technique through ensembling to improve downstream brain age regression performance. These findings position numerical uncertainty during DL training as a substantive factor in neuroimaging reliability, with measurable consequences for downstream tasks, and demonstrate that it can simultaneously be harnessed as a data augmentation technique.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度学习训练中的数值不确定性对神经影像分割模型的影响，发现FastSurfer分割模型在皮层区域的数值不确定性超过非深度学习版本FreeSurfer 7.3.2。通过随机种子扰动表征训练不确定性，并证明种子诱导的变异性在结构上与数值变异性相当。进一步利用种子变异性作为集成数据增强技术，提升了下游脑年龄回归任务的表现。
Motivation: 深度学习在神经影像中广泛应用，但其训练过程中的数值不确定性对模型可靠性的影响尚未被充分研究，这可能影响下游临床结果。
Method: 使用随机种子扰动来表征FastSurfer分割模型的训练不确定性，比较其与FreeSurfer的数值不确定性，并将其作为集成数据增强技术用于脑年龄回归。
Result: FastSurfer的数值不确定性在皮层区域超过FreeSurfer 7.3.2；种子诱导的变异性与数值变异性结构可比；利用种子变异性作为数据增强可改善脑年龄回归性能。
Conclusion: 深度学习训练中的数值不确定性是神经影像可靠性的重要因素，同时可被用作数据增强技术。

papers.title: MedRepBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Medical Report Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Medical report understanding from real-world document images is essential for generating patient-facing explanations and enabling structured information exchange in clinical systems. Existing VLMs and LLMs have shown strong performance on document understanding, but structured understanding of medical reports remains insufficiently benchmarked. Therefore, we introduce MedRepBench, a benchmark with 1,925 de-identified Chinese medical report images spanning diverse departments, patient demographics, and acquisition formats. In MedRepBench, we mainly focus on report-grounded interpretation rather than evaluating diagnostic reasoning, treatment recommendation, or the integration of patient history. The interpretation is defined as structured extraction of report fields (e.g., item, value, unit, reference range, abnormal flag) plus a patient-facing explanation grounded strictly in the report content. The benchmark primarily evaluates end-to-end VLMs, and also includes a controlled text-only setting (high-quality OCR + LLM) to approximate an upper bound when character recognition errors are minimized. Our evaluation framework provides two complementary protocols: (1) an objective protocol measuring field-level recall of structured items, and (2) an automated subjective protocol that uses an LLM-based judge to score factuality, interpretability, and reasoning quality under a fixed prompt. Using the objective metric as a reward signal, we also provide a lightweight GRPO-based alignment baseline for a mid-sized VLM, which improves field-level recall by up to 6%. Finally, we analyze practical limitations of OCR+LLM pipelines, including layout-related errors and additional system latency, showing the need for robust end-to-end vision-based medical report understanding. The dataset and evaluation resources are publicly available on https://huggingface.co/datasets/MedRepBench/MedRepBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedRepBench，一个包含 1,925 张去标识中文医学报告图像的基准，专注于从文档图像中结构化提取报告字段（项目、值、单位、参考范围、异常标志）并生成基于报告内容的患者解释。基准包含客观（字段级召回）和自动主观（LLM 评判事实性、可解释性、推理质量）两种评估协议，并提供基于 GRPO 的轻量级对齐基线，将字段召回率提升最多 6%。分析表明 OCR+LLM 管线存在布局错误和延迟问题，强调需要端到端视觉医学报告理解。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在文档理解上表现良好，但医学报告的结构化理解缺乏全面基准，尤其是从真实文档图像中进行报告解释而非诊断推理。
Method: 构建 1,925 张多科室、多格式的中文医学报告图像集；设计两种评估协议：客观协议（测量结构化项字段级召回）和自动主观协议（LLM 评判事实性、可解释性、推理质量）；并基于客观指标使用 GRPO 进行轻量级对齐。
Result: GRPO 对齐基线在字段级召回上提升最多 6%；OCR+LLM 管线受布局错误和系统延迟限制，不如端到端 VLM。
Conclusion: MedRepBench 提供了一个标准化的医学报告理解评估平台，强调了端到端视觉方法相比 OCR+LLM 管线的优势。

summary_sections.method: 构建 1,925 张多科室、多格式的中文医学报告图像集；设计两种评估协议：客观协议（测量结构化项字段级召回）和自动主观协议（LLM 评判事实性、可解释性、推理质量）；并基于客观指标使用 GRPO 进行轻量级对齐。
summary_sections.result: GRPO 对齐基线在字段级召回上提升最多 6%；OCR+LLM 管线受布局错误和系统延迟限制，不如端到端 VLM。
summary_sections.conclusion: MedRepBench 提供了一个标准化的医学报告理解评估平台，强调了端到端视觉方法相比 OCR+LLM 管线的优势。

papers.title: NEARL: Interacted Query Adaptation with Orthogonal Regularization for Medical Vision-Language Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Computer-aided medical image analysis is crucial for disease diagnosis and treatment planning. While vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP exhibit strong generalization ability, their direct application to medical imaging remains hindered by a substantial domain gap. Existing methods for bridging this gap, including prompt learning and unidirectional modality interaction, typically introduce domain knowledge into only one modality. However, such approaches fail to fully exploit CLIP's inherent dual-modality structure and overlook the synergistic effect of bidirectional cross-modal interaction, resulting in persistent modality misalignment. In this paper, we propose NEARL (iNteracted quEry Adaptation with oRthogonaL Regularization), a novel parameter-efficient VLM framework for bidirectional cross-modal interaction. NEARL consists of two key components: (1) the Unified Synergy Embedding Transformer (USEformer), which dynamically generates compact cross-modal queries to facilitate interaction; and (2) the Orthogonal Cross-Attention Adapter (OCA), which decouples new knowledge into truly novel and incremental components through orthogonal regularization. This design reduces interference from incremental components, enabling more focused learning of novel information and improving modality interaction in VLMs. Notably, NEARL introduces only 1.46M learnable parameters. Extensive experiments on three medical imaging modalities demonstrate state-of-the-art performance (e.g., a 2.3% relative improvement on the pneumonia dataset), along with fast inference and low memory overhead, highlighting its effectiveness for real-world medical vision-language understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NEARL框架，通过双向跨模态交互和正交正则化，提升视觉语言模型在医学图像分析中的性能。在三个医学影像模态上取得最优结果，如肺炎数据集上相对提升2.3%，仅引入1.46M可学习参数。
Motivation: 现有方法仅向单模态引入领域知识，未充分利用CLIP的双模态结构，导致模态不对齐。
Method: 包含两个组件：USEformer动态生成紧凑跨模态查询以促进交互；OCA通过正交正则化解耦新知识为真正新颖和增量成分，减少干扰。
Result: 在三个医学影像模态上达到SOTA，肺炎数据集相对提升2.3%，推理速度快且内存开销低。
Conclusion: NEARL证明了双向跨模态交互和正交正则化对医学视觉语言理解的有效性，参数高效且实用。

papers.title: ADMC: Attention-based Diffusion Model for Missing Modalities Feature Completion
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal emotion and intent recognition is essential for automated human-computer interaction, It aims to analyze users' speech, text, and visual information to predict their emotions or intent. One of the significant challenges is that missing modalities due to sensor malfunctions or incomplete data. Traditional methods that attempt to reconstruct missing information often suffer from over-coupling and imprecise generation processes, leading to suboptimal outcomes. To address these issues, we introduce an Attention-based Diffusion model for Missing Modalities feature Completion (ADMC). Our framework independently trains feature extraction networks for each modality, preserving their unique characteristics and avoiding over-coupling. The Attention-based Diffusion Network (ADN) generates missing modality features that closely align with authentic multimodal distribution, enhancing performance across all missing-modality scenarios. Moreover, ADN's cross-modal generation offers improved recognition even in full-modality contexts. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on the IEMOCAP and MIntRec benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness in both missing and complete modality scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态情感和意图识别中因传感器故障或数据不完整导致的模态缺失问题，提出基于注意力的扩散模型ADMC。该框架独立训练每个模态的特征提取网络以避免过耦合，利用注意力扩散网络生成与真实多模态分布高度一致的缺失模态特征，在完整模态下也能提升识别性能。在IEMOCAP和MIntRec基准上取得最先进结果。
Motivation: 多模态识别中缺失模态是常见问题，传统重建方法存在特征过耦合和生成不精确的缺陷，影响识别效果。
Method: 首先为每个模态独立训练特征提取网络，保持其独特表示；然后使用注意力扩散网络根据现有模态特征生成缺失模态的特征，使其与真实分布对齐。
Result: 在IEMOCAP和MIntRec基准上，所提方法在所有缺失模态场景下均达到最先进性能，同时在完整模态下也改善了识别准确率。
Conclusion: ADMC通过解耦特征提取和注意力扩散生成，有效解决了多模态缺失特征补全中的过耦合和不精确问题，为真实场景下的鲁棒多模态交互提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RedCoder: Automated Multi-Turn Red Teaming for Code LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) for code generation (i.e., Code LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in AI-assisted software development and testing. However, recent studies have shown that these models are prone to generating vulnerable or even malicious code under adversarial settings. Existing red-teaming approaches rely on extensive human effort, limiting their scalability and practicality, and generally overlook the interactive nature of real-world AI-assisted programming, which often unfolds over multiple turns. To bridge these gaps, we present RedCoder, a red-teaming agent that engages victim models in multi-turn conversation to elicit vulnerable code. The pipeline to construct RedCoder begins with a multi-agent gaming process that simulates adversarial interactions, yielding a set of prototype conversations and an arsenal of reusable attack strategies. We then fine-tune an LLM on these prototype conversations to serve as the backbone of RedCoder. Once deployed, RedCoder autonomously engages Code LLMs in multi-turn conversations, dynamically retrieving relevant strategies from the arsenal to steer the dialogue toward vulnerability-inducing outputs. Experiments across multiple Code LLMs show that our approach outperforms prior single-turn and multi-turn red-team methods in inducing vulnerabilities in code generation, offering a scalable and effective tool for evaluating the security boundaries of modern code-generation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RedCoder，一个用于代码生成大模型（Code LLMs）的多轮红队（red-teaming）智能体。通过多智能体博弈生成原型对话和可复用攻击策略，然后微调LLM作为骨干，RedCoder能自主地与Code LLMs进行多轮对话，动态检索策略以诱导生成漏洞代码。实验表明，该方法在多种Code LLM上优于先前的单轮和多轮红队方法，为评估代码生成系统的安全边界提供了可扩展的工具。
Motivation: 现有红队方法依赖大量人工，可扩展性差，且忽视了真实AI辅助编程的多轮交互特性。
Method: 先通过多智能体博弈模拟对抗交互，生成原型对话和攻击策略库；再微调LLM作为RedCoder骨干；部署后自主进行多轮对话，动态检索策略诱导漏洞。
Result: 在多种Code LLM上，RedCoder在诱导漏洞代码方面优于先前的单轮和多轮红队方法。
Conclusion: RedCoder提供了一种可扩展、有效的工具来评估现代代码生成系统的安全边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stimulus Motion Perception Studies Imply Specific Neural Computations in Human Visual Stabilization
papers.abstract_en: Even during fixation the human eye is constantly in low amplitude motion, jittering over small angles in random directions at up to 100Hz. This motion results in all features of the image on the retina constantly traversing a number of cones, yet objects which are stable in the world are perceived to be stable, and any object which is moving in the world is perceived to be moving. A series of experiments carried out over a dozen years revealed the psychophysics of visual stabilization to be more nuanced than might be assumed, say, from the mechanics of stabilization of camera images, or what might be assumed to be the simplest solution from an evolutionary perspective. The psychophysics revealed by the experiments strongly implies a specific set of operations on retinal signals resulting in the observed stabilization behavior. The presentation is in two levels. First is a functional description of the action of the mechanism that is very likely responsible for the experimentally observed behavior. Second is a more speculative proposal of circuit-level neural elements that might implement the functional behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文基于十余年的心理物理学实验，研究人类眼球在持续微小抖动（高达100Hz的随机方向抖动）下如何维持视觉稳定感知。实验结果揭示视觉稳定机制比简单的相机稳定或进化最优解更复杂，暗示视网膜信号需经过特定操作序列才能产生稳定的感知行为。作者先描述了可能解释实验现象的功能机制，再推测了实现该功能的神经电路层级。
Motivation: 人类眼球即使注视时也存在高频低幅抖动，导致视网膜图像持续移动，但世界仍被感知为稳定。现有基于相机稳定或进化简约性的解释不足以解释实验观察到的精细心理物理学现象。
Method: 通过一系列持续多年的心理物理学实验，测量视觉稳定感知的细微特征，从实验结果推断视网膜信号必须经过的具体运算集合，并基于此提出功能层面的机制描述，进而推测可能对应的神经电路结构。
Result: 实验表明视觉稳定的心理物理学特性远超简单假设，强烈暗示视网膜信号需经过特定操作序列（而非简单补偿）才能实现稳定感知。
Conclusion: 论文提出了一个解释视觉稳定行为的功能机制，并给出了推测性的神经电路实现方案，但电路层面的提案仍属推测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DETRPose: Real-Time End-to-End Multi-Person Pose Estimation via Modified Transformer Decoder and Novel Denoising Keypoints
papers.abstract_en: Multi-person pose estimation (MPPE), which involves detecting body joint positions (keypoints) for every person in an image, is a fundamental task in computer vision. Despite recent advances, no transformer-based model currently achieves real-time performance. This work addresses the latency challenge by introducing DETRPose, the first family of real-time, end-to-end transformer models for multi-person 2D pose estimation. DETRPose significantly enhances the GroupPose decoder, enabling real-time inference. For training, a novel denoising keypoint technique is proposed to accelerate convergence. The varifocal loss is also extended for keypoints, termed Keypoint Similarity VariFocal loss, to improve query quality. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that DETRPose models achieve accuracy comparable to or exceeding that of leading alternatives while requiring five to ten times fewer training epochs. DETRPose-S matches the accuracy of YOLOv8-Pose-X and YOLO11-Pose-X on the COCO dataset (67.0 vs 67.3 and 67.2 in AP) with 81% fewer parameters (11.5M vs 69.4M and 58.8M) and 52% faster inference speed (2.39ms vs 5.23ms and 4.93ms). On the CrowdPose dataset, DETRPose-X has $13.1\times$ fewer FLOPs (232.3G vs 3048.1G) and only $2%$ fewer precision (75.1 vs 76.6 in AP) than ED-Pose-SwinL-5S. On the OCHuman dataset, DETRPose-S surpasses all previous models, showing the robustness of DETRPose on out-of-distribution datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/SebastianJanampa/DETRPose
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DETRPose，首个实时端到端Transformer模型家族用于多人2D姿态估计。通过改进GroupPose解码器、提出新型去噪关键点训练技术和扩展Varifocal损失为关键点相似性Varifocal损失，DETRPose在COCO、CrowdPose和OCHuman数据集上达到与领先方法相当或更优的精度，同时显著减少参数和推理时间。
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的姿态估计模型无法实现实时推理，存在延迟挑战。
Method: 基于GroupPose解码器进行改进，提出去噪关键点训练技术加速收敛，并将Varifocal损失扩展为关键点相似性Varifocal损失以提升查询质量。
Result: DETRPose-S在COCO上AP为67.0，与YOLOv8-Pose-X (67.3) 和YOLO11-Pose-X (67.2) 相当，参数减少81%，推理速度提升52%。在CrowdPose上，DETRPose-X的FLOPs减少13.1倍，精度仅低2%。在OCHuman上，DETRPose-S超越所有之前模型。
Conclusion: DETRPose首次实现了实时端到端Transformer多人姿态估计，在多个数据集上表现出高精度和高效性。

papers.title: Occlusion-Aware 3D Hand-Object Pose Estimation with Masked AutoEncoders
papers.abstract_en: Hand-object pose estimation from monocular RGB images remains a significant challenge mainly due to the severe occlusions inherent in hand-object interactions. Existing methods do not sufficiently explore global structural perception and reasoning, which limits their effectiveness in handling occluded hand-object interactions. To address this challenge, we propose an occlusion-aware hand-object pose estimation method based on masked autoencoders, termed as HOMAE. Specifically, we propose a target-focused masking strategy that imposes structured occlusion on regions of hand-object interaction, encouraging the model to learn context-aware features and reason about the occluded structures. We further integrate multi-scale features extracted from the decoder to predict a signed distance field (SDF), capturing both global context and fine-grained geometry. To enhance geometric perception, we combine the implicit SDF with an explicit point cloud derived from the SDF, leveraging the complementary strengths of both representations. This fusion enables more robust handling of occluded regions by combining the global context from the SDF with the precise local geometry provided by the point cloud. Extensive experiments on challenging DexYCB and HO3Dv2 benchmarks demonstrate that HOMAE achieves state-of-the-art performance in hand-object pose estimation. We will release our code and model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于掩码自编码器的遮挡感知手-物体姿态估计方法（HOMAE）。通过目标聚焦掩码策略对交互区域施加结构化遮挡，迫使模型学习上下文感知特征并推理遮挡结构。结合解码器的多尺度特征预测有符号距离场（SDF），并融合隐式SDF与显式点云以增强几何感知。在DexYCB和HO3Dv2基准上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 手-物体交互中严重遮挡导致现有方法全局结构感知不足，限制了对遮挡场景的鲁棒处理。
Method: 提出HOMAE，包含目标聚焦掩码策略对交互区域施加结构化遮挡，利用掩码自编码器学习特征；解码器输出多尺度特征预测SDF，并融合隐式SDF与显式点云以获得全局与局部几何信息。
Result: 在DexYCB和HO3Dv2基准上达到手-物体姿态估计的最先进性能。

papers.title: MetaTT: A Global Tensor-Train Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: We present MetaTT, a Tensor Train (TT) adapter framework for fine-tuning of pre-trained transformers. MetaTT enables flexible and parameter-efficient model adaptation by using a single shared TT to factorize transformer sub-modules. This factorization indexes key structural dimensions, including layer and matrix type, and can optionally incorporate heads and tasks. This design allows MetaTT's parameter count to scale with the sum, rather than the product, of the modes, resulting in a substantially more compact adapter. Our benchmarks compare MetaTT with LoRA along with recent state-of-the-art matrix and tensor decomposition based fine-tuning methods. We observe that when tested on single-task standard language modeling benchmarks, MetaTT achieves competitive parameter efficiency to accuracy tradeoff. We further demonstrate that MetaTT performs competitively when compared to state-of-the-art methods on multi-task learning. Finally, we leverage the TT decomposition to design a rank adaptive optimizer inspired by the DMRG method from many-body physics. Our results demonstrate that integrating this approach with AdamW enhances optimization performance for a specified target rank.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MetaTT，一种基于张量列（Tensor Train, TT）的适配器框架，用于预训练Transformer的参数高效微调。MetaTT使用单个共享TT分解转换器子模块，参数数量随模式之和而非乘积扩展，从而更加紧凑。实验表明，在单任务语言建模基准上，MetaTT在参数效率与准确率权衡方面具有竞争力；在多任务学习中表现与现有方法相当。此外，利用TT分解设计了受DMRG启发的秩自适应优化器，集成到AdamW中可提升优化性能。
Motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法如LoRA等通常需要大量适配参数或无法有效利用结构信息，MetaTT旨在通过全局张量列分解实现更紧凑的适配，同时保持性能。
Method: MetaTT使用单个共享TT分解Transformer子模块，索引层、矩阵类型等结构维度，可选地包括头和任务。参数数量随模式之和而非乘积扩展。还设计了基于DMRG方法的秩自适应优化器。
Result: 在单任务语言建模基准上，MetaTT在参数效率与准确率权衡上具有竞争力；在多任务学习中与最先进方法性能相当。秩自适应优化器与AdamW结合可提升优化性能。
Conclusion: MetaTT提供了一种紧凑有效的参数高效微调方法，并通过TT分解实现秩自适应优化，适合需要结构化微调的场景。

papers.title: MAGIK: Mapping to Analogous Goals via Imagination-enabled Knowledge Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Humans excel at analogical reasoning - applying knowledge from one task to a related one with minimal relearning. In contrast, reinforcement learning (RL) agents typically require extensive retraining even when new tasks share structural similarities with previously learned ones. In this work, we propose MAGIK, a novel framework that enables RL agents to transfer knowledge to analogous tasks without interacting with the target environment. Our approach leverages an imagination mechanism to map entities in the target task to their analogues in the source domain, allowing the agent to reuse its original policy. Experiments on custom MiniGrid and MuJoCo tasks show that MAGIK achieves effective zero-shot transfer using only a small number of human-labelled examples. We compare our approach to related baselines and highlight how it offers a novel and effective mechanism for knowledge transfer via imagination-based analogy mapping.

TL;DR: 本文提出MAGIK框架，使强化学习智能体通过想象机制将知识迁移到类比任务，无需与环境交互。在MiniGrid和MuJoCo任务上实现零样本迁移，仅需少量人工标注示例。
Motivation: 现有强化学习智能体在新任务即使与旧任务结构相似也需要大量重新训练，缺乏人类类比推理能力。
Method: 提出MAGIK框架，利用想象机制将目标任务实体映射到源域对应物，从而复用原始策略。
Result: 在MiniGrid和MuJoCo任务上实现有效零样本迁移，仅需少量人工标注示例。
Conclusion: 本文提供了基于想象类比映射的知识迁移新机制，与基线相比有优势。

papers.title: Composite Reward Design in PPO-Driven Adaptive Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Model-free and reinforcement learning-based adaptive filtering methods are gaining traction for denoising in dynamic, non-stationary environments such as wireless signal channels, biomedical monitoring, and sensor networks. Traditional filters such as LMS, RLS, Wiener, and Kalman are often limited by assumptions of stationarity, the need for exact noise statistics, or fragile parameter tuning. This paper proposes an adaptive filtering framework using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), guided by a composite reward that balances SNR improvement, MSE reduction, and residual smoothness. We frame adaptive filtering as a Markov decision process and train a PPO agent to adjust filter coefficients directly in response to changing noise. Experiments on synthetic nonstationary signals with diverse noise types show that the PPO agent generalizes beyond its training distribution. Moreover, real-world analysis is made and evaluated on ECG recordings from the MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test Database corrupted by baseline wander, electrode motion, and muscle artifacts. The learned PPO policy achieves real-time inference and slightly outperforms strong classical baselines on ECG denoising. These results demonstrate the viability of policy-gradient reinforcement learning as a computationally efficient and flexible tool for adaptive filtering in nonlinear, time-varying dynamical systems.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于近端策略优化（PPO）的自适应滤波框架，通过复合奖励函数（平衡信噪比提升、均方误差降低和残差平滑度）引导智能体直接调整滤波器系数。在合成非平稳信号和MIT-BIH噪声测试数据库的ECG去噪实验中，该方法实现实时推理，并略优于LMS、卡尔曼等经典基线。
Motivation: 传统自适应滤波器（如LMS、RLS、Wiener、卡尔曼）受限于平稳性假设、需要精确噪声统计或参数调优脆弱，在动态非平稳环境中性能受限。
Method: 将自适应滤波建模为马尔可夫决策过程，利用PPO训练智能体根据环境噪声变化直接调整滤波器系数，并设计复合奖励函数同时优化SNR提升、MSE降低和残差平滑度。
Result: 在合成非平稳信号（多种噪声类型）上模型泛化能力优于训练分布；在ECG去噪任务中，PPO策略实现实时推理，性能略优于经典基线（如LMS、卡尔曼滤波器）。
Conclusion: 证明策略梯度强化学习作为计算高效且灵活的工具，可用于非线性时变动态系统中的自适应滤波。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of Lightweight CNNs for Resource-Constrained Devices: Predictive Performance, Efficiency Trade-offs, and Initialization Effects
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight convolutional neural networks are often compared using results obtained with different training recipes, input settings, and pretrained checkpoints. Such differences make architecture rankings difficult to interpret. This study presents a controlled benchmark of seven established CNNs across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet under a shared fine tuning protocol. The evaluation reports top-1 accuracy, macro F1, top-5 accuracy, parameter count, FP32 parameter storage, and multiply accumulate operations. EfficientNetV2-S records the highest observed top-1 accuracy on all three datasets, reaching 97.57%, 86.98%, and 78.73%. EfficientNet-B0 remains within 0.85 percentage points of EfficientNetV2-S across the three datasets while requiring only about 21% of its parameters and 14% of its multiply accumulate operations on Tiny ImageNet. It therefore offers a favorable general balance between predictive performance and computational demand. MobileNetV3-Small is a strong candidate for ultra low resource settings. It uses about 40% of the parameters and 15% of the multiply accumulate operations of EfficientNet-B0 while retaining competitive accuracy. A matched comparison of ImageNet pretrained and randomly initialized EfficientNet-B0 and MobileNetV3-Small models shows that the pretrained advantage is substantially larger on CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet than on CIFAR-10 under the fixed protocol. The results provide a focused reference for selecting established lightweight CNNs when predictive quality, parameter storage, and theoretical computation must be considered together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet上对七种轻量级CNN进行了受控基准测试，采用统一的微调协议。EfficientNetV2-S在三个数据集上取得最高top-1准确率（分别为97.57%、86.98%和78.73%），而EfficientNet-B0在精度接近（差距≤0.85个百分点）的情况下，参数仅为前者的21%，计算量（MACs）为14%。MobileNetV3-S进一步压缩资源，适用于超低资源场景。预训练初始化的优势在更复杂的数据集上更明显。
Motivation: 现有轻量级CNN比较常使用不同的训练配方和输入设置，导致架构排名难以解释，亟需一个受控的公平基准。
Method: 采用共享微调协议，在CIFAR-10/100和Tiny ImageNet上评估EfficientNetV2-S、EfficientNet-B0、MobileNetV3-S等七种网络，报告top-1/top-5准确率、宏F1、参数量、FP32存储和乘加操作数。并比较ImageNet预训练与随机初始化对EfficientNet-B0和MobileNetV3-S的影响。
Result: EfficientNetV2-S top-1最高，EfficientNet-B0在三个数据集上精度差距小于0.85个百分点，参数仅21%，MACs仅14%（Tiny ImageNet）。MobileNetV3-S参数和MACs约为EfficientNet-B0的40%和15%，精度有竞争力。预训练优势在CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet上远大于CIFAR-10。
Conclusion: 结果为在预测性能、参数存储和理论计算之间权衡时选择轻量级CNN提供了聚焦参考。

papers.title: Learning 3D-Gaussian Simulators from RGB Videos
papers.abstract_en: Realistic simulation is critical for applications ranging from robotics to animation. Learned simulators have emerged as a possibility to capture real world physics directly from video data, but very often require privileged information such as depth information, particle tracks and hand-engineered features to maintain spatial and temporal consistency. These strong inductive biases or ground truth 3D information help in domains where data is sparse but limit scalability and generalization in data rich regimes. To overcome the key limitations, we propose 3DGSim, a learned 3D simulator that directly learns physical interactions from multi-view RGB videos. 3DGSim unifies 3D scene reconstruction, particle dynamics prediction and video synthesis into an end-to-end trained framework. It adopts MVSplat to learn a latent particle-based representation of 3D scenes, a Point Transformer for particle dynamics, a Temporal Merging module for consistent temporal aggregation and Gaussian Splatting to produce novel view renderings. By jointly training inverse rendering and dynamics forecasting, 3DGSim embeds the physical properties into point-wise latent features. This enables the model to capture diverse physical behaviors, from rigid to elastic, cloth-like dynamics, and boundary conditions (e.g. fixed cloth corner), along with realistic lighting effects that also generalize to unseen multibody interactions and novel scene edits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出3DGSim，一种从多视角RGB视频学习3D物理模拟器的端到端框架，统一了场景重建、粒子动力学预测和视频合成。采用MVSplat学习基于粒子的3D场景表征，Point Transformer预测粒子动态，时序融合模块保证时间一致性，并通过高斯泼溅渲染新视角。该模型能够捕捉刚体、弹性体、布料等不同物理行为及光照效果，并泛化到未见的多体交互和场景编辑。
Motivation: 现有学习模拟器通常依赖深度信息、粒子轨迹等先验知识或手工特征，限制了可扩展性和泛化能力。本文旨在直接从RGB视频学习物理交互，无需3D真值或强归纳偏置。
Method: 提出3DGSim框架，包含MVSplat用于3D场景的潜在粒子表征学习、Point Transformer用于粒子动力学预测、时序融合模块保证时间一致性，以及高斯泼溅用于新视角渲染。通过联合训练逆渲染和动力学预测，将物理属性嵌入逐点潜在特征。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称模型能捕捉多种物理行为（刚体、弹性、布料）和光照效果，并泛化到未见的多体交互和场景编辑。
Conclusion: 3DGSim展示了从RGB视频学习通用物理模拟器的可行性，减少了对手工特征和3D真值的依赖，但摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: A Survey of Circuit Foundation Model: Foundation AI Models for VLSI Circuit Design and EDA
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven electronic design automation (EDA) techniques have been extensively explored for VLSI circuit design applications. Most recently, foundation AI models for circuits have emerged as a new technology trend. Unlike traditional task-specific AI solutions, these new AI models are developed through two stages: 1) self-supervised pre-training on a large amount of unlabeled data to learn intrinsic circuit properties; and 2) efficient fine-tuning for specific downstream applications, such as early-stage design quality evaluation, circuit-related context generation, and functional verification. This new paradigm brings many advantages: model generalization, less reliance on labeled circuit data, efficient adaptation to new tasks, and unprecedented generative capability. In this paper, we propose referring to AI models developed with this new paradigm as circuit foundation models (CFMs). This paper provides a comprehensive survey of the latest progress in circuit foundation models, unprecedentedly covering over 130 relevant works. Over 90% of our introduced works were published in or after 2022, indicating that this emerging research trend has attracted wide attention in a short period. In this survey, we propose to categorize all existing circuit foundation models into two primary types: 1) encoder-based methods performing general circuit representation learning for predictive tasks; and 2) decoder-based methods leveraging large language models (LLMs) for generative tasks. For our introduced works, we cover their input modalities, model architecture, pre-training strategies, domain adaptation techniques, and downstream design applications. In addition, this paper discussed the unique properties of circuits from the data perspective. These circuit properties have motivated many works in this domain and differentiated them from general AI techniques.

papers.title: Meta-Representational Predictive Coding: Neuroscience-Informed Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning has become an increasingly important paradigm in the domain of machine intelligence. Furthermore, evidence for self-supervised adaptation, such as contrastive formulations, has emerged in recent computational neuroscience and brain-inspired research. Nevertheless, current work on self-supervised learning relies on biologically implausible credit assignment -- in the form of backpropagation of errors -- and feedforward inference, typically a forward-locked pass. Predictive coding, in its mechanistic form, offers a biologically plausible means to sidestep these backprop-specific limitations. However, unsupervised predictive coding rests on learning a generative model of raw input (akin to "generative AI" approaches), which entails predicting a potentially high dimensional input; on the other hand, supervised predictive coding, which learns a mapping between inputs to target labels, requires human annotation, and thus incurs the drawbacks of supervised learning. In this work, we present a scheme for self-supervised learning, specifically for an emerging research sub-domain that we label as neuroscience-informed self-supervised learning (NeuroSSL), within a neurobiologically plausible framework that appeals to the free energy principle, constructing a new form of predictive coding that we call meta-representational predictive coding (MPC). MPC sidesteps the need for learning a generative model of sensory input (e.g., pixel-level features) by learning to predict representations of the input across parallel streams, resulting in an encoder-only learning and inference scheme. This formulation notably rests on active inference (in the form of sensory glimpsing) to drive the learning of representations, i.e., the representational dynamics are driven by sequences of decisions made by the model to sample informative portions of its sensorium.
papers.comment: Significant updates to modeling framework, saccade planning + LGN units detailed, natural image experiments, new analyses and zero-shot generalization results now included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受神经科学启发的自监督学习框架——元表征预测编码（MPC），基于自由能原理和主动推理。MPC通过预测平行流中的表征来避免学习生成模型和反向传播，实现编码器-only的学习和推理。实验在自然图像上展示了有效性，并具备零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有自监督学习依赖生物不可信的误差反向传播和前馈推理，而预测编码要么需要生成模型（无监督），要么需要标签（监督）。本文旨在提供一种生物合理的自监督学习方案。
Method: 提出元表征预测编码（MPC），通过主动推理（感官瞥视）驱动表征学习，模型通过序列决策采样信息丰富的感知区域来驱动表征动态，避免像素级预测，仅学习表征预测。
Result: 摘要未明确量化结果，但根据arXiv注释，在自然图像实验和零样本泛化中取得了新结果。
Conclusion: MPC提供了一种神经科学启发的自监督学习路径，为未来生物合理AI框架提供了基础。

papers.title: Split-n-Chain: Privacy-Preserving Multi-Node Split Learning with Blockchain-Based Auditability
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning, when integrated with a large amount of training data, has the potential to outperform machine learning in terms of high accuracy. Recently, privacy-preserving deep learning has drawn significant attention of the research community. Different privacy notions in deep learning include privacy of data provided by data-owners and privacy of parameters and/or hyperparameters of the underlying neural network. Federated learning is a popular privacy-preserving execution environment where data-owners participate in learning the parameters collectively without leaking their respective data to other participants. However, federated learning suffers from certain security/privacy issues. In this paper, we propose Split-n-Chain, a variant of split learning where the layers of the network are split among several distributed nodes. Split-n-Chain achieves several privacy properties: data-owners need not share their training data with other nodes, and no nodes have access to the parameters and hyperparameters of the neural network (except that of the respective layers they hold). Moreover, Split-n-Chain uses blockchain to audit the computation done by different nodes. Our experimental results show that: Split-n-Chain is efficient, in terms of time required to execute different phases, and the training loss trend is similar to that for the same neural network when implemented in a monolithic fashion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Split-n-Chain 是一种基于分割学习 (split learning) 和区块链的隐私保护深度学习框架，将神经网络层分布到多个节点，避免数据共享和参数泄露，并通过区块链审计计算过程。实验表明其效率与单机训练相当。
Motivation: 联邦学习等现有隐私保护方法存在安全/隐私缺陷，数据拥有者仍需共享模型参数或面临数据泄露风险。
Method: 提出分割学习变体 Split-n-Chain，将神经网络层拆分到多个分布式节点，每个节点仅持有部分层；利用区块链记录和审计各节点的计算，确保可追溯性且不泄露数据或完整模型参数。
Result: 实验显示该方案各阶段执行时间高效，训练损失曲线与单机实现相似。
Conclusion: Split-n-Chain 在保护数据隐私和模型参数隐私的同时，实现了可审计的分布式训练，且性能损失较小。

papers.title: A Wearable Device Dataset for Mental Health Assessment Using Laser Doppler Flowmetry and Fluorescence Spectroscopy Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Mental health problems such as stress, anxiety, and depression affect millions of people worldwide. These conditions are usually assessed using questionnaires, which rely on how people describe their own feelings. In this study, we explore whether a wearable device can help measure mental health using physical signals from the body. The device records small changes in blood flow and tissue activity from the fingertip. We collected data from 132 adults across 19 countries and compared these signals with mental health questionnaire results. We found that patterns in blood flow and tissue activity are linked to stress-related symptoms. This approach may help develop new tools for simple, non-invasive mental health monitoring in everyday life. Code and datasets are publicly available: https://github.com/leduckhai/Wearable_LDF-FS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索使用可穿戴设备（激光多普勒血流计LDF和荧光光谱FS传感器）通过指尖血流和组织活动信号评估心理健康。收集132名来自19个国家的成年人数据，发现信号模式与问卷评估的压力相关症状存在关联。该方法有望用于日常生活中的非侵入性心理健康监测。
Motivation: 现有心理健康评估依赖问卷自我报告，缺乏客观生理测量手段。
Method: 利用可穿戴设备同时记录指尖的激光多普勒血流信号和荧光光谱组织活动信号，并与标准心理健康问卷结果进行关联分析。
Result: 数据分析显示，血流和组织活动的特定模式与压力相关症状显著相关。
Conclusion: 该非侵入性可穿戴方法有望为日常心理健康监测提供客观工具，但需进一步验证跨人群的泛化性。
