papers.title: AI Assistance for Human Review of Default Judgments
papers.abstract_en: Overwhelmed courts in the United States review millions of default judgments each year. Unfortunately, such manual reviews are time-consuming and prone to error. In an audit of 188 debt collection cases granted default judgment by the Superior Court of Los Angeles, we find that 4% contained major defects that should have entirely prevented default judgment, 10% contained inconsistencies requiring reduced judgments, and 32% contained errors requiring amendment prior to judgment. To support courthouses in default judgment review, we collaborated with courthouse attorneys and judges in designing a Default Assistant. The Default Assistant employs large language models to evaluate a case with respect to predetermined legal requirements and provide cited recommendations for an expert user's review. We equip users to verify these recommendations by grounding the assistant's explanations in cited quotes and tables from the original case filings. We conduct a controlled study with 66 law students that conservatively simulates court review, with more time and resources than court staff. We nevertheless find users aided by the Default Assistant were 6.0% more accurate on the average requirement than unaided reviewers (p < 1.0e-4). Simultaneously, users were 25.9% faster in reviewing the average requirement than unaided reviewers (p < 2.5e-10). Statutory requirements demanding extensive document search realized the largest gains, with error reductions and time savings from AI assistance up to 62% and 34%, respectively, relative to unassisted user performance and with differences statistically significant (p < 0.05). Our work provides a proof-of-concept that AI assistants with citations have the potential to help resource-constrained courts conduct default judgment review more accurately and efficiently.

papers.title: Beyond Detection: Redesigning Assessment and Governande of Generative AI at the Universidad Politécnica de Madrid (UPM)
papers.abstract_en: Universities have responded to generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in noticeably different ways, both internationally and within Spain. So far, the dominant reaction has been defensive, this is, most institutions frame the debate around AI detection, plagiarism, academic integrity and a presumed drop in student effort, prioritizing basic training for academic staff over students. Other group of pioneering universities is doing the opposite, pursuing deeper adoption, and assuming that any policy built on prevention or sanction will not hold. This paper sides with that second view. Obsessing about detection is a dead end, since generated text is increasingly hard to distinguish from human writing, and detectors still misfire too often to be trusted. What universities need instead is a coordinated effort to set clear, course-by-course rules for GenAI use, redesign assessment toward authentic and interdisciplinary assessment that fosters critical thinking and learner autonomy, and build a serious AI-literacy programme that treats students as critical co-creators rather than passive users. The challenge, though, is not only pedagogical. Adoption at university scale also raises organisational, technical, operational, legal and economic questions that have to be solved together. In this context, the Universidad Politécnica de Madrid (UPM) is developing a strategic and sustainable AI policy and adoption framework structured around six dimensions, in which AI functions as an enabler of student autonomy and pedagogical innovation rather than as a threat to be policed.

TL;DR: 本文讨论大学如何应对生成式人工智能（GenAI），反对以检测和惩罚为主的防御性策略，主张通过重新设计评估方式、建立明确的课程规则、提升AI素养来将GenAI整合到教学中。马德里理工大学（UPM）正在制定一个基于六个维度的战略框架，将AI视为学生自主性和教学创新的推动者。
Motivation: 当前多数大学对GenAI的反应是防御性的，聚焦于检测抄袭和学术诚信，但检测工具不可靠且已陷入死胡同。需要一种新的方法，将GenAI视为教育工具而非威胁。
Method: 提出一个重新设计评估和治理的框架，包括：逐课程制定GenAI使用规则、转向真实性和跨学科评估、建立AI素养项目，以及从组织、技术、运营、法律和经济等多维度协调推进。
Result: 论文描述UPM正在开发一个六维战略框架，但未提供具体实验或量化结果。
Conclusion: 大学应放弃对检测的执念，通过系统性的政策、评估改革和AI素养教育，将GenAI转化为促进批判性思维和学习自主性的工具。

papers.title: How Indian Dermatologists are Utilizing Artificial Intelligence for Clinical Practice and Workflow Management: A Nationwide Survey with a Special Focus on atopic dermatitis
papers.abstract_en: Background: Dermatology AI has mainly focused on image-based diagnosis, while chronic disease workflows have received less attention. We surveyed Indian dermatologists to map routine clinical challenges, with a focus on atopic dermatitis (AD), and assess current AI use. Methods: A nationwide cross-sectional survey commissioned by the Society for Eczema Studies included 377 practicing Indian dermatologists. The survey assessed clinical challenges, AD workflow barriers, AI use, adoption barriers, and ethical concerns. Analyses used descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, false discovery rate correction, and multivariable logistic regression. Results: Patient adherence (61.3%) and treatment planning in difficult or refractory cases (57.0%) were reported more often than diagnostic uncertainty (48.0%). In AD care, severity scoring was reported as a challenge by 47.7% and had the lowest satisfaction among measured workflow areas. Current AI use was reported by 49.9%, most often involving general large language models for literature synthesis, documentation, and academic tasks rather than specialized image analysis. Barriers differed by experience: dermatologists with more than 20 years of practice more often cited lack of training, while those with 5 years or less more often cited lack of clinical utility after trying AI tools. AI users were more likely than non-users to report concern about patient self-misdiagnosis and anxiety, which remained significant after adjustment for experience and academic affiliation. Conclusion: Respondents reported using general-purpose AI mainly for cognitive and administrative tasks, while their clinical needs centered on chronic disease management and AD workflow support. Clinician-supervised workflow tools may be more useful than standalone diagnostic applications.

TL;DR: 本文通过全国横断面调查377名印度皮肤科医生，评估他们在临床实践和工作流程管理中利用人工智能（AI）的现状，重点关注特应性皮炎（AD）。结果显示，近半数受访者使用通用大语言模型处理文献综合、文档和学术任务，而非专业图像分析；临床挑战主要集中在患者依从性和难治病例治疗计划上，而非诊断不确定性。调查还发现AI使用障碍与医生经验相关，AI使用者更担忧患者自我误诊和焦虑。
Motivation: 现有皮肤科AI研究多聚焦于图像诊断，而针对慢性病工作流程的支持关注不足。本研究旨在系统了解印度皮肤科医生在临床实践中的实际挑战和AI使用情况，特别是特应性皮炎（AD）管理中的痛点。
Method: 采用全国横断面调查，由湿疹研究学会委托，纳入377名执业印度皮肤科医生。问卷评估临床挑战、AD工作流程障碍、AI使用、采用障碍和伦理问题，使用描述性统计、卡方检验、错误发现率校正和多变量逻辑回归分析。
Result: 49.9%的受访者报告使用AI，主要是通用大语言模型；临床挑战中患者依从性（61.3%）和难治病例治疗计划（57.0%）比诊断不确定性（48.0%）更常见；AD护理中严重程度评分被47.7%视为挑战且满意度最低；AI使用者更担忧患者自我误诊和焦虑，此关联在调整经验和学术背景后仍显著。
Conclusion: 印度皮肤科医生主要将通用AI用于认知和管理任务，而临床需求集中于慢性病管理和AD工作流程支持；临床医生监督的工作流工具可能比独立诊断应用更有实用价值。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有皮肤科AI研究多聚焦于图像诊断，而针对慢性病工作流程的支持关注不足。本研究旨在系统了解印度皮肤科医生在临床实践中的实际挑战和AI使用情况，特别是特应性皮炎（AD）管理中的痛点。
summary_sections.method: 采用全国横断面调查，由湿疹研究学会委托，纳入377名执业印度皮肤科医生。问卷评估临床挑战、AD工作流程障碍、AI使用、采用障碍和伦理问题，使用描述性统计、卡方检验、错误发现率校正和多变量逻辑回归分析。
summary_sections.result: 49.9%的受访者报告使用AI，主要是通用大语言模型；临床挑战中患者依从性（61.3%）和难治病例治疗计划（57.0%）比诊断不确定性（48.0%）更常见；AD护理中严重程度评分被47.7%视为挑战且满意度最低；AI使用者更担忧患者自我误诊和焦虑，此关联在调整经验和学术背景后仍显著。
summary_sections.conclusion: 印度皮肤科医生主要将通用AI用于认知和管理任务，而临床需求集中于慢性病管理和AD工作流程支持；临床医生监督的工作流工具可能比独立诊断应用更有实用价值。

papers.title: Collaborative Disagreement Resolution for Scalable Oversight
papers.abstract_en: Debate, where AI agents argue opposing positions, has emerged as a key approach to scalable oversight. However, debate faces a fundamental tension: models are incentivized to be persuasive to the judge, which may not always align with epistemic honesty. In this work, we propose an alternative paradigm: disagreement resolution, which reframes the interaction mechanism from adversarial debate to collaborative truth seeking. Drawing on principles from human mediation and conflict resolution, where mediators facilitate dialogue to help disputing parties reach consensus rather than adjudicating between them, we design an automated pipeline that adapts these strategies to AI oversight. Unlike standard debate where models argue for fixed positions, our pipeline directs models to collaboratively identify points of disagreement, examine the evidence for conflicting claims, and converge toward consensus or isolate the specific ''crux'' of their disagreement. We find that Disagreement Resolution consistently helps non-expert models identify the truth, achieving 62.1% judging accuracy compared to 49.2% for standard debate. Our results provide encouraging empirical evidence for rethinking the scalable oversight protocol from adversarial persuasion to collaborative truth-seeking.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to ICML 2026. Codebase link: https://github.com/ChicagoHAI/collaborative-dr.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种替代传统辩论的可扩展监督范式——分歧解决（Disagreement Resolution），将AI代理的交互从对抗性辩论转变为协作性真理论证。通过模拟人类调解中的对话促进共识或识别分歧核心，实验表明该方法使非专家模型的判断准确率达到62.1%，显著优于标准辩论的49.2%。
Motivation: 现有基于辩论的可扩展监督方法存在模型为说服评委而牺牲认知诚实的根本矛盾，需要一种更协作的替代机制。
Method: 设计自动化管道，借鉴人类调解与冲突解决策略，引导模型协作识别分歧点、检查证据，并收敛至共识或孤立分歧的“症结”。
Result: 在非专家模型判断任务上，分歧解决达到62.1%的准确率，而标准辩论仅为49.2%。
Conclusion: 该结果为从对抗性说服转向协作性真理论证的可扩展监督协议提供了实证支持。

papers.title: Structuring the Space of Sociotechnical Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Sociotechnical alignment concerns the social desirability of AI behavior and is thus inherently normative, not merely technical. While NLP research increasingly addresses its technical aspects, it often leaves underspecified what such "social desirability" entails. We argue that this reflects a fundamental gap: the absence of a systematic way to specify how sociotechnical alignment defines, justifies, and evaluates socially desirable AI behavior. To address this gap, we introduce a human-centered framework for specifying sociotechnical alignment. We draw on social-scientific accounts of sociobehavioral desirability to ground the basis for behavioral desirability judgments and use this framework to analyze how alignment is specified in practice. Our systematic literature review identifies recurring patterns: normative concepts grounding desirability judgments are often unspecified or conflated with alignment targets for (desired) system behavior, target populations are underdefined, and design choices are rarely theoretically justified. These findings point to a lack of conceptual specificity that limits cumulative progress. We therefore offer recommendations that link social-scientific frameworks to alignment design choices, supporting more conceptually precise approaches to sociotechnical alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出社会技术对齐（sociotechnical alignment）领域缺乏系统性的规范方法来定义、论证和评估AI行为的“社会合意性”。作者引入了一个以人为中心的框架，基于社会科学对行为合意性的论述，并通过系统文献综述揭示了现有实践中规范性概念未明确、目标人口定义不清、设计选择缺乏理论依据等问题。最后提供了将社会科学框架与对齐设计选择相连接的建议，以支持更概念精确的方法。
Motivation: 当前NLP研究虽日益关注社会技术对齐的技术方面，但对其核心概念“社会合意性”的界定往往不充分，缺乏系统性的规范方法，阻碍了领域的累积性进展。
Method: 提出一个以人为中心的框架，借鉴社会科学的规范概念来制定行为合意性判断的基础，并利用该框架对现有对齐规范实践进行系统文献综述分析。
Result: 系统综述发现普遍模式：规范性概念常未明确或与对齐目标混淆，目标人群定义不足，设计选择很少得到理论辩护。
Conclusion: 本文呼吁增加概念精确性，通过连接社会科学框架与对齐设计选择来推动社会技术对齐研究。

papers.title: A Practice Auditing Framework for Large Language Model Use: Collective Empiricism, Pseudo-Rational Cognition, and Governance of AI-Generated Content
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used for knowledge acquisition, code generation, academic writing, and agent-based automation. In these settings, users may obtain highly structured answers, plans, and judgments without sufficient domain practice. This paper proposes a practice auditing framework for LLM use and AI-generated content governance. It introduces collective empiricism to describe how LLMs compress and reorganize large-scale human experience into outputs that appear empirical and rational, and pseudo-rational cognition to describe how users may mistake AI-generated structured expression for their own rational understanding. The paper analyzes AI subjectivity illusion, subjectivity structures in input materials, template loops in AI-AI conversations, statistical misjudgment in AIGC detection, and memory pollution when generated content enters future contexts, long-term memory, retrieval spaces, or agent skill systems. To reduce these risks, the paper proposes an auditing process based on requirement definition, problem-boundary identification, evidence-source auditing, practical validation, reverse questioning, logging, version management, rollback, and renewed cognition. The framework does not reject AI productivity; it argues that LLM outputs should be returned to verifiable, reproducible, and intervenable processes of practice. The paper provides a conceptual and auditable framework for cognitive risks in LLM interaction, AI-generated content governance, long-term memory systems, and human-AI interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对大语言模型（LLM）使用的实践审计框架，引入集体经验主义（collective empiricism）和伪理性认知（pseudo-rational cognition）概念，分析AI主观性幻觉、模板循环、统计误判、记忆污染等风险，并给出基于需求定义、问题边界识别、证据源审计等步骤的审计流程。
Motivation: 用户可能从LLM获取看似经验且理性的输出，却缺乏足够的领域实践，导致认知偏差和风险。
Method: 提出实践审计框架，包含概念分析（集体经验主义、伪理性认知）和一系列审计步骤（需求定义、问题边界识别、证据源审计、实践验证、反向提问、日志记录、版本管理、回滚、认知更新）。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，而是给出概念框架和风险评估。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在将LLM输出回归到可验证、可复现、可干预的实践过程，不否定AI生产力。

papers.title: LLMs as Teaching Assistants for Mathematics Exam Grading: Reliability, and Practical Usability
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended mathematics exams are valuable because they assess reasoning, proof construction, algorithmic thinking, and communication of intermediate steps. They are also difficult to grade at scale because instructors must apply partial-credit rubrics consistently while giving feedback that helps students repair misconceptions. This paper evaluates six contemporary large language model (LLM) configurations, Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended, Gemini 3.5 Flash, ChatGPT 5.5 Pro Extended, ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking, Claude Pro Opus 4.7, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, as grading assistants for an undergraduate discrete mathematics examination. The study compares two grading policies. The BASELINE policy uses a stricter rubric-following prompt that emphasizes explicit evidence and complete justification. The LIBERAL policy was added after preliminary grading showed that the baseline condition sometimes applied harsh point deductions and failed to recognize valid partial reasoning. Agreement with human grading is measured at both the question and exam-total levels using mean absolute error, root mean squared error, normalized root mean squared error, Pearson correlation, and exact agreement. The results show that liberal partial-credit prompting reduces average question-level error for every evaluated model family. ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking (LIBERAL) has the lowest average question-level MAE (1.87) and RMSE (2.53), while Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (LIBERAL) has the lowest total-score MAE (8.00) and RMSE (10.66). However, the strongest total-score Pearson correlation occurs under Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (BASELINE) at 0.58, showing that point calibration and rank preservation remain distinct goals. We also report practical usability observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估六种当代大语言模型（LLM）作为本科离散数学考试评分助手的可靠性与实用性。比较了两种评分策略：严格遵循评分标准的BASELINE策略和更宽松的LIBERAL策略。结果表明，LIBERAL策略能降低所有模型的题目级误差，其中ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking (LIBERAL) 的题目级平均绝对误差（MAE）最低（1.87），而Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (LIBERAL) 的总分MAE最低（8.00）。但最强的总分皮尔逊相关性出现在Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (BASELINE) 下（0.58），说明分数校准与排名保持仍是不同目标。
Motivation: 开放式数学考试能评估推理和证明能力，但大规模评分时需一致应用部分评分标准并提供反馈，现有LLM在此场景下的可靠性未经系统检验。
Method: 收集六种LLM配置（Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended等）在离散数学考试上的评分结果，对比两种提示策略：BASELINE（严格遵循评分标准）和LIBERAL（更宽松地认可部分推理），并使用MAE、RMSE、皮尔逊相关系数等指标与人工评分比较。
Result: LIBERAL策略在所有模型上降低了题目级误差；ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking (LIBERAL) 取得最低题目级MAE (1.87) 和RMSE (2.53)；Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (LIBERAL) 取得最低总分MAE (8.00) 和RMSE (10.66)；但总分皮尔逊相关性最高为Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (BASELINE) 的0.58。
Conclusion: LLM有潜力作为数学考试评分助教，但点校准与排名保持难以同时优化；LIBERAL策略更符合人类评分习惯，但准确性仍有提升空间。

papers.title: Office Comprehension Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Office Comprehension Bench (OCB), the first public benchmark to jointly evaluate LLM systems on Word, Excel, and PowerPoint comprehension over native file formats (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) and their variants. OCB consists of two tracks. File Fidelity Q&A tests structural and visual perception of office artifacts - tables, charts, embedded images, formulas, and app-specific elements such as headers, speaker notes, and named ranges. Domain Q&A tests expert-level reasoning grounded in real-world industry documents across 12 professional domains, with queries requiring multi-step analysis and synthesis across documents. Each reference answer is decomposed into atomic, binary-gradable claims, and an ensemble of LLM judges scores responses against each claim independently. Even the strongest frontier system in its default reasoning mode reaches only about 59.3% on Domain Q&A; increasing thinking depth within a tier does not move performance materially, while moving to a higher product tier yields modest gains. We release the dataset, evaluation tooling, judge prompt, and a public leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Office Comprehension Bench (OCB)，这是首个公开的用于评估LLM系统对Word、Excel、PowerPoint原生文件格式（.docx、.xlsx、.pptx）理解能力的基准。OCB包含两个任务：文件保真度问答（测试对表格、图表、嵌入图像、公式等结构和视觉感知）和领域问答（基于12个专业领域真实行业文档的专家级推理）。即使最强的前沿系统在默认推理模式下，领域问答准确率也仅约59.3%。作者公开了数据集、评估工具、裁判提示和排行榜。
Motivation: 当前缺乏公开基准来全面评估LLM对办公文档（Word、Excel、PowerPoint）原生格式的理解能力，尤其是涉及结构、视觉元素和专业领域推理的综合评估。
Method: 构建包含两个轨道的基准：文件保真度问答（测试结构和视觉感知）和领域问答（测试基于真实行业文档的专家级多步推理）。将参考答案分解为原子化的二元可评分声明，并使用集成LLM裁判独立评分每个声明。
Result: 最强前沿系统在默认推理模式下在领域问答上仅达到约59.3%；在同一产品层级内增加思考深度不会显著提升性能，升级到更高产品层级只有小幅改进。
Conclusion: OCB揭示了当前LLM在办公文档理解上的局限性，并提供了标准化评估工具。作者公开了数据集和评估代码以促进该方向的研究。

summary_sections.result: 最强前沿系统在默认推理模式下在领域问答上仅达到约59.3%；在同一产品层级内增加思考深度不会显著提升性能，升级到更高产品层级只有小幅改进。
summary_sections.conclusion: OCB揭示了当前LLM在办公文档理解上的局限性，并提供了标准化评估工具。作者公开了数据集和评估代码以促进该方向的研究。

papers.title: ExPerT: Personalizing LLM Responses to Users' Domain Expertise via Query-Wise Semantic and Keystroke Behavioral Cues
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by end users, yet existing personalization methods relying on static profiles or text-only signals fail to capture query-specific expertise variation. We present ExPerT, a query-wise personalization framework that adapts LLM responses to users' query domain expertise by combining semantic and behavioral cues. ExPerT consists of two key components: (i) a semantic-behavioral expertise inference module that jointly interprets query text and keystroke dynamics via in-context LLM prompting, and (ii) an expertise-conditioned response generation that adapts the level of detail, terminology, and conceptual complexity. Our user study with 40 participants and 1270 queries demonstrated that ExPerT reduced expertise inference error by 65.7% compared to the strongest baseline (MAE = 0.398 vs. 1.162) and improved response satisfaction by 17.52% (from 3.71 to 4.36) on a 5-point Likert scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ExPerT，一个查询级别的个性化框架，通过结合语义和击键行为线索推断用户对特定查询的领域专业知识，并据此调整 LLM 回答的详细程度、术语和概念复杂度。用户研究表明，与最强基线相比，专业知识推断误差降低了 65.7%，回答满意度提升了 17.52%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 个性化方法依赖静态用户档案或纯文本信号，无法捕获查询特定的专业知识变化，导致对同一用户不同查询的响应缺乏适应性。
Method: ExPerT 包含两个关键组件：语义-行为专业知识推理模块，通过上下文 LLM 提示联合解释查询文本和击键动态；专业知识条件化的响应生成，根据推断的专业知识水平调整详细程度、术语和概念复杂度。
Result: 在 40 名参与者和 1270 个查询的用户研究中，ExPerT 将专业知识推断误差（MAE）从 1.162 降至 0.398（降低 65.7%），并将 5 点 Likert 量表上的回答满意度从 3.71 提高到 4.36（提升 17.52%）。
Conclusion: 结合查询文本和击键行为线索可以有效推断用户对特定查询的领域专业知识，并显著提升个性化 LLM 响应质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mapping Text to Multiplex Graph: Prompt Compression as Lévy Walk-Guided Graph Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Existing prompt compression methods treat text as flat token sequences, failing to capture the distributed nature of important information, which is often spread across multiple locations and connected through both local syntactic dependencies and global semantic relations. Such relational structure is naturally represented as a graph, where tokens or sentences become nodes and their dependencies become edges. To this end, we propose RAGP, which formulates prompt compression as Redundancy-Aware Graph Pruning on a multiplex graph that jointly models fine-grained attention-based dependencies and coarse-grained semantic relations. To efficiently identify non-redundant nodes in this heterogeneous structure (dense local subgraphs and sparse global connections), we employ Levy walks whose heavy-tailed step distribution naturally balances local exploitation with global exploration. Experiments on LongBench show that RAGP achieves an average score of 49.3 under a 4x compression ratio, outperforming existing LLM-based compression methods, such as LongLLMLingua, which attains 48.8 at a 3x compression ratio. Besides, RAGP also surpasses state-of-the-art vision-based text compression paradigms on multiple tasks. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RAGP-B0CB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAGP，将提示压缩视为多层图上的冗余感知图剪枝，利用Levy游走的重尾步长分布在密集局部子图和稀疏全局连接中高效识别非冗余节点。在LongBench上，4倍压缩比下平均得分49.3，优于现有基于LLM的压缩方法如LongLLMLingua（3倍压缩比下48.8）。
Motivation: 现有提示压缩方法将文本视为扁平token序列，无法捕捉重要信息在多个位置分布并通过局部句法依赖和全局语义关系连接的结构，这种关系自然表示为图。
Method: 提出RAGP，将提示压缩公式化为多层图上的冗余感知图剪枝，联合建模细粒度注意力依赖和粗粒度语义关系，并使用Levy游走实现局部开发与全局探索的平衡。
Result: 在LongBench上，4倍压缩比下平均得分49.3，超越LongLLMLingua（3倍压缩比48.8）；在多个任务上也优于基于视觉的文本压缩方法。
Conclusion: RAGP通过图剪枝和Levy游走有效建模文本的分布式信息结构，实现高效提示压缩。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prompt Framing Distorts Count-Based Evaluation of LLM Error Detection: Evidence from Numeric Anchoring
papers.abstract_en: Count-based F1 is widely used as a proxy for LLM error-detection quality, but this paper shows that it can rise dramatically without a corresponding improvement in span localization, a gap termed F1 Inflation. The paper introduces ErrorBench, a controlled stress-test protocol for prompt-induced count distortion. ErrorBench evaluates six contemporary LLMs under five prompt conditions over 4,290 responses from 143 CoNLL-2014 passages. Under CoNLL-2014 M2-style scoring, anchored prompts produce up to 0.79 points of F1 Inflation, and up to 0.96 under strict matching. A 100-passage replication using the official ERRANT 3.0.0 pipeline and multi-reference scoring reproduces the pattern: averaged over six models, the Blind-to-Anchored prompt shift raises Count-F1 by +0.21 while raising multi-reference ERRANT F0.5 by only +0.04. The study finds larger count responses in highly instruction-compliant GPT/Claude systems and smaller responses in the Gemini family under this stress-test protocol. The findings suggest that LLM proofreading and document-review evaluations should avoid pre-populated error counts and should report span-aware metrics alongside count-based metrics.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Preprint under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了基于计数的F1指标在评估LLM错误检测能力时存在严重扭曲：提示中的数字锚定（如预先提供错误数量）会使Count-F1显著提升，而实际错误定位质量并未同步改善，作者将此现象命名为'F1膨胀'。为量化该偏差，论文提出ErrorBench压力测试协议，在CoNLL-2014数据集上评估6种当代LLM，发现锚定提示最多导致0.79分的F1膨胀（严格匹配下为0.96）。基于ERRANT 3.0.0的多参考评分复现表明，从盲提示切换到锚定提示使Count-F1平均提升+0.21，但多参考ERRANT F0.5仅提升+0.04。研究建议LLM校对评估应避免预填充错误计数，并同时报告span-aware指标与计数指标。
Motivation: 现有的基于计数的F1指标被广泛用于评估LLM错误检测质量，但该指标可能因提示中的数字锚定而产生虚假提升，无法真实反映模型对错误位置的定位能力，这种扭曲尚未被系统量化。
Method: 设计ErrorBench压力测试协议，在CoNLL-2014数据集上控制五种提示条件（盲提示、锚定提示等），评估六种当代LLM的4290条响应，采用M2风格评分和ERRANT多参考评分，计算F1膨胀量及Count-F1与ERRANT F0.5的差异。
Result: 锚定提示下，LLM的Count-F1最多提升0.79（严格匹配0.96）；跨模型平均，从盲提示到锚定提示，Count-F1提升+0.21，而多参考ERRANT F0.5仅提升+0.04。GPT/Claude系列对指令高度遵从，计数响应更大，Gemini系列响应较小。
Conclusion: 基于计数的F1评估不可靠，LLM校对任务应避免预填充错误数量，并采用span-aware指标（如ERRANT F0.5）结合计数指标进行综合评价。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Breaking Safety at the Token Boundary: How BPE Tokenization Creates Exploitable Gaps in LLM Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Character-level perturbations bypass safety alignment in modern LLMs despite leaving prompts human-readable. We identify and test a central structural mechanism: BPE tokenization fragments safety-critical words into sub-word pieces, and the three public alignment datasets we surveyed contain no intentionally fragmented inputs. The mechanism is a chain, tested end-to-end on five model families (Qwen-3-4B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B). An optimization targeting safety-token fragmentation flips the first-token refusal trigger on 80-100% of refused HarmBench prompts, with 48% of those flips producing genuinely harmful outputs (per-model 29-65%; gap-vs-behavior ROC-AUC 0.66-0.98, pooled 0.84). Activation patching localizes the disrupted signal to the last ${\sim}30\%$ of layers; an alignment-data scan finds zero fragmented prompts among 30,000 examples (positive-control recall $\geq 99\%$ at attack-relevant intensities); and targeted-mutation experiments isolate safety words as the disruption locus. On the defense side, a 68-cell grid (55 trained checkpoints) shows that no DPO configuration achieves seed- and pool-stable ASR closure on the three families with closed pool-size confounds. SFT trained on fragmented prompts closes ASR on 3/5 families but only via global collapse that raises refusal on benign prompts as well, indicating the missing distribution is necessary but not sufficient under the LoRA-16 recipe we tested. To distinguish selective repair from global collapse, we introduce Conv-Benign, a candidate paired diagnostic. All ASR claims are 3-judge-calibrated (cell rankings stable across judges; absolute levels $\pm$18pp; see App.~B.13).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现BPE分词机制会碎片化安全关键词，导致LLM安全对齐存在可利用间隙。在五个模型族上测试，针对安全令牌碎片化的优化攻击可翻转80-100%的拒绝提示，其中48%产生有害输出。激活修补定位到后30%层，数据扫描显示对齐数据集中缺乏碎片化输入。防御方面，DPO无法稳定闭合攻击成功率（ASR），SFT虽能闭合3/5模型族但引发全局拒答上升。
Motivation: 现有LLM安全对齐数据集缺乏BPE碎片化输入，导致字符级扰动可绕过安全对齐，但根本机制不明。本文旨在揭示BPE分词结构如何创造安全漏洞。
Method: 提出针对安全令牌碎片化的优化攻击，在Qwen-3-4B等五个模型族上测试；结合激活修补、数据扫描和靶向突变实验分析机制；评估DPO和SFT两种防御策略。
Result: 攻击在80-100%的HarmBench拒绝提示上翻转拒绝行为，48%产生有害输出（各模型29-65%）；激活定位到后约30%层；对齐数据集中0碎片化提示（召回率≥99%）；DPO防御无法实现ASR闭合，SFT闭合3/5模型族但导致良性提示拒答上升。
Conclusion: BPE分词碎片化是LLM安全对齐的一个结构性漏洞，现有防御不充分；需要区分选择性修复与全局崩溃的方法，Conv-Benign诊断可辅助评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPARCLE: SPeaker-aware Aligned Representations via Contrastive Language Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in speech synthesis have shifted from phoneme representations to direct grapheme modeling. While phonemes address the one-to-many mapping between text and acoustics, they rely on grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) systems that fail to capture speaker-specific acoustic variation. Prior work demonstrates that grapheme-based models outperform phoneme-based systems at scale, but not in low-resource settings. In this paper, we propose SPARCLE, a speaker-aware grapheme representation model that enriches characters with their precise acoustic realizations. SPARCLE is trained with a contrastive objective to align graphemes with corresponding Wav2Vec2 acoustic representations while conditioned on speaker identity. The resulting model serves as a replacement to G2P systems for downstream text-to-speech (TTS) tasks. We demonstrate that SPARCLE improves generation quality, reducing word error rates by half in extreme low-resource settings compared to standard grapheme-based models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPARCLE，一种说话人感知的字母表示模型，通过对比学习对齐字母与Wav2Vec2声学表示，并以说话人身份为条件。在极端低资源文本转语音场景下，SPARCLE将词错误率减半，优于标准字母模型。
Motivation: 现有字母模型在低资源文本转语音任务中性能不佳，而基于音素的系统依赖字母到音素（G2P）转换，无法捕捉说话人特有的声学变化。
Method: SPARCLE使用对比学习目标，将字母嵌入与对应的Wav2Vec2声学表示对齐，同时以说话人身份为条件，生成说话人感知的字母表示。
Result: 在极端低资源设置下，SPARCLE将词错误率降低一半，相比标准字母模型显著提升生成质量。
Conclusion: SPARCLE可作为下游文本转语音系统中G2P的替代方案，尤其适用于低资源场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kara: Efficient Reasoning LLM Serving via Sliding-Window KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models often generate long chain-of-thought (CoT), which accumulates a massive KV cache during the decoding phase and incurs high decoding latency and limited throughput. To address these issues, KV cache compression has emerged as a promising technique for reducing memory overhead by selectively removing unimportant KV pairs while preserving useful ones for subsequent decoding. Nevertheless, we identify two key limitations in existing KV cache compression methods: 1) their threshold-triggered compression policy may provide limited throughput improvement or even reduce throughput, and may fully eliminate KV pairs from certain blocks of the sequence, potentially worsening information loss. 2) they typically retain either isolated KV pairs or fixed-size chunks with rigid boundaries, failing to preserve important flexible-sized chunks at arbitrary token positions. To overcome these limitations, we propose Kara, a sliding-window KV cache compression method that performs decoding-time compression by operating only on the recently generated context. Kara leverages bidirectional attention to score and select informative KV pairs in the window. To enable flexible preservation of important semantic information, we design a Token2Chunk module to expand a subset of selected KV pairs into chunks. Furthermore, we adapt Kara to PagedAttention and develop KvLLM, an inference framework built upon vLLM, which reduces KV cache memory usage and effectively improves output throughput. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements of proposed Kara and KvLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Kara，一种在解码阶段对KV缓存进行滑动窗口压缩的方法，旨在解决推理语言模型因长链思维（CoT）导致KV缓存过大、解码延迟高和吞吐量低的问题。Kara利用双向注意力对窗口内KV对进行评分和选择，并通过Token2Chunk模块将选中的KV对扩展为灵活大小的块。基于vLLM实现的推理框架KvLLM进一步减少内存占用并提升输出吞吐量。实验表明Kara和KvLLM在多种任务上取得一致性能提升。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩方法存在两个关键局限：一是阈值触发的压缩策略可能限制吞吐量甚至降低吞吐量，且可能完全移除某些序列块中的所有KV对，加剧信息损失；二是通常只保留孤立的KV对或固定大小的块，无法在任意位置保留灵活的重要块。
Method: Kara采用滑动窗口机制，仅在最近生成的上下文上进行解码时压缩；利用双向注意力为窗口内KV对打分并选择信息丰富的对；设计Token2Chunk模块将选中的KV对扩展为块，实现灵活保留语义信息；并适配PagedAttention，基于vLLM构建KvLLM推理框架。
Result: 大量实验表明，Kara和KvLLM在KV缓存内存占用和输出吞吐量方面持续优于现有方法，同时保持模型质量。
Conclusion: Kara通过滑动窗口压缩和灵活块保留策略，有效缓解了推理LLM解码阶段KV缓存过大的问题，提升了吞吐量，且易于集成到现有推理系统中。

papers.title: Safeguarding LLM Agents from Misalignment through Provenance Analysis
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents gain increasing access to powerful tools, ensuring that their actions are aligned with the user's intent becomes critical. When an agent's proposed tool invocation deviates from the user's intent -- a phenomenon called misalignment -- it may lead to harmful consequences that are difficult to undo. Existing runtime guardrails rely on an LLM-as-a-judge paradigm that lacks a systematic framework for reasoning about alignment, often producing judgments that are inconsistent or difficult to audit. Motivated by provenance analysis, we propose a provenance-based conceptual framework that formalizes misalignment detection as determining whether a proposed tool call is supported by traceable evidence in the agent's context. Building on this framework, we propose ProvenanceGuard, a multi-stage pipeline that analyzes the agent's action for three types of misalignment before the selected tool is executed and only allows the action to take place when it is considered aligned with the user's input query. We evaluated our proposed approach on two different benchmarks, Agent-SafetyBench and WorkBench, across 10 backbone LLMs. Compared to the LLM-as-a-judge baseline, ProvenanceGuard reduces error rate on misaligned traces from 42.9% to 1.8% on Agent-SafetyBench and from 32.1% to 17.3% on WorkBench, while reducing intervention burden on task-successful traces from 30.5% to 12.8% and introducing no statistically significant increase in unnecessary interventions on aligned traces. These results demonstrate that structured, provenance-based reasoning provides an effective and practical foundation for safeguarding LLM agents from misalignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM agent在工具调用时与用户意图偏离（misalignment）的问题，提出基于溯源分析（provenance analysis）的ProvenanceGuard框架。该框架在工具执行前检测三种类型的misalignment，通过形式化判断工具调用是否由可追踪证据支持。在Agent-SafetyBench和WorkBench上，相比LLM-as-a-judge基线，错误率分别从42.9%降至1.8%和从32.1%降至17.3%，成功轨迹上的干预负担从30.5%降至12.8%，且未引入显著额外干预。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM-as-a-judge的运行时防护缺乏系统推理框架，判断不一致且难以审计，无法可靠地防止agent工具调用偏离用户意图带来的有害后果。
Method: 提出基于溯源的概念框架，将misalignment检测形式化为工具调用是否由可追踪证据支持；进一步构建多阶段流水线ProvenanceGuard，在工具执行前分析三类misalignment，仅当判定对齐时才允许执行。
Result: 在Agent-SafetyBench上错误率从42.9%降至1.8%，在WorkBench上从32.1%降至17.3%；任务成功轨迹上的干预负担从30.5%降至12.8%，对齐轨迹上无显著额外干预。
Conclusion: 结构化、基于溯源的推理为保护LLM agent免受misalignment影响提供了有效且实用的基础。

papers.title: TokenScope: Token-Level Explainability and Interpretability for Code-Oriented Tasks in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how Large Language Models (LLMs) make token-level decisions during code generation remains a major challenge for both researchers and practitioners. While recent tools provide insights into model internals or generation outcomes, they often lack decoding-time signals, fine-grained uncertainty measures, and interactive mechanisms for exploring alternative generation paths. We present TokenScope, an interactive interpretability and analysis tool for decoder-based LLMs that exposes token-level metrics, attention patterns, and structural information during generation. TokenScope supports interactive token replacement, counterfactual branching, and code-aware aggregation via abstract syntax trees. By unifying decoding-time signals with structural program analysis, TokenScope enables systematic investigation of LLM behaviour during code generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 TokenScope，一个针对解码器型大语言模型（LLM）的交互式可解释性分析工具，专注于代码生成任务。工具提供 token 级别的指标、注意力模式和结构信息，支持交互式 token 替换、反事实分支和基于抽象语法树（AST）的代码感知聚合。通过统一解码时信号与结构程序分析，帮助系统研究 LLM 在代码生成过程中的行为。
Motivation: 现有工具缺乏解码时信号、细粒度不确定性度量和交互式探索替代生成路径的机制，难以理解 LLM 在代码生成时的 token 级别决策。
Method: 提出 TokenScope 工具，集成 token 级别指标、注意力模式、结构信息，支持交互式 token 替换、反事实分支和 AST 聚合。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，仅描述了工具功能和目标。
Conclusion: 摘要指出通过统一解码时信号与结构程序分析，TokenScope 能系统研究 LLM 在代码生成中的行为。
Relevance: 0
